name: North West Shelf Project
nature_en: LNG export and domestic gas: offshore gas fields + Karratha Gas Plant
nature_zh: LNG出口及内销气：海上气田＋Karratha天然气处理厂
location_note: North Rankin Complex (offshore hub); LNG plant onshore at Karratha
owners: Woodside 33.33% (operator; rising to 50% on completion of Chevron asset swap, targeted Q4 2026), BP 16.67%, Chevron 16.67%, Shell 16.67%, Japan Australia LNG (MIMI: Mitsui/Mitsubishi) 16.67%; CNOOC in China LNG JV
capacity_note: Capacity after one of five LNG trains was shut in July 2025 (Baird Maritime, Sep 2025); original five-train capacity 16.9 Mtpa
description_en:
Australia's oldest LNG export project, now in field decline and seeking third-party gas to fill spare capacity.
- One of five LNG trains shut in July 2025, cutting capacity to 14.3 Mtpa.
- Federal approval (12 Sep 2025) extends operations from 2030 to 2070 under 48 conditions, incl. NOx cuts of 60% within five years and 90% by 2061.
- Woodside equity production 14.0 MMboe in H1 2026 (down 7% on reservoir decline and Cyclone Narelle); LNG reliability 98.7%.
- Greater Western Flank Phase 4 drilling from 2027, first production 2028; Browse gas planned as the main backfill.
description_zh:
澳大利亚运营时间最长的LNG出口项目，气田处于递减期，需引入第三方气源填补富余产能。
- 2025年7月关停5条生产线中的1条，铭牌产能降至1430万吨/年。
- 2025年9月12日获联邦最终批准，运营期由2030年延至2070年，附48项条件，包括氮氧化物排放5年内降60%、2061年前降90%。
- 2026年上半年伍德赛德权益产量1400万桶油当量，同比降7%（储层递减及Narelle气旋），LNG装置可靠性98.7%。
- Greater Western Flank四期计划2027年钻井、2028年投产；Browse气田为主要接替气源。
latest_update_en: 2026-08: Three Federal Court challenges to the 2070 extension heard July 2026; WA Supreme Court matter scheduled Q4 2026. Single-train turnaround from Sep 2026.
latest_update_zh: 2026年8月：针对延期至2070年批准的3宗联邦法院诉讼已于2026年7月开庭，西澳最高法院案件排期2026年第四季度；单列生产线检修自2026年9月开始。

name: Pluto LNG (Train 1)
nature_en: LNG export: Pluto/Xena offshore gas fields + Karratha LNG train
nature_zh: LNG出口：Pluto/Xena海上气田＋Karratha液化线
location_note: Pluto platform (approximate); LNG train onshore near Karratha
capacity_note: Existing Pluto train capacity (LNG Prime, Jul 2024); Train 1 being modified to process Scarborough gas
description_en:
Single-train LNG project fed by the Pluto and Xena fields, being integrated with Scarborough.
- Train 1 capacity 4.9 Mtpa; modifications let it take Scarborough gas.
- Woodside equity production 20.6 MMboe in H1 2026, down 18% (May 2026 turnaround and Cyclone Mitchell).
- LNG reliability 100% for three consecutive quarters to Q1 2026; 98.7% in H1 2026.
- XNA-03 infill well drilled; start-up targeted H2 2026.
description_zh:
单线LNG项目，气源为Pluto及Xena气田，正与Scarborough项目整合。
- 一号线铭牌产能490万吨/年，改造后可处理Scarborough气。
- 2026年上半年伍德赛德权益产量2060万桶油当量，同比降18%（5月大修及Mitchell气旋）。
- 截至2026年一季度连续3个季度LNG装置可靠性100%，2026年上半年为98.7%。
- XNA-03加密井已完钻，计划2026年下半年投产。
latest_update_en: 2026-05: Train 1 turnaround completed on schedule and budget (400,000+ hours, no lost-time injury).
latest_update_zh: 2026年5月：一号线大修按期按预算完成（工时逾40万小时，无损工事故）。

name: Scarborough Energy Project and Pluto Train 2
nature_en: LNG export and domestic gas: deepwater Scarborough field + FPU + 433 km pipeline + Pluto Train 2
nature_zh: LNG出口及内销气：Scarborough深水气田＋浮式生产装置＋433公里管道＋Pluto二号线
location_note: Scarborough field FPU (approximate), ~375 km off the Pilbara coast
owners: Scarborough JV: Woodside 74.9% (operator), JERA 15.1%, LNG Japan 10%; Pluto Train 2: Woodside 51%, Global Infrastructure Partners 49%
capacity_note: Pluto Train 2 capacity ~5 Mtpa plus up to 225 TJ/d domestic gas; total project cost US$12.5bn (revised Jul 2024, FID estimate US$12.0bn)
description_en:
Woodside's largest Australian growth project, combining a deepwater gas field with a second Pluto LNG train.
- FID Nov 2021; revised cost US$12.5bn (Woodside share US$8.2bn).
- 70,000 t floating production unit; 433 km export pipeline; 8 of 13 planned wells drilled by Aug 2026.
- Pluto Train 2 ~5 Mtpa LNG plus up to 225 TJ/d domestic gas; Bechtel EPC.
- 98% complete at 30 Jun 2026; first gas reached the FPU after the period.
description_zh:
伍德赛德在澳最大增长项目，将深水气田与Pluto第二条液化线结合。
- 2021年11月FID，2024年7月修订总投资125亿美元（伍德赛德权益82亿美元）。
- 浮式生产装置7万吨，外输管道433公里，截至2026年8月已钻13口计划井中的8口。
- Pluto二号线LNG约500万吨/年，另供内销气最高225太焦/日，Bechtel为EPC承包商。
- 截至2026年6月30日完工率98%，期后浮式生产装置实现首气。
latest_update_en: 2026-08: First gas flowing offshore; FPU ready for start-up. First LNG cargo targeted Q4 2026 (not yet confirmed shipped at time of verification).
latest_update_zh: 2026年8月：海上已实现首气，浮式生产装置具备启动条件；首船LNG目标2026年第四季度（核实时尚未确认装运）。

name: Gorgon LNG
nature_en: LNG export and domestic gas: Gorgon and Jansz-Io fields + Barrow Island LNG plant with CO2 injection
nature_zh: LNG出口及内销气：Gorgon与Jansz-Io气田＋Barrow岛液化厂（含CO2回注）
location_note: Gorgon field (approximate); LNG plant on Barrow Island (-20.78, 115.45)
owners: Chevron 47.33% (operator), ExxonMobil 25%, Shell 25%, Osaka Gas 1.25%, Tokyo Gas 1%, Chubu Electric/JERA 0.417%
capacity_note: 3 trains x 5.2 Mtpa; domestic gas up to 300 TJ/d. Cost widely reported at US$54bn (Natural Gas World); Offshore Technology cites 54bn in A$ terms, so A$ field left null
description_en:
Australia's largest LNG project by capacity, with an integrated reservoir CO2 injection system.
- Three trains of 5.2 Mtpa (15.6 Mtpa); first LNG March 2016, third train March 2017.
- Domestic gas plant up to 300 TJ/d, supplying since Dec 2016.
- Raw gas carries ~15% CO2, injected >2,000 m below Barrow Island via nine injection wells.
- Gorgon Stage 3 (six wells, two fields, ~US$2bn) sanctioned Dec 2025 as a reservoir management investment.
description_zh:
按产能计澳大利亚最大的LNG项目，配套储层CO2回注系统。
- 3条生产线各520万吨/年，合计1560万吨/年；2016年3月首产LNG，三号线2017年3月投产。
- 内销气装置最高300太焦/日，2016年12月起供气。
- 原料气CO2含量约15%，经9口注入井回注至Barrow岛地下2000米以下。
- Gorgon三期（2个气田6口井，约20亿美元）于2025年12月FID，属稳产投资，不增加产能。
latest_update_en: 2025-12: Gorgon Stage 3 FID (~US$2bn, six wells); Jansz-Io compression targeting completion mid-2026.
latest_update_zh: 2025年12月：Gorgon三期FID（约20亿美元，6口井）；Jansz-Io增压项目目标2026年年中完工。

name: Jansz-Io Compression Project
nature_en: Subsea gas compression to sustain Gorgon LNG supply
nature_zh: 海底天然气增压，维持Gorgon LNG供气
owners: Gorgon JV: Chevron 47.33% (operator), ExxonMobil 25%, Shell 25%, Japanese utilities 2.67%
capacity_note: US$4bn project; 27,000 t floating field control station; 6,500 t subsea compression station; 100 MVA power over ~140 km from Barrow Island
description_en:
Brownfield project to offset reservoir pressure decline at Jansz-Io, a core Gorgon feed field.
- FID 2021 at ~US$4bn.
- Electric subsea compression station at ~1,360 m depth, powered from Barrow Island over ~140 km (ABB).
- Normally unattended floating field control station (~27,000 t) built by DSME; Aker Solutions supplied compression system.
- Installation scheduled mid-2024 to mid-2026.
description_zh:
棕地增压项目，用于抵消Gorgon主力气源Jansz-Io的储层压力递减。
- 2021年FID，投资约40亿美元。
- 电驱海底增压站位于约1360米水深，经约140公里海缆由Barrow岛供电（ABB）。
- 常态无人值守浮式控制站约2.7万吨，由DSME建造；Aker Solutions供应增压系统。
- 安装窗口为2024年年中至2026年年中。
latest_update_en: 2026: Targeting completion mid-2026; operator start-up announcement not confirmed in sources reviewed (Oct 2026).
latest_update_zh: 2026年：目标2026年年中完工；截至2026年10月所查来源未见运营商宣布投运。

name: Wheatstone LNG
nature_en: LNG export and domestic gas: Wheatstone/Iago and Julimar-Brunello fields + Ashburton North LNG plant
nature_zh: LNG出口及内销气：Wheatstone/Iago与Julimar-Brunello气田＋Ashburton North液化厂
location_note: Wheatstone offshore platform (approximate); LNG plant near Onslow
owners: Chevron 64.14% (operator), KUFPEC 13.4%, Woodside 13% (transferring to Chevron under 2026 swap), PE Wheatstone (JERA) 8%, Kyushu Electric 1.46%
capacity_note: Two trains; domestic gas plant ~200 TJ/d; approved to expand to 25 Mtpa; project cost US$34bn (WA Government)
description_en:
Chevron's second operated LNG hub in WA.
- Two trains totalling 8.9 Mtpa; first LNG export Oct 2017, Train 2 mid-2018.
- Domestic gas plant ~200 TJ/d, supplying since Mar 2019.
- Cost US$34bn; approval held for expansion to 25 Mtpa.
- Woodside's 13% stake moves to Chevron on completion of the asset swap (targeted Q4 2026).
description_zh:
雪佛龙在西澳运营的第二个LNG枢纽。
- 2条生产线合计890万吨/年，2017年10月首船出口，二号线2018年年中投产。
- 内销气装置约200太焦/日，2019年3月起供气。
- 总投资340亿美元，已获扩建至2500万吨/年的批准。
- 伍德赛德13%权益将在资产置换完成后转给雪佛龙（目标2026年第四季度）。
latest_update_en: 2026-H1: Woodside share of output 4.4 MMboe, down 30% due to Cyclone Narelle.
latest_update_zh: 2026年上半年：伍德赛德权益产量440万桶油当量，受Narelle气旋影响同比降30%。

name: Julimar-Brunello
nature_en: Subsea gas fields tied back to Wheatstone platform
nature_zh: 海底气田，回接至Wheatstone平台
owners: Woodside 65% (operator), KUFPEC 35%; Woodside interest and operatorship transfer to Chevron on swap completion (targeted Q4 2026)
description_en:
Third-party feed gas for Wheatstone LNG.
- Woodside 65% operated interest; to be handed to Chevron under the Dec 2024 asset swap.
- Julimar Phase 3: four-well tieback; drilling began Q3 2025, subsea construction and drilling completed H1 2026.
- Phase 3 start-up targeted H2 2026; handover is a condition of the swap, with up to US$100m contingent payment to Woodside.
- Decommissioning of three exploration wells began H1 2026.
description_zh:
Wheatstone LNG的第三方原料气来源。
- 伍德赛德持有65%权益并任运营商，按2024年12月资产置换协议将移交雪佛龙。
- Julimar三期为4口井回接，2025年三季度开钻，2026年上半年完成海底施工与钻井。
- 三期目标2026年下半年投产，移交为置换交割条件，伍德赛德可获最高1亿美元或有对价。
- 3口探井弃置作业于2026年上半年开始。
latest_update_en: 2026-H1: Julimar Phase 3 subsea construction and drilling complete; start-up targeted H2 2026.
latest_update_zh: 2026年上半年：Julimar三期海底施工及钻井完成，目标2026年下半年投产。

name: Ichthys LNG
nature_en: LNG export: Ichthys field (CPF + FPSO) + 889 km pipeline + Bladin Point LNG plant, Darwin
nature_zh: LNG出口：Ichthys气田（中央处理平台＋FPSO）＋889公里管道＋达尔文Bladin Point液化厂
location_note: Ichthys field (approximate), ~220 km off WA; LNG plant in Darwin NT
owners: INPEX 67.82% (operator; 68.555% after JERA stake purchase, pending approval), TotalEnergies 26%, CPC 2.625%, Japanese utilities remainder
capacity_note: Nominal two-train capacity 8.9 Mtpa (output ~9.3 Mtpa reported 2026) plus ~1.65 Mtpa LPG and up to ~100 kbbl/d condensate; cost US$34bn at FID, later US$37bn
description_en:
Japan's largest overseas LNG investment, operated by INPEX.
- First gas 30 Jul 2018; first LNG cargo 22 Oct 2018.
- Ichthys Explorer CPF (~120,000 t) and Ichthys Venturer FPSO; 889 km subsea pipeline to Darwin.
- Output ~9.3 Mtpa LNG, ~1.65 Mtpa LPG, condensate peak ~100 kbbl/d.
- 116 LNG cargoes expected in 2025, matching 2024.
description_zh:
国际石油开发帝石（INPEX）运营，日本企业最大的海外LNG投资。
- 2018年7月30日首气，2018年10月22日首船LNG。
- Ichthys Explorer中央处理平台约12万吨，配Ichthys Venturer FPSO，889公里海底管道至达尔文。
- 年产LNG约930万吨、LPG约165万吨，凝析油峰值约10万桶/日。
- 2025年预计外运LNG 116船，与2024年持平。
latest_update_en: 2026-09: INPEX agreed to buy JERA's 0.735% stake, lifting its interest to 68.555% (subject to Australian approval).
latest_update_zh: 2026年9月：INPEX同意收购JERA所持0.735%权益，持股升至68.555%（待澳方审批）。

name: Prelude FLNG
nature_en: Floating LNG facility on the Prelude field
nature_zh: Prelude气田上的浮式LNG装置
capacity_note: Nameplate 3.6 Mtpa LNG; reported cost US$17.4bn (GEM)
description_en:
World's largest floating LNG facility, moored ~200 km off the Kimberley coast.
- Nameplate 3.6 Mtpa LNG; first production Dec 2018.
- Prior outages: 2022 safety shutdown and industrial action; planned maintenance Jan-Feb 2025.
- Crux field (FID May 2022) is the designated backfill, first gas expected 2027.
description_zh:
全球最大的浮式LNG装置，系泊于Kimberley海岸外约200公里。
- 铭牌产能360万吨/年，2018年12月首产。
- 2022年曾因安全事件停产并遭遇劳资行动；2025年1至2月计划检修。
- Crux气田（2022年5月FID）为接替气源，预计2027年首气。
latest_update_en: 2025-12: NOPSEMA approvals received for Crux tie-in pipeline to backfill Prelude.
latest_update_zh: 2025年12月：获NOPSEMA批准Crux回接管道，用于向Prelude补充气源。

name: Crux
nature_en: Gas field backfill for Prelude FLNG: unmanned platform + ~160 km pipeline
nature_zh: Prelude浮式LNG接替气源：无人平台＋约160公里管道
location_note: Crux field (approximate), permit AC/P23 (Ashmore and Cartier offshore area)
capacity_note: Design rate 550 mmscf/d to Prelude; reserves ~2 tcf gas and 66 MMbbl condensate (Offshore Technology)
description_en:
Backfill gas development to extend Prelude FLNG.
- FID May 2022.
- Not-normally-manned platform with five dry-tree wells, remotely operated from Prelude.
- 26-inch export pipeline of ~160 km; design rate 550 mmscf/d; field life ~20 years.
- NOPSEMA approved installation environment plan in March 2025.
description_zh:
为延长Prelude浮式LNG寿命而开发的接替气源。
- 2022年5月FID。
- 常态无人平台，5口干式井口，由Prelude远程操控。
- 26英寸外输管道约160公里，设计产量5.5亿立方英尺/日，开采期约20年。
- 2025年3月NOPSEMA批准平台与管道安装环境计划。
latest_update_en: 2025-12: Further NOPSEMA approvals for the Crux pipeline; first gas expected 2027.
latest_update_zh: 2025年12月：Crux管道再获NOPSEMA批准，预计2027年首气。

name: Browse to North West Shelf
name_zh: Browse至西北大陆架开发项目
nature_en: Planned LNG backfill: Brecknock, Calliance, Torosa fields via FPSOs and ~900 km pipeline to Karratha
nature_zh: 规划中的LNG接替项目：Brecknock、Calliance、Torosa气田经FPSO及约900公里管道输往Karratha
owners: Woodside 30.6% (operator; 41.27% after pre-emption of PetroChina 10.67%), Shell 27%, BP 17.33%, Japan Australia LNG (MIMI) 14.4%, PetroChina 10.67% (being acquired)
capacity_note: Reported cost A$48.7bn (~US$34bn), Jul 2026; three-train concept at Karratha Gas Plant under study
description_en:
Australia's largest undeveloped conventional gas resource, intended to refill North West Shelf trains.
- Fields: Brecknock, Calliance and Torosa (Torosa underlies Scott Reef).
- Reported cost A$48.7bn (~US$34bn); FPSO tenders issued to inform FEED entry.
- WA EPA and DCCEEW accepted amended proposal Aug-Sep 2025; revised Browse CCS referral lodged Jun 2026.
- Jun 2026: Woodside pre-empted PetroChina's 10.67% for US$225m plus US$175m contingent on FID of all three fields by 30 Jun 2032.
description_zh:
澳大利亚最大的未开发常规天然气资源，用于填补西北大陆架液化产能。
- 包括Brecknock、Calliance、Torosa三个气田（Torosa位于Scott Reef下方）。
- 报道投资487亿澳元（约340亿美元），已发出FPSO招标以支持进入FEED决策。
- 2025年8至9月西澳EPA与联邦DCCEEW接受修订方案，2026年6月重新提交Browse碳封存（CCS）申报。
- 2026年6月伍德赛德对中石油10.67%权益行使优先购买权，对价2.25亿美元，另加1.75亿美元或有对价（条件为2032年6月30日前三个气田均FID）。
latest_update_en: 2026-07: WA Government declared Browse to NWS a State Significant Project, prioritising state approvals.
latest_update_zh: 2026年7月：西澳政府将Browse至西北大陆架项目列为州重大项目，州级审批优先处理。

name: Greater Sunrise
nature_en: Undeveloped gas-condensate fields in the Timor Sea; Timor-Leste-based LNG concept under study
nature_zh: 帝汶海未开发凝析气田，研究在东帝汶建LNG厂方案
basin_region: Timor Sea (Greater Sunrise Special Regime area)
location_note: Sunrise/Troubadour fields (approximate), under the 2018 Australia-Timor-Leste maritime boundary treaty
description_en:
Long-stalled gas development whose processing location has been the main dispute with Timor-Leste.
- Woodside 33.44% operator; Timor GAP majority partner.
- Technical and commercial work progressing on a Timor-Leste-based LNG concept under a cooperation agreement.
- Earliest first gas pushed back to 2034-35; Timor-Leste targets FID by 2029.
- Fiscal and regulatory frameworks still being negotiated with both governments.
description_zh:
长期停滞的气田开发项目，处理厂选址是与东帝汶的主要分歧。
- 伍德赛德持33.44%并任运营商，Timor GAP为控股方。
- 依据合作协议推进东帝汶本土LNG方案的技术与商务研究。
- 最早首气推迟至2034至2035年，东帝汶目标2029年前FID。
- 财税与监管框架仍在与两国政府谈判。
latest_update_en: 2026-09: Earliest production date moved back two years to 2034; latest negotiation round concluded.
latest_update_zh: 2026年9月：最早投产时间推迟两年至2034年，最新一轮谈判结束。

name: Darwin LNG
nature_en: Single-train LNG plant at Wickham Point, Darwin, now fed by Barossa
nature_zh: 达尔文Wickham Point单线液化厂，现由Barossa气田供气
location_note: LNG plant at Wickham Point, Darwin
owners: Santos 43.4% (operator), SK E&S 25%, INPEX 11.4%, Eni 11%, JERA 6.1%, Tokyo Gas 3.1%
capacity_note: Annual capacity 3.7 Mt (Argus, Jan 2026)
description_en:
LNG plant restarted on Barossa gas after a two-year gap following Bayu-Undan depletion.
- Capacity 3.7 Mtpa; originally supplied by Bayu-Undan from 2006.
- Life extension project completed 2025; ready for start-up Aug 2025; environment protection licence renewed from 19 Sep 2025.
- First Barossa LNG cargo loaded 22 Jan 2026 for Sakai, Japan.
- 100% reliability in the June 2026 quarter.
description_zh:
Bayu-Undan枯竭后停产约两年，现以Barossa气源复产。
- 铭牌产能370万吨/年，2006年起由Bayu-Undan供气。
- 2025年完成延寿改造，同年8月具备启动条件，环保许可自2025年9月19日续期。
- 2026年1月22日装运Barossa首船LNG，运往日本堺市接收站。
- 2026年二季度装置可靠性100%。
latest_update_en: 2026-07: Darwin LNG achieved 100% reliability in the June 2026 quarter.
latest_update_zh: 2026年7月：达尔文LNG 2026年二季度可靠性达100%。

name: Barossa Gas Project
nature_en: Offshore gas-condensate field + BW Opal FPSO + pipeline to Darwin LNG
nature_zh: 海上凝析气田＋BW Opal浮式生产储卸装置＋输往达尔文LNG的管道
location_note: Barossa field / BW Opal FPSO (approximate), ~285 km north of Darwin
capacity_note: BW Opal producing ~450 mmscf/d at ~75% of capacity in Jan 2026; US$3.95bn invested to Jun 2025
description_en:
Backfill gas for Darwin LNG and Santos' largest recent Australian project.
- FPSO arrived in field 15 Jun 2025; first gas into the export pipeline 12 Oct 2025.
- First LNG cargo loaded 22 Jan 2026; ramp-up delayed ~2 months by FPSO pipework failures.
- First condensate cargo (~300,000 bbl) shipped to South Korea in the June 2026 quarter.
- Operating at 97% of planned rates in Q2 2026.
description_zh:
桑托斯近年在澳最大项目，为达尔文LNG提供接替气源。
- FPSO于2025年6月15日抵达气田，2025年10月12日首气进入外输管道。
- 2026年1月22日装运首船LNG；FPSO管线故障导致爬产推迟约2个月。
- 2026年二季度首船凝析油约30万桶运往韩国。
- 2026年二季度产量达计划水平的97%。
latest_update_en: 2026-07: Barossa at 97% of planned production rates; first condensate cargo loaded.
latest_update_zh: 2026年7月：Barossa产量达计划的97%，首船凝析油完成装运。

name: Gorgon Stage 3
nature_en: Six-well tie-in of two additional gas fields to sustain Gorgon supply
nature_zh: 新增2个气田6口井回接，维持Gorgon供气
owners: Gorgon JV: Chevron 47.33% (operator), ExxonMobil 25%, Shell 25%, Japanese utilities 2.67%
capacity_note: ~US$2bn (A$3bn); reservoir management, not a capacity expansion
description_en:
Backfill phase for Gorgon LNG.
- FID Dec 2025 at ~US$2bn (A$3bn).
- Six new wells across two gas fields.
- Described by Chevron as reservoir management, not capacity expansion.
description_zh:
Gorgon LNG的接替开发阶段。
- 2025年12月FID，投资约20亿美元（30亿澳元）。
- 2个气田新钻6口井。
- 雪佛龙定位为储层管理投资，不增加产能。
latest_update_en: 2025-12: FID taken by Gorgon JV.
latest_update_zh: 2025年12月：Gorgon合资方作出FID。

name: Greater Western Flank Phase 4
nature_en: Subsea backfill wells for the North West Shelf Project
nature_zh: 西北大陆架项目海底接替井
location_note: Greater Western Flank area west of North Rankin (approximate)
owners: NWS JV: Woodside 33.33% (operator; 50% post-swap), BP, Chevron, Shell, MIMI 16.67% each
description_en:
Next NWS backfill phase ahead of Browse.
- Drilling rig contract approved H1 2026.
- Drilling from 2027; first production targeted 2028.
- Supports NWS volumes as legacy fields decline.
description_zh:
Browse之前西北大陆架的下一期接替开发。
- 2026年上半年批准钻机合同。
- 2027年开钻，目标2028年投产。
- 用于弥补老气田递减。
latest_update_en: 2026-H1: Rig contract approved; drilling from 2027.
latest_update_zh: 2026年上半年：钻机合同获批，2027年开钻。

name: Equus Gas Project
nature_en: Undeveloped gas fields; tie-back concept to North West Shelf infrastructure for domestic gas and LNG
nature_zh: 未开发气田，计划回接西北大陆架设施，供内销气及LNG
capacity_note: Alcoa GSA ~50 TJ/d from start-up, ~182 PJ over 10 years
description_en:
Independent multi-tcf gas resource seeking FID via NWS tie-back.
- Pre-FEED found tie-back to existing NWS infrastructure technically feasible.
- 10-year GSA with Alcoa: ~50 TJ/d from start-up, ~182 PJ, ~5% of WA domestic market.
- Alcoa arrangement provides up to US$30m toward FEED and FID.
- FID and first gas dates not set.
description_zh:
独立持有的数万亿立方英尺级气资源，拟回接西北大陆架后推进FID。
- 预FEED结论：回接现有西北大陆架设施技术可行。
- 与美铝签署10年购气协议：投产起约50太焦/日，合计约182拍焦，约占西澳内销市场5%。
- 美铝安排提供最高3000万美元资金支持FEED及FID。
- FID与首气时间未定。
latest_update_en: 2026-08: Binding 10-year gas sales agreement with Alcoa finalised.
latest_update_zh: 2026年8月：与美铝的10年期购气协议正式生效。

name: Thebe Gas Field
nature_en: Undeveloped deepwater gas discovery on the Exmouth Plateau
nature_zh: Exmouth高原深水未开发气发现
location_note: Thebe-1 location (approximate), ~50 km north of Scarborough
owners: Woodside (inherited BHP's 100% interest via 2022 merger; current equity not re-verified)
description_en:
Discovered gas in the Scarborough area, a potential future Pluto/Scarborough backfill.
- Thebe-1 discovered by BHP in Aug 2007 in WA-346-P.
- Water depth ~1,173 m; ~73 m gas column.
- Passed to Woodside with BHP Petroleum in 2022; no development concept announced.
description_zh:
位于Scarborough区域的气发现，可作为Pluto/Scarborough的远期接替气源。
- 2007年8月由必和必拓在WA-346-P区块发现（Thebe-1井）。
- 水深约1173米，气柱约73米。
- 2022年随必和必拓石油业务并入伍德赛德，尚无开发方案。
latest_update_en: No dated 2025-26 development found; held as contingent resource.
latest_update_zh: 未查到2025至2026年开发动态，作为待开发资源持有。

name: Macedon
nature_en: Domestic gas: subsea wells + onshore gas plant at Ashburton North
nature_zh: 内销气：海底井＋Ashburton North陆上处理厂
capacity_note: Domestic gas plant capacity ~200 TJ/d into the Dampier-Bunbury pipeline (WA Government)
description_en:
Pure domestic gas project supplying the WA market.
- Commissioned Sep 2013; four offshore wells and onshore plant ~200 TJ/d.
- Supplied ~16% of WA domestic gas in H1 2026.
- Woodside share 4.0 MMboe in H1 2026, down 5% on natural decline.
description_zh:
纯内销气项目，供应西澳市场。
- 2013年9月投产，4口海上井，陆上处理厂约200太焦/日。
- 2026年上半年约占西澳内销气供应16%。
- 2026年上半年伍德赛德权益产量400万桶油当量，自然递减致同比降5%。
latest_update_en: 2026-H1: Macedon supplied ~16% of WA domestic gas.
latest_update_zh: 2026年上半年：Macedon约占西澳内销气供应16%。

name: Varanus Island Hub (John Brookes, Spar, Halyard, Spartan)
nature_en: Domestic gas hub: offshore fields processed on Varanus Island
nature_zh: 内销气枢纽：海上气田在Varanus岛处理
description_en:
Santos' main WA domestic gas hub.
- Fields: John Brookes, Spar, Halyard, Spartan, Greater East Spar.
- Compression project phase 2 developed ~24 mmboe of 2P reserves; Halyard-2 infill lifted 2025 output.
- 99% reliability in 2025; WA domestic gas output up 15% on 2024.
- John Brookes-7 well planned Q3/Q4 2027, subject to approvals.
description_zh:
桑托斯在西澳的主力内销气枢纽。
- 气田包括John Brookes、Spar、Halyard、Spartan、Greater East Spar。
- 增压二期动用2P储量约2400万桶油当量，Halyard-2加密井提升2025年产量。
- 2025年可靠性99%，西澳内销气产量同比增15%。
- John Brookes-7井计划2027年三或四季度实施，待审批。
latest_update_en: 2026-Q2: Condensate tank B refurbishment complete; JB-7 drilling planned Q3/Q4 2027.
latest_update_zh: 2026年二季度：B号凝析油储罐翻新完成，JB-7井计划2027年三或四季度钻探。

name: Reindeer / Devil Creek
nature_en: Domestic gas: Reindeer wellhead platform + Devil Creek onshore gas plant (ceased)
nature_zh: 内销气：Reindeer井口平台＋Devil Creek陆上处理厂（已停产）
description_en:
Domestic gas asset that has ceased production; repurposing for CO2 storage under study.
- Reindeer platform and Devil Creek plant entered cessation of production in Q3 2025.
- Pipeline in remote monitoring and preservation; plant unmanned, in care and maintenance.
- Reindeer CCS: Declaration of Storage Formation submitted to NOPTA Nov 2024.
description_zh:
已停产的内销气资产，正研究改作CO2封存。
- Reindeer平台与Devil Creek处理厂于2025年三季度停产。
- 管道处于远程监测与保养状态，处理厂无人值守、封存维护。
- Reindeer CCS已于2024年11月向NOPTA提交封存地层申报。
latest_update_en: 2025-Q3: Cessation of production; Devil Creek in care and maintenance.
latest_update_zh: 2025年三季度：停产，Devil Creek处理厂进入封存维护。

name: Pyrenees FPSO
nature_en: Oil: Ravensworth, Crosby, Stickle and other fields via Pyrenees Venture FPSO
nature_zh: 原油：Ravensworth、Crosby、Stickle等油田经Pyrenees Venture FPSO生产
owners: Woodside operator (WA-42-L 71.43%, WA-43-L 40%); Santos and other partners hold the balance
description_en:
Ex-BHP oil FPSO now operated by Woodside.
- Macedon & Pyrenees crude 1,274 Mbbl Jan-Sep 2025 (gross reported).
- Woodside share ~6 Mboe/d in Sep 2025 after unplanned maintenance.
- Affected by Cyclone Narelle in H1 2026; combined Woodside FPSO output (Pyrenees, Okha, Ngujima-Yin) 2.2 MMboe, down 39%.
description_zh:
原属必和必拓的浮式产油装置，现由伍德赛德运营。
- 2025年1至9月Macedon与Pyrenees合计原油产量127.4万桶。
- 2025年9月伍德赛德权益产量约6千桶油当量/日，受非计划检修影响。
- 2026年上半年受Narelle气旋影响，伍德赛德3艘FPSO合计产量220万桶油当量，同比降39%。
latest_update_en: 2026-H1: Production affected by Cyclone Narelle.
latest_update_zh: 2026年上半年：产量受Narelle气旋影响。

name: Ngujima-Yin FPSO (Vincent / Greater Enfield)
nature_en: Oil: Vincent and Greater Enfield fields via Ngujima-Yin FPSO
nature_zh: 原油：Vincent及大Enfield油田经Ngujima-Yin FPSO生产
description_en:
Woodside's largest Australian oil FPSO by output.
- Crude 2,769 Mbbl Jan-Sep 2025.
- Woodside 60% share ~17 Mboe/d in Sep 2025 (20 Mboe/d in Jun 2025).
- Hosts Greater Enfield tie-backs after the Enfield FPSO was retired.
description_zh:
伍德赛德在澳产量最大的浮式产油装置。
- 2025年1至9月原油产量276.9万桶。
- 伍德赛德60%权益产量2025年9月约1.7万桶油当量/日（6月为2万）。
- Enfield FPSO退役后承接大Enfield区块回接井。
latest_update_en: 2025-Q3: Output eased on reliability issues; included in combined FPSO decline of 39% in H1 2026.
latest_update_zh: 2025年三季度：可靠性问题致产量回落；2026年上半年计入FPSO合计产量降39%。

name: Van Gogh / Coniston / Novara (Ningaloo Vision)
nature_en: Oil fields formerly produced via Ningaloo Vision FPSO; now decommissioning
nature_zh: 原经Ningaloo Vision FPSO生产的油田，现处弃置阶段
description_en:
Exmouth sub-basin oil fields at end of life.
- Ningaloo Vision entered cessation of production Aug 2025, disconnected and left Australia; ownership passed to Pax Ocean for recycling.
- Removal of remaining floating assets (incl. DTM) scheduled from H2 2026.
- VGCN 4HGI ST1 well decommissioning or suspension proposed from H1 2027 (EP with NOPSEMA).
description_zh:
Exmouth次盆地已到开采末期的油田。
- Ningaloo Vision于2025年8月停产并解脱离开澳大利亚，所有权转给Pax Ocean拆解回收。
- 剩余浮式设施（含DTM）计划2026年下半年开始拆除。
- VGCN 4HGI ST1井拟于2027年上半年起弃置或暂闭（环境计划在NOPSEMA审查中）。
latest_update_en: 2026-Q2: Floating asset removal scheduled to start H2 2026.
latest_update_zh: 2026年二季度：浮式设施拆除计划于2026年下半年启动。

name: Okha FPSO (Cossack, Wanaea, Lambert, Hermes)
nature_en: Oil: North West Shelf oil fields via Okha FPSO
nature_zh: 原油：西北大陆架油田经Okha FPSO生产
owners: Woodside 50% (operator; 66.67% after Chevron swap), Jadestone 33.33%, Chevron 16.67% (to Woodside)
description_en:
Mature NWS oil project; temporarily shut in for repairs in 2026.
- Jadestone lifted its stake to 33.33% by buying MIMI's 16.67% (closing 2024), incl. FPSO and abandonment liability.
- Crude 1,474 Mbbl Jan-Sep 2025; Woodside share ~13 Mboe/d.
- FPSO returned to station May 2026 after dry-dock; J-tube riser defect found.
- Infill drilling expected to extend life beyond 2031, the FPSO's initial design life.
description_zh:
西北大陆架成熟油田项目，2026年因维修临时停产。
- Jadestone收购MIMI所持16.67%（2024年交割），持股增至33.33%，同时承接FPSO及弃置责任。
- 2025年1至9月原油产量147.4万桶，伍德赛德权益约1.3万桶油当量/日。
- 2026年5月FPSO结束坞修回到油田，检查发现立管J型管缺陷。
- 加密井有望将开采期延至2031年（FPSO初始设计寿命）以后。
latest_update_en: 2026-07: Restart targeted around end Q3 2026 after J-tube riser repairs, subject to regulator approval.
latest_update_zh: 2026年7月：J型管立管修复后目标约2026年三季度末复产，待监管批准。

name: Enfield (Nganhurra FPSO)
nature_en: Former oil field; infrastructure removed
nature_zh: 已退役油田，设施已回收
description_en:
Retired oil field off Exmouth.
- Infrastructure recovery completed in 2025.
- Final seabed survey completed H1 2026; results to regulator in H2 2026.
- Woodside portfolio decommissioning spend ~US$274m in H1 2026.
description_zh:
Exmouth外海已退役油田。
- 2025年完成设施回收。
- 2026年上半年完成最终海床调查，结果于2026年下半年提交监管机构。
- 2026年上半年伍德赛德全组合弃置支出约2.74亿美元。
latest_update_en: 2026-H1: Final seabed survey completed.
latest_update_zh: 2026年上半年：完成最终海床调查。

name: Stybarrow
nature_en: Former oil field (ex-BHP); subsea removal under way
nature_zh: 已停产油田（原属必和必拓），海底设施拆除中
description_en:
Legacy BHP oil field in active decommissioning.
- Xmas trees removed from all 10 wells by Q3 2025; four wellheads removed.
- More than 18 km of flexible flowlines and umbilicals removed by Q1 2026.
- Work resumed under revised NOPSEMA General Direction requirements.
description_zh:
原必和必拓油田，弃置作业进行中。
- 截至2025年三季度10口井采油树全部拆除，4个井口已移除。
- 截至2026年一季度回收柔性管线与脐带缆逾18公里。
- 依据修订后的NOPSEMA总体指令恢复作业。
latest_update_en: 2026-H1: >18 km of flowlines and umbilicals removed.
latest_update_zh: 2026年上半年：已回收管线及脐带缆逾18公里。

name: Griffin
nature_en: Former oil and gas field (ex-BHP); subsea removal under way
nature_zh: 已停产油气田（原属必和必拓），海底设施拆除中
description_en:
Legacy BHP field in decommissioning.
- Mid-depth buoy chain removal completed 2025.
- ~8 km of flexible flowlines removed by Q1 2026.
- Echo Yodel umbilical removal preparations began Q4 2025.
description_zh:
原必和必拓油气田，处于弃置阶段。
- 2025年完成中层浮筒锚链拆除。
- 截至2026年一季度回收柔性管线约8公里。
- 2025年四季度开始准备拆除Echo Yodel脐带缆。
latest_update_en: 2026-H1: ~8 km of flexible flowlines removed.
latest_update_zh: 2026年上半年：已回收柔性管线约8公里。

name: Mutineer-Exeter-Fletcher-Finucane (MEFF)
nature_en: Former oil fields; decommissioning
nature_zh: 已停产油田，弃置中
description_en:
Depleted oil fields north of Dampier.
- Decommissioning environment plan accepted by NOPSEMA Oct 2024.
- Decommissioning work commenced Q2 2026.
- Part of Santos' WA decommissioning program with Ningaloo Vision and Varanus Island State-waters wells (offshore execution proposed 2027).
description_zh:
Dampier以北已枯竭油田。
- 2024年10月NOPSEMA接受弃置环境计划。
- 2026年二季度开始弃置作业。
- 属桑托斯西澳弃置计划的一部分，同期还有Ningaloo Vision及Varanus岛州水域井（海上作业拟2027年实施）。
latest_update_en: 2026-Q2: Decommissioning commenced.
latest_update_zh: 2026年二季度：弃置作业启动。

name: Montara (Montara, Skua, Swift, Swallow)
nature_en: Oil: Montara field group via Montara Venture FPSO
nature_zh: 原油：Montara油田群经Montara Venture FPSO生产
description_en:
Timor Sea oil asset and Jadestone's largest Australian production.
- Producing through Montara Venture FPSO (Skua is a subsea tie-back in the field group).
- May 2026: re-injection compressor upgrade completed.
- Upgrade expected to cut ~110 kt CO2e a year (~45% of 2026 forecast emissions) and add ~300 bbl/d.
- Jadestone group output 15,281 boe/d in H1 2026.
description_zh:
帝汶海油田资产，为Jadestone在澳最大产量来源。
- 经Montara Venture FPSO生产（Skua为同一油田群的海底回接）。
- 2026年5月完成回注压缩机升级。
- 预计每年减排约11万吨CO2当量（约占2026年预测排放45%），增产约300桶/日。
- 2026年上半年Jadestone集团产量15281桶油当量/日。
latest_update_en: 2026-05: Re-injection compressor upgrade executed on Montara FPSO.
latest_update_zh: 2026年5月：Montara FPSO完成回注压缩机升级。

name: Stag
nature_en: Oil: Stag platform with export via CALM buoy
nature_zh: 原油：Stag平台，经CALM浮筒外输
description_en:
Mature oil field shut in after cyclone damage.
- Shut in 23 Mar 2026 ahead of Cyclone Narelle (~18 m waves); CALM buoy damaged.
- Replacement CALM buoy preferred; deployment expected Q1 2027.
- Restart expected Q2 2027; business interruption insurance to May 2027.
- ~US$11m capex and ~US$6m opex tied to the damage, expected to be insured.
description_zh:
成熟油田，遭气旋损坏后停产。
- 2026年3月23日Narelle气旋来临前关井（浪高约18米），CALM浮筒受损。
- 拟更换CALM浮筒，预计2027年一季度部署。
- 预计2027年二季度复产，营业中断保险覆盖至2027年5月。
- 损失相关资本支出约1100万美元、运营支出约600万美元，预计由保险赔付。
latest_update_en: 2026-07: Restart deferred to Q2 2027 pending replacement CALM buoy.
latest_update_zh: 2026年7月：复产推迟至2027年二季度，待更换CALM浮筒。

name: Wandoo
nature_en: Oil: Wandoo platform field
nature_zh: 原油：Wandoo平台油田
description_en:
Vermilion's only Australian asset.
- 100% working interest offshore WA.
- Oil sold at Brent-indexed premium pricing.
- Vermilion does not disclose a separate Wandoo production figure on its operations page.
description_zh:
Vermilion在澳唯一资产。
- 持有西澳海上油田100%工作权益。
- 原油按布伦特挂钩定价，享溢价。
- Vermilion业务页面未单独披露Wandoo产量。
latest_update_en: No dated 2025-26 event verified beyond continued operation.
latest_update_zh: 除持续生产外，未核实到2025至2026年具体事件。

name: Cliff Head
nature_en: Former oil field off Dongara; planned conversion to CO2 storage (Mid West Clean Energy Project)
nature_zh: Dongara外海已停产油田，拟改造为CO2封存（Mid West清洁能源项目）
owners: Pilot Energy (State-waters assets 100%; Commonwealth JV interests pending NOPTA approval to reach 100%)
capacity_note: Storage 2C resource for WA-31-L raised to 72.2 Mt (Dec 2024)
description_en:
Small oil field now being repurposed for carbon storage.
- Oil production ceased; hydrocarbons removed from facilities by Dec 2024 quarter.
- Pilot acquired Triangle's interests; first stage completed 24 Jun 2025.
- WA-31-L storage 2C resource 72.2 Mt; DoSF amendment and EPBC referral planned Q1 2026.
- No FID; up to 60% sell-down being sought.
description_zh:
小型油田，正改造为碳封存设施。
- 已停产，2024年四季度完成设施脱烃。
- Pilot收购Triangle权益，第一阶段于2025年6月24日交割。
- WA-31-L封存2C资源7220万吨，计划2026年一季度提交封存地层申报修订及EPBC申报。
- 尚未FID，正寻求出售最多60%权益。
latest_update_en: 2025-12: Pilot reported non-production phase; regulatory lodgements for CCS planned Q1 2026.
latest_update_zh: 2025年12月：Pilot披露处于非生产阶段，CCS监管申报计划于2026年一季度提交。

name: Northern Endeavour FPSO / Laminaria-Corallina
nature_en: Former oil fields; Commonwealth-led decommissioning
nature_zh: 已停产油田，联邦政府主导弃置
location_note: Laminaria-Corallina fields (approximate), ~550 km NW of Darwin
owners: Commonwealth of Australia (after 2019 collapse of titleholder); costs recovered via Laminaria and Corallina Decommissioning Cost Recovery Levy
description_en:
Australia's first government-led offshore decommissioning after the titleholder's insolvency.
- Phase 1: FPSO disconnection and disposal (Petrofac lead contractor).
- Phase 2: P&A of nine subsea wells, awarded to Zenith Energy Australia (Aug 2026).
- Phase 3: subsea infrastructure removal and field remediation; Xodus appointed for environmental approvals (Aug 2026).
- Funded by an industry levy rather than taxpayers.
description_zh:
运营商破产后澳大利亚首个由政府主导的海上弃置项目。
- 第一阶段：FPSO解脱与处置，Petrofac为总承包商。
- 第二阶段：9口海底井永久封堵，2026年8月授予Zenith Energy Australia。
- 第三阶段：拆除海底设施并修复油田，2026年8月Xodus中标环保审批工作。
- 费用由行业征费承担，不由纳税人负担。
latest_update_en: 2026-08: Zenith Energy Australia awarded Phase 2 P&A of nine wells; offshore execution subject to Commonwealth approval.
latest_update_zh: 2026年8月：Zenith Energy Australia中标第二阶段9口井封堵，海上实施待联邦批准。

name: Bayu-Undan
nature_en: Former gas-condensate field that supplied Darwin LNG; proposed CCS conversion
nature_zh: 原供气达尔文LNG的凝析气田，拟改造为CCS
basin_region: Bonaparte Basin, Timor Sea (former JPDA, now Timor-Leste)
owners: Santos 36.5% (operator), SK E&S 21%, Timor GAP 16%, INPEX 9.6%, Eni 9.2%, Tokyo Timor Sea Resources 7.7%
description_en:
Depleted field in Timor-Leste waters, now proposed as a CO2 store for Barossa.
- Discovered 1995; developed by ConocoPhillips with two central processing platforms, a wellhead platform and an FSO.
- Production ceased 2025 (Timor-Leste minister: June 2025).
- Planned well suspension scope completed Dec 2025.
- CCS FEED complete; fiscal and regulatory terms with both governments still needed before FID.
description_zh:
位于东帝汶海域的枯竭气田，拟作为Barossa的CO2封存场所。
- 1995年发现，由康菲开发，配2座中央处理平台、1座井口平台及FSO。
- 2025年停产（东帝汶部长称2025年6月）。
- 2025年12月完成计划内的井暂闭作业。
- CCS FEED已完成，FID前仍需与两国政府确定财税与监管条款。
latest_update_en: 2025-12: Well suspension scope completed; CCS conversion awaiting government frameworks.
latest_update_zh: 2025年12月：完成井暂闭作业，CCS改造待两国政府框架落定。

name: Gippsland Basin Joint Venture (Bass Strait)
name_zh: Gippsland盆地合资项目（巴斯海峡）
nature_en: East coast gas and liquids: Bass Strait platforms + Longford gas plants + Long Island Point
nature_zh: 东海岸天然气及液体：巴斯海峡平台＋Longford处理厂＋Long Island Point
location_note: Central Bass Strait platforms (approximate); Longford plant onshore near Sale
owners: GBJV: Woodside 50% (operator since 1 Jul 2026), ExxonMobil Australia (Esso) 50%
description_en:
Largest single source of gas for the east coast market, operated by Woodside from 1 Jul 2026.
- Fields include Snapper, Marlin, Turrum, Tuna and Barracouta; ~200 wells, >800 km subsea pipelines.
- Longford operating since 1969; oil production at Longford ended 2024.
- Woodside equity production 8.4 MMboe in H1 2026 (down 8%).
- Four potential development wells could add up to 200 PJ, subject to FID and the domestic gas reservation scheme.
description_zh:
东海岸天然气最大单一来源，2026年7月1日起由伍德赛德运营。
- 气田包括Snapper、Marlin、Turrum、Tuna、Barracouta，约200口井，海底管道逾800公里。
- Longford处理厂1969年投运，2024年停止原油生产。
- 2026年上半年伍德赛德权益产量840万桶油当量，同比降8%。
- 4口潜在开发井可增加最多200拍焦，取决于FID及内销气保留机制。
latest_update_en: 2026-07-01: Operatorship of GBJV and KUJV transferred from ExxonMobil to Woodside.
latest_update_zh: 2026年7月1日：GBJV与KUJV运营权由埃克森美孚移交伍德赛德。

name: Kipper (Kipper Unit Joint Venture)
nature_en: East coast gas: Kipper field tied into Bass Strait infrastructure
nature_zh: 东海岸天然气：Kipper气田接入巴斯海峡设施
owners: KUJV: Woodside 32.5% (operator since 1 Jul 2026), ExxonMobil Australia (Esso) 32.5%, Mitsui 35%
description_en:
Subsea gas field feeding Longford via Bass Strait platforms.
- Kipper 1B well drilling completed Q4 2025.
- Operatorship moved to Woodside 1 Jul 2026 with the GBJV.
- KUJV equity: Woodside 32.5%, Esso 32.5%, Mitsui 35%.
description_zh:
通过巴斯海峡平台向Longford供气的海底气田。
- Kipper 1B井于2025年四季度完钻。
- 2026年7月1日随GBJV一并改由伍德赛德运营。
- KUJV权益：伍德赛德32.5%、Esso 32.5%、三井35%。
latest_update_en: 2025-Q4: Kipper 1B drilling completed.
latest_update_zh: 2025年四季度：Kipper 1B井完钻。

name: Turrum Phase 3
nature_en: Infill gas wells at Turrum/North Turrum via Marlin B
nature_zh: Turrum及North Turrum加密气井，经Marlin B平台
description_en:
Near-term east coast gas supply project.
- Five wells drilled by H1 2026.
- Marlin B topsides modifications under way.
- Gas delivery targeted H1 2027.
description_zh:
近期东海岸供气项目。
- 截至2026年上半年已钻5口井。
- Marlin B平台上部改造进行中。
- 目标2027年上半年供气。
latest_update_en: 2026-H1: All five wells drilled; first gas targeted H1 2027.
latest_update_zh: 2026年上半年：5口井全部完钻，目标2027年上半年供气。

name: Bass Strait decommissioning (Kingfish, Halibut, Cobia, Tuna, Bream)
nature_en: Retired Bass Strait oil platforms: well P&A and platform removal
nature_zh: 巴斯海峡已退役产油平台：封井及平台拆除
description_en:
One of Australia's largest decommissioning programs.
- 13 facilities at end of productive life; >200 of 421 original wells permanently sealed.
- West Kingfish and Cobia well plugging complete; rig operations started on Halibut and Tuna.
- All Campaign 1 platform P&A complete; platform removal Campaign 1 starts Q3 2027 (NOPSEMA EP accepted).
- Platforms to return to Barry Beach Marine Terminal for dismantling.
description_zh:
澳大利亚规模最大的海上弃置计划之一。
- 13座设施已到开采末期，原有421口井中逾200口已永久封堵。
- West Kingfish与Cobia平台封井完成，Halibut与Tuna平台开始钻机作业。
- 第一批平台封井全部完成，平台拆除第一批将于2027年三季度启动（NOPSEMA已接受环境计划）。
- 平台将运回Barry Beach海运码头拆解。
latest_update_en: 2026-H1: Campaign 1 P&A complete; removal from Q3 2027.
latest_update_zh: 2026年上半年：第一批封井完成，2027年三季度起拆除。

name: Sole Gas Field / Orbost Gas Processing Plant
nature_en: East coast gas: Sole subsea field + Orbost onshore plant
nature_zh: 东海岸天然气：Sole海底气田＋Orbost陆上处理厂
capacity_note: Orbost plant nameplate 68 TJ/d; stable above 70 TJ/d in H2 FY26, record 74.7 TJ/d
description_en:
Amplitude's core east coast gas asset.
- Gippsland output 24.3 PJ in FY26 (avg 66.5 TJ/d), up 7.2%.
- Orbost nameplate 68 TJ/d; record 74.7 TJ/d and 73.5 TJ/d average in Jul 2026.
- Sole-5 infill added 3.1 MMboe of 2C resources.
description_zh:
Amplitude在东海岸的核心气田资产。
- 2026财年Gippsland产量24.3拍焦（日均66.5太焦），同比增7.2%。
- Orbost铭牌产能68太焦/日，单日纪录74.7太焦，2026年7月日均73.5太焦。
- Sole-5加密井新增2C资源310万桶油当量。
latest_update_en: 2026-07: Orbost averaged 73.5 TJ/d, above nameplate.
latest_update_zh: 2026年7月：Orbost日均73.5太焦，高于铭牌产能。

name: Patricia-Baleen restart
nature_en: Restart of shut-in Gippsland gas wells via Orbost
nature_zh: Gippsland已关停气井经Orbost复产
description_en:
Low-cost restart of existing wells to add east coast gas.
- Select phase completed Aug 2026; FEED entry expected later in 2026.
- Production licence application lodged with NOPTA (conversion of retention licence).
- SGH Energy's Longtom wells retained as a backfill option.
description_zh:
利用现有气井低成本复产，增加东海岸供气。
- 2026年8月完成方案选择阶段，预计2026年内进入FEED。
- 已向NOPTA申请将保留许可证转为生产许可证。
- SGH Energy的Longtom气井作为接替选项。
latest_update_en: 2026-08: Select phase complete; FEED entry expected later 2026.
latest_update_zh: 2026年8月：方案选择阶段完成，预计2026年内进入FEED。

name: Longtom
nature_en: Shut-in Gippsland gas field
nature_zh: Gippsland已关停气田
description_en:
Stranded gas field linked by pipeline to the Patricia-Baleen system.
- Production began 2009 (Nexus Energy); SGH acquired Nexus late 2014.
- Production ceased 2015 after a control fault.
- NOPSEMA (Dec 2025) directed SGH to stop a small well leak by Mar 2026 and restore monitoring by Oct 2027.
- Being assessed as backfill for Amplitude's Patricia-Baleen restart.
description_zh:
与Patricia-Baleen系统管道相连的搁浅气田。
- 2009年投产（Nexus Energy），2014年底SGH收购Nexus。
- 2015年因控制故障停产。
- 2025年12月NOPSEMA责令SGH于2026年3月前止住小规模井漏，2027年10月前恢复连续监测。
- 正作为Amplitude Patricia-Baleen复产的接替气源评估。
latest_update_en: 2025-12: NOPSEMA direction to fix leaking well; backfill studies with Amplitude ongoing.
latest_update_zh: 2025年12月：NOPSEMA责令修复漏气井，与Amplitude的接替研究进行中。

name: Manta
nature_en: Undeveloped gas and liquids discovery near Sole
nature_zh: Sole附近未开发气及液体发现
description_en:
Undeveloped discovery held under retention leases.
- Permits VIC/RL13-15, 100% Amplitude.
- A$5.0m success fee payable on commercial production (67% probability of payment in 2032 per Amplitude's accounts).
- Former Basker-Manta-Gummy (BMG) wells decommissioning completed.
description_zh:
以保留许可证持有的未开发发现。
- 许可证VIC/RL13-15，Amplitude持100%。
- 实现商业生产时需支付500万澳元成功费（Amplitude财报按2032年支付、概率67%计提）。
- 原BMG（Basker-Manta-Gummy）井弃置已完成。
latest_update_en: No dated 2025-26 development decision found.
latest_update_zh: 未查到2025至2026年开发决策。

name: Casino-Henry-Netherby / Athena Gas Plant
nature_en: East coast gas: Otway subsea fields + Athena gas plant, Port Campbell
nature_zh: 东海岸天然气：Otway海底气田＋Port Campbell的Athena处理厂
description_en:
Mature Otway gas fields; the Athena plant is the processing host for the East Coast Supply Project.
- Licences VIC/L24 and VIC/L30.
- Output 10.3 TJe/d net to Amplitude in H1 FY25, down 8% on decline.
- Athena to receive AJA fields gas from 2028.
description_zh:
成熟的Otway气田，Athena处理厂为东海岸供气项目（ECSP）的处理设施。
- 生产许可证VIC/L24与VIC/L30。
- 2025财年上半年Amplitude净产量10.3太焦当量/日，递减致同比降8%。
- 2028年起Athena将处理AJA气田来气。
latest_update_en: 2026-09: Athena modifications included in ECSP FID scope (works 2028).
latest_update_zh: 2026年9月：Athena改造纳入ECSP的FID范围（2028年施工）。

name: East Coast Supply Project (Annie, Juliet, Artisan, Nestor)
nature_en: New Otway subsea gas fields tied back to Athena Gas Plant
nature_zh: Otway新海底气田回接至Athena处理厂
owners: Amplitude Energy 50% (operator), Mitsui 50% (Annie); Artisan 50% purchase from Beach pending
capacity_note: AJA fields up to 90 TJ/d for at least four years; Amplitude share capex A$190-210m in 2027-28; >120 PJ 2C in Annie and Artisan
description_en:
Amplitude's growth project to add Otway gas for the east coast.
- Annie production licence VIC/L37 granted May 2026.
- Elanora and Isabella wells non-commercial; Juliet-1 discovery suspended for development.
- AJA fields up to 90 TJ/d to Athena; >120 PJ 2C in Annie and Artisan.
- Foundation GSAs with EnergyAustralia and AGL for 35 PJ; first gas targeted 2028.
description_zh:
Amplitude为东海岸新增Otway气源的增长项目。
- 2026年5月获Annie生产许可证VIC/L37。
- Elanora与Isabella井无商业价值，Juliet-1发现井已暂闭待开发。
- AJA气田向Athena供气最高90太焦/日，Annie与Artisan 2C资源逾120拍焦。
- 与EnergyAustralia、AGL签订基础购气协议35拍焦，目标2028年首气。
latest_update_en: 2026-09: FID taken; Annie-2 development well and Nestor exploration well to follow with Transocean Equinox.
latest_update_zh: 2026年9月：作出FID，Transocean Equinox钻机随后钻Annie-2开发井及Nestor探井。

name: Otway Gas Project (Thylacine, Geographe, Enterprise)
nature_en: East coast gas: Otway offshore fields + Otway Gas Plant
nature_zh: 东海岸天然气：Otway海上气田＋Otway处理厂
location_note: Thylacine platform (approximate); Enterprise drilled from onshore into State waters
capacity_note: Otway Gas Plant averaged 116 TJ/d gross in Q4 FY26 and 180 TJ/d in the final week
description_en:
Beach's main east coast gas asset.
- FY26 net production 5,792 kboe; Q4 FY26 1,270 kboe (up 4%).
- Thylacine West intervention restored previously suspended Waarre reservoirs.
- Artisan-1 completed; VIC/L35 sale to Amplitude and O.G. Otway pending.
- La Bella-2 development dropped.
description_zh:
Beach在东海岸的主力气田资产。
- 2026财年净产量579.2万桶油当量，四季度127万桶油当量（环比增4%）。
- Thylacine West修井恢复此前关停的Waarre储层产量。
- Artisan-1井完钻，VIC/L35出售给Amplitude及O.G. Otway待交割。
- 放弃La Bella-2开发井。
latest_update_en: 2026-07: Otway portion of Equinox rig campaign completed; Otway Gas Plant hit 180 TJ/d.
latest_update_zh: 2026年7月：Equinox钻机Otway段作业结束，Otway处理厂日产达180太焦。

name: Otway nearshore (Enterprise East, Selje)
nature_en: Proposed two-well nearshore gas campaign to Otway Gas Plant
nature_zh: 拟议的两口近岸气井，输往Otway处理厂
capacity_note: Capex ~A$175-200m gross; target all-in cost ~A$5/GJ on success
description_en:
Low-cost nearshore gas option for Beach's Otway system.
- Two wells: Enterprise East and Selje.
- Capex ~A$175-200m gross; target development cost ~A$5/GJ.
- FID targeted H2 FY27.
description_zh:
Beach Otway系统的低成本近岸气源。
- 两口井：Enterprise East与Selje。
- 毛投资约1.75亿至2亿澳元，目标开发成本约5澳元/吉焦。
- 目标2027财年下半年FID。
latest_update_en: 2026-07: Under assessment; FID targeted H2 FY27.
latest_update_zh: 2026年7月：评估中，目标2027财年下半年FID。

name: BassGas (Yolla)
nature_en: East coast gas: Yolla platform in Bass Basin + Lang Lang gas plant
nature_zh: 东海岸天然气：Bass盆地Yolla平台＋Lang Lang处理厂
owners: Beach Energy (operator, majority interest; partner equity not re-verified)
capacity_note: Lang Lang Gas Plant averaged 11 TJ/d in Q4 FY26
description_en:
Small Bass Strait gas asset landing gas in Victoria.
- FY26 output 1,452 kboe net; Q4 down 32% on compressor downtime.
- New compressor targeted late FY27.
- Trefoil-1 plugged and abandoned; Yolla-1 final P&A under way.
description_zh:
巴斯海峡小型气田，气体在维州上岸。
- 2026财年净产量145.2万桶油当量，四季度因压缩机停机环比降32%。
- 新压缩机目标2027财年末安装。
- Trefoil-1井已封堵弃置，Yolla-1井最终封堵进行中。
latest_update_en: 2026-07: Yolla-1 final P&A under way; Lang Lang averaging 11 TJ/d.
latest_update_zh: 2026年7月：Yolla-1井最终封堵进行中，Lang Lang日均11太焦。

name: Minerva
nature_en: Former Otway gas field; decommissioning
nature_zh: 已停产Otway气田，弃置中
description_en:
Shut-in Otway gas field inherited from BHP.
- Licence VIC/L22 shut in.
- Environment plan consultation completed for removing remaining infrastructure (H1 2026).
- Amplitude Energy holds a 10% non-operated interest.
description_zh:
原必和必拓旗下的Otway关停气田。
- 生产许可证VIC/L22已关停。
- 2026年上半年完成剩余设施拆除的环境计划咨询。
- Amplitude Energy持有10%非运营权益。
latest_update_en: 2026-H1: EP consultation for remaining infrastructure removal completed.
latest_update_zh: 2026年上半年：剩余设施拆除环境计划咨询完成。

name: ConocoPhillips Otway Exploration Program
nature_en: Deepwater gas exploration offshore Victoria/Tasmania
nature_zh: 维州及塔州外海深水天然气勘探
location_note: Representative point for the drilling area (approximate)
owners: ConocoPhillips Australia (operator); partners not named in source
description_en:
Phase one of a multi-well Otway exploration program.
- Two wells: Essington-1 and Charlemont-1.
- Essington-1: 62.6 m gross hydrocarbon column in Waarre A; 33.2 m best estimate in Waarre C.
- Charlemont-1: wireline logs indicated gas in Waarre A and C.
- Commerciality not determined; both wells to be plugged and abandoned.
description_zh:
Otway多井勘探计划第一阶段。
- 两口井：Essington-1与Charlemont-1。
- Essington-1：Waarre A层油气柱毛厚62.6米，Waarre C层最佳估计33.2米。
- Charlemont-1：电缆测井显示Waarre A、C层含气。
- 商业性未确定，两井均将封堵弃置。
latest_update_en: 2026-01: Phase one completed; no development decision; further drilling undecided.
latest_update_zh: 2026年1月：第一阶段完成，尚无开发决定，后续钻探未定。

name: Otway Basin 2025 offshore acreage release
nature_en: New Commonwealth and Victorian State-waters exploration areas
nature_zh: 联邦及维州州水域新勘探区块
owners: Government acreage release; no titleholder yet
description_en:
New acreage to support east coast gas supply.
- Commonwealth released five Otway Basin areas on 11 Dec 2025; bids closed 30 Jun 2026.
- Victoria offered VIC/25-1 (offshore Otway, State waters) and onshore Gippsland VIC/25-2; bids closed 11 Feb 2026.
- Victorian applications under assessment; no Gippsland offshore area in either release.
description_zh:
为东海岸供气新增勘探面积。
- 2025年12月11日联邦政府推出5个Otway盆地区块，2026年6月30日截标。
- 维州推出VIC/25-1（Otway州水域）及陆上Gippsland区块VIC/25-2，2026年2月11日截标。
- 维州申请评审中；两轮招标均无Gippsland海上区块。
latest_update_en: 2026-06: Commonwealth bids closed 30 Jun 2026; awards pending.
latest_update_zh: 2026年6月：联邦区块于2026年6月30日截标，待授标。

name: Dorado
nature_en: Undeveloped oil and gas discovery; FPSO development deferred
nature_zh: 未开发油气发现，FPSO开发方案已推迟
location_note: Dorado field (approximate), ~160 km north of Port Hedland
capacity_note: Carnarvon estimate 162 MMbbl light oil and condensate; earlier concept cost >US$3bn
description_en:
Largest North West Shelf oil discovery in decades, shelved by Santos.
- Discovered 2018.
- Jan 2025: Santos deferred FPSO purchase and FEED, pushing back a 2025 FID; concept to be revisited.
- Resource estimated by Carnarvon at 162 MMbbl liquids plus gas.
- Bedout multi-well exploration and appraisal planned from Q1 2027.
description_zh:
北部大陆架数十年来最大的石油发现，已被桑托斯搁置。
- 2018年发现。
- 2025年1月桑托斯暂停采购FPSO及FEED，原定2025年FID推迟，开发方案将重新评估。
- Carnarvon估算液体资源1.62亿桶，另有天然气。
- Bedout多井勘探评价计划于2027年一季度开始。
latest_update_en: 2026-Q2: Bedout multi-well program EP under NOPSEMA assessment; start planned Q1 2027.
latest_update_zh: 2026年二季度：Bedout多井计划环境计划在NOPSEMA审查中，计划2027年一季度开钻。

name: Bedout Basin exploration and appraisal
nature_en: Multi-well exploration and appraisal around Dorado
nature_zh: Dorado周边多井勘探评价
owners: Santos (operator); partners incl. Carnarvon Energy and CPC on Dorado-area permits
description_en:
Santos' follow-up program to mature Bedout resources.
- Bedout multi-well E&A: EP under NOPSEMA assessment, start Q1 2027.
- Bedout East multi-well E&A: EP to be submitted Q4 2026, start Q1 2027.
- Keraudren Phase 3 seismic survey scheduled 2028.
description_zh:
桑托斯推进Bedout资源成熟度的后续计划。
- Bedout多井勘探评价：环境计划在NOPSEMA审查中，2027年一季度开始。
- Bedout东部多井勘探评价：环境计划2026年四季度提交，2027年一季度开始。
- Keraudren三期地震采集计划2028年实施。
latest_update_en: 2026-Q2: Two multi-well programs planned to start Q1 2027.
latest_update_zh: 2026年二季度：两个多井计划拟于2027年一季度开始。

name: Beehive
nature_en: Large carbonate oil/gas prospect in the Joseph Bonaparte Gulf
nature_zh: Joseph Bonaparte海湾大型碳酸盐岩油气圈闭
location_note: Activity area in WA-488-P (approximate), ~77 km off WA coast
description_en:
Frontier prospect acquired by EOG.
- Permit WA-488-P; activity area ~45 km2.
- Accepted EP covers up to three exploration/appraisal wells between 1 Jan 2025 and 31 Dec 2029.
- Each well expected to take 55-150 days.
description_zh:
EOG收购的前沿勘探圈闭。
- 许可证WA-488-P，作业区约45平方公里。
- 环境计划允许2025年1月1日至2029年12月31日间钻最多3口勘探或评价井。
- 单井作业预计55至150天。
latest_update_en: 2025-29: Multi-well drilling window open; 2025-26 well results not verified.
latest_update_zh: 2025至2029年：多井钻探窗口期；2025至2026年钻井结果未核实。

name: Petrel and Tern
nature_en: Undeveloped gas fields in the Bonaparte Gulf targeted for NT domestic gas
nature_zh: Bonaparte海湾未开发气田，目标供应北领地内销
owners: Eni Australia (acquired Santos' 42.71% of Petrel and 100% of Tern, completed Dec 2025); Petrel partner equity not re-verified
capacity_note: Petrel estimated ~970 bcf gas (NS Energy)
description_en:
Long-discovered gas fields now consolidated under Eni.
- Dec 2025: Santos completed sale of its 42.71% Petrel and 100% Tern interests to Eni Australia.
- Santos cited unlocking future domestic gas supply via existing partners.
- No development concept announced.
description_zh:
早年发现的气田，现由埃尼整合持有。
- 2025年12月桑托斯完成向埃尼澳大利亚出售Petrel 42.71%及Tern 100%权益。
- 桑托斯称交易有助于现有合作方开发，为内销市场提供气源。
- 尚未公布开发方案。
latest_update_en: 2025-12: Sale to Eni Australia completed.
latest_update_zh: 2025年12月：向埃尼澳大利亚出售完成。

name: Star of the South
name_zh: Star of the South（南方之星）海上风电项目
nature_en: Fixed-bottom offshore wind farm, Gippsland declared area Part 1
nature_zh: 固定式海上风电场，吉普斯兰宣布海域第1部分
location_note: approximate centre of 586 km² licence area, 10–40 km off Port Albert–Woodside Beach
owners: Southerly Ten (backed by Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners; Cbus and co-founders reported as investors)
capacity_note: up to 2.2 GW; up to 147 turbines, max tip height 350 m
description_en:
Australia's most advanced offshore wind project, in development since 2017.
- Exploration licence 2019; feasibility licence 2024; Major Project Status renewed Nov 2025 for 3 years.
- 586 km² licence area 10–40 km offshore; up to 147 turbines, up to 5 offshore substations and 8 export cables.
- ~30 km onshore cable to proposed VicGrid hub at Giffard; 120 ha landfall site bought near Reeves Beach.
- Developer targets first power by 2032; construction could start ~2030 subject to approvals.
description_zh:
澳洲进度最快的海上风电项目，2017年启动开发。
- 2019年获勘探许可，2024年获可行性许可证；2025年11月联邦重大项目地位续期3年。
- 许可海域586平方公里，离岸10–40公里；最多147台风机、5座海上升压站、8条送出海缆。
- 陆上电缆约30公里，接入VicGrid拟建Giffard枢纽；已在Reeves Beach附近购地120公顷用于登陆点。
- 开发商目标2032年首次发电；若审批顺利，约2030年开工。
latest_update_en: 2026-05: Draft Commonwealth EIS and Victorian EES released for public comment (to 29 Jun 2026); first offshore wind EES in Australia.
latest_update_zh: 2026年5月：发布联邦EIS与维州EES草案并公示至2026年6月29日，为澳洲首份海上风电EES。

name: Kut-Wut Brataualung Offshore Wind
name_zh: Kut-Wut Brataualung 海上风电项目
nature_en: Offshore wind farm, Gippsland declared area Part 3 (south of Wilsons Promontory)
nature_zh: 海上风电场，吉普斯兰宣布海域第3部分（威尔逊岬以南）
location_note: approximate; licence area ~45 km from southern tip of Wilsons Promontory
capacity_note: proposed 2.2 GW
description_en:
Southerly Ten's second Gippsland project.
- Feasibility licence granted May 2024 over 689 km² in Part 3 of the Gippsland area.
- Located ~45 km offshore, south of Wilsons Promontory.
- Proposed capacity 2.2 GW.
- Listed by the Victorian Government (Aug 2026) as one of 9 active Gippsland licence holders.
description_zh:
Southerly Ten旗下第二个吉普斯兰项目。
- 2024年5月获可行性许可证，许可海域689平方公里，位于吉普斯兰宣布海域第3部分。
- 离岸约45公里，位于威尔逊岬以南。
- 拟建装机2.2吉瓦。
- 维州政府2026年8月名单显示其为吉普斯兰9个有效许可证项目之一。
latest_update_en: 2026-08: Listed as an active feasibility licence holder in Victoria's offshore wind project register.
latest_update_zh: 2026年8月：列入维州海上风电项目名单，可行性许可证有效。

name: Blue Mackerel Offshore Wind
name_zh: Blue Mackerel 海上风电项目
nature_en: Fixed-bottom offshore wind farm, Gippsland Part 1, ~10 km offshore
nature_zh: 固定式海上风电场，吉普斯兰第1部分，离岸约10公里
location_note: approximate; ~10 km off Gippsland coast, east of Wilsons Promontory
owners: JERA Nex bp (JERA / bp offshore wind JV) 100%
capacity_note: 1 GW; up to 70 turbines
description_en:
JERA Nex bp's Gippsland project, among the closest to shore in the zone.
- Feasibility licence (7-year) granted April 2024; feasibility management plan approved by OIR early 2025.
- 1 GW from up to 70 turbines, ~10 km offshore.
- Major Project Status granted Dec 2025.
- Construction targeted 2029, operation 2032 (developer timeline).
description_zh:
JERA Nex bp在吉普斯兰的项目，离岸距离为海域内最近之一。
- 2024年4月获7年期可行性许可证；2025年初海上基础设施监管机构（OIR）批准可行性阶段管理计划。
- 装机1吉瓦，最多70台风机，离岸约10公里。
- 2025年12月获联邦重大项目地位。
- 开发商计划2029年开工、2032年投运。
latest_update_en: 2026-03: Commonwealth confirmed full EIS assessment under the EPBC Act (EIS documents lodged Feb 2026).
latest_update_zh: 2026年3月：联邦确认按EPBC法开展完整EIS评估（2026年2月已提交EIS文件）。

name: Gippsland 1 (Gippsland 01)
nature_en: Fixed-bottom offshore wind farm, Gippsland Part 2, 56–100 km offshore
nature_zh: 固定式海上风电场，吉普斯兰第2部分，离岸56–100公里
location_note: approximate; Ørsted licence areas 56–100 km offshore
capacity_note: 2.8 GW; up to 200 turbines; may be built in phases
description_en:
Ørsted's lead Australian project.
- Feasibility licence granted April 2024; 700 km² area 56–100 km offshore.
- 2.8 GW from up to 200 turbines; EPBC application allows phased build.
- Ørsted lodged EPBC environmental documents in Feb 2026.
- No first-power date published.
description_zh:
沃旭能源（Ørsted）在澳洲的首要项目。
- 2024年4月获可行性许可证；许可海域700平方公里，离岸56–100公里。
- 装机2.8吉瓦，最多200台风机；EPBC申请允许分期建设。
- 2026年2月提交EPBC环境评估文件。
- 未公布首次发电时间。
latest_update_en: 2026-02: EPBC Act environmental documents lodged and published for comment. A reported 'pause' of Gippsland 1 could not be verified as at Oct 2026.
latest_update_zh: 2026年2月：按EPBC法提交环境文件并公示。截至2026年10月，未能核实有关Gippsland 1“暂停”的报道。

name: Gippsland 2 (Gippsland 02)
nature_en: Offshore wind farm, Gippsland Part 2, adjacent to Gippsland 1
nature_zh: 海上风电场，吉普斯兰第2部分，毗邻Gippsland 1
capacity_note: 2 GW proposed
description_en:
Ørsted's second Gippsland licence.
- Feasibility licence awarded 2024 after First Nations consultation.
- 2 GW proposed, ~60 km offshore in Part 2.
- Ørsted's Gippsland 1 and 2 sites together sit 56–100 km offshore.
- Listed as active by the Victorian Government (Aug 2026).
description_zh:
沃旭能源在吉普斯兰的第二张许可证。
- 2024年完成原住民磋商后获可行性许可证。
- 拟建2吉瓦，位于第2部分，离岸约60公里。
- Gippsland 1、2两块海域合计离岸56–100公里。
- 维州政府2026年8月名单显示仍有效。
latest_update_en: 2026-08: Listed as active feasibility licence holder; no EPBC referral reported (Gippsland 1 progressing first).
latest_update_zh: 2026年8月：列为有效可行性许可证项目；未见EPBC申报（Gippsland 1先行）。

name: Aurora Green Offshore Wind
name_zh: Aurora Green 海上风电项目
nature_en: Fixed-bottom offshore wind farm, Gippsland Part 1, 25 km+ offshore
nature_zh: 固定式海上风电场，吉普斯兰第1部分，离岸25公里以上
location_note: approximate; 25 km+ off coast between Seaspray and Woodside Beach
capacity_note: up to 3 GW; Phase 1 timeline published
description_en:
Iberdrola's Gippsland project, the largest licensed capacity in the zone.
- Feasibility licence awarded July 2024.
- Up to 3 GW, 25 km+ offshore between Seaspray and Woodside Beach.
- Developer timeline: feasibility/approvals 2025–2029, Phase 1 construction 2029–2032, operation from 2032.
- EPBC referral for geotechnical/geophysical surveys ruled 'not a controlled action'.
description_zh:
伊维尔德罗拉（Iberdrola）吉普斯兰项目，海域内许可装机最大。
- 2024年7月获可行性许可证。
- 装机最高3吉瓦，位于Seaspray至Woodside Beach之间，离岸25公里以上。
- 开发商时间表：2025–2029年可研与审批，2029–2032年一期建设，2032年起运营。
- 岩土与地球物理勘察的EPBC申报获“非受控行动”认定。
latest_update_en: 2026-08: Community update; Iberdrola awaiting final Victorian auction documents, bid participation not confirmed.
latest_update_zh: 2026年8月：发布社区通报；等待维州招标正式文件，是否投标未确认。

name: Great Eastern Offshore Wind
name_zh: Great Eastern 海上风电项目
nature_en: Fixed-bottom offshore wind farm, Gippsland Part 1, behind Star of the South
nature_zh: 固定式海上风电场，吉普斯兰第1部分，位于Star of the South外侧
owners: Corio Generation (Macquarie); licence held within Macquarie after Corio disbanded
capacity_note: 2.5 GW proposed
description_en:
Corio's Gippsland project, now dormant.
- Feasibility licence granted 2024; 2.5 GW proposed ~25 km offshore.
- Corio was disbanded in 2025 after Macquarie failed to sell it; staff let go.
- Licence and A$16m Victorian grant funding sit inside Macquarie.
- Still listed by Victoria as an active licence holder (Aug 2026).
description_zh:
Corio（麦格理旗下）吉普斯兰项目，目前处于停滞状态。
- 2024年获可行性许可证；拟建2.5吉瓦，离岸约25公里。
- 麦格理出售Corio未果，2025年解散该平台并裁撤员工。
- 许可证及1600万澳元维州补助留存于麦格理体内。
- 维州政府2026年8月名单仍列为有效许可证项目。
latest_update_en: 2026-08: RenewEconomy reports no public activity for some time and that it is unclear whether the project is live.
latest_update_zh: 2026年8月：RenewEconomy报道项目长期无公开活动，是否仍在推进不明。

name: Navigator North Offshore Wind
name_zh: Navigator North 海上风电项目
nature_en: Offshore wind farm, Gippsland Part 1, ~34 km offshore
nature_zh: 海上风电场，吉普斯兰第1部分，离岸约34公里
location_note: approximate; ~34 km from shore, 700 km² licence area
capacity_note: 1.5 GW; ~110 turbines
description_en:
Origin–RES joint venture project, on hold since Sept 2025.
- Feasibility licence awarded July 2024 over 700 km², ~34 km offshore.
- 1.5 GW from ~110 turbines; reported value ~A$8bn.
- Sept 2025: put on hold; JV said it cannot meet the 2032 delivery timeline of Victoria's first auction.
- JV says it will keep the licence and target 2035/2040 auction rounds.
description_zh:
Origin与RES合资项目，2025年9月起搁置。
- 2024年7月获可行性许可证，许可海域700平方公里，离岸约34公里。
- 装机1.5吉瓦，约110台风机；媒体报道投资约80亿澳元。
- 2025年9月宣布搁置，原因是无法满足维州首轮招标2032年交付要求。
- 合资方表示保留许可证，瞄准2035年、2040年后续招标轮次。
latest_update_en: 2025-09: Project put on hold; will not bid in Victoria's first (2032-delivery) auction.
latest_update_zh: 2025年9月：项目搁置，不参与维州首轮（2032年交付）招标。

name: High Sea Wind
name_zh: High Sea Wind 海上风电项目
nature_en: Offshore wind farm, Gippsland Part 2, ~60 km off Seaspray
nature_zh: 海上风电场，吉普斯兰第2部分，距Seaspray约60公里
capacity_note: ~1.3 GW (1.28 GW in earlier filings); 150 km² licence area
description_en:
Ocean Winds' Gippsland project.
- Feasibility licence granted 2024; 150 km² licence area in Part 2.
- ~1.3 GW expected (1.28 GW in early filings).
- Ocean Winds is a 50:50 EDPR–Engie JV; also holds Westward Wind (WA).
- Geophysical survey campaign under way (Mar 2026).
description_zh:
Ocean Winds吉普斯兰项目。
- 2024年获可行性许可证；许可海域150平方公里，位于第2部分。
- 预计装机约1.3吉瓦（早期文件为1.28吉瓦）。
- Ocean Winds为葡电新能源（EDPR）与Engie各占50%的合资公司，另持有西澳Westward Wind项目。
- 2026年3月开展地球物理勘察。
latest_update_en: 2026-03: Geophysical survey campaign started off Seaspray.
latest_update_zh: 2026年3月：在Seaspray外海启动地球物理勘察。

name: Gippsland Dawn
name_zh: Gippsland Dawn 海上风电项目
nature_en: Floating offshore wind farm (withdrawn), Gippsland Part 1
nature_zh: 漂浮式海上风电场（已撤出），吉普斯兰第1部分
location_note: approximate; 10–43 km offshore between Woodside Beach and Seaspray
capacity_note: 2.1 GW per ESD News; Windtech reported 2.5 GW
description_en:
BlueFloat's Gippsland project, abandoned in 2025.
- Held feasibility licence FL-07 and Major Project Status.
- Proposed ~2.1 GW, 10–43 km offshore.
- July 2025: BlueFloat ended all Australian offshore wind work as parent Quantum Capital exited the sector.
- Licence surrendered 14 July 2025.
description_zh:
BlueFloat吉普斯兰项目，2025年放弃。
- 曾持有可行性许可证FL-07及联邦重大项目地位。
- 拟建约2.1吉瓦，离岸10–43公里。
- 2025年7月母公司Quantum Capital退出海上风电，BlueFloat终止全部澳洲项目。
- 2025年7月14日交还许可证。
latest_update_en: 2025-07-14: Feasibility licence FL-07 surrendered.
latest_update_zh: 2025年7月14日：交还可行性许可证FL-07。

name: Kent Offshore Wind
nature_en: Offshore wind farm (withdrawn), Gippsland area near Kent Group islands
nature_zh: 海上风电场（已撤出），吉普斯兰海域Kent群岛附近
location_note: approximate; Bass Strait near Kent Group islands
capacity_note: ~2 GW as reported at cancellation
description_en:
RWE's Gippsland project, ceased in Oct 2025.
- Held feasibility licence FL-08 from 2024.
- ~2 GW proposed in Bass Strait near the Kent Group islands.
- RWE cited cost pressures plus regulatory and auction uncertainty.
- Licence surrendered 10 Oct 2025.
description_zh:
莱茵集团（RWE）吉普斯兰项目，2025年10月终止。
- 2024年起持有可行性许可证FL-08。
- 拟建约2吉瓦，位于巴斯海峡Kent群岛附近。
- RWE称成本上升，监管及招标时间不确定。
- 2025年10月10日交还许可证。
latest_update_en: 2025-10-10: Feasibility licence FL-08 surrendered.
latest_update_zh: 2025年10月10日：交还可行性许可证FL-08。

name: Gippsland Skies
name_zh: Gippsland Skies 海上风电项目
nature_en: Fixed-bottom offshore wind farm (withdrawn), Gippsland
nature_zh: 固定式海上风电场（已撤出），吉普斯兰
location_note: approximate representative point in Gippsland area
owners: Mainstream Renewable Power, Reventus Power, DIRECT Infrastructure, AGL Energy (20%)
capacity_note: 2.5 GW fixed-bottom proposal
description_en:
AGL-backed consortium project, abandoned Dec 2025.
- Held feasibility licence FL-03, awarded May 2024.
- 2.5 GW fixed-bottom proposal; AGL held 20%.
- Dec 2025: JV discontinued studies; AGL redirected capital to batteries and onshore firming.
- Licence surrendered 5 Jan 2026; third Gippsland exit in 2025.
description_zh:
AGL参股联合体项目，2025年12月放弃。
- 2024年5月获可行性许可证FL-03。
- 拟建2.5吉瓦固定式风电；AGL持股20%。
- 2025年12月合资方终止可研；AGL将资本转向储能电池及陆上调峰项目。
- 2026年1月5日交还许可证；为2025年吉普斯兰第三个退出项目。
latest_update_en: 2026-01-05: Feasibility licence FL-03 surrendered.
latest_update_zh: 2026年1月5日：交还可行性许可证FL-03。

name: Spinifex Offshore Wind
nature_en: Offshore wind farm, Southern Ocean declared area off Warrnambool–Port Fairy
nature_zh: 海上风电场，南大洋宣布海域（Warrnambool–Port Fairy外海）
owners: Alinta Energy; JERA Nex (Parkwind) partner from Apr 2024
capacity_note: 1.2 GW, 50–75 turbines (Victoria lists '1 GW+')
description_en:
Only licensed project in the Southern Ocean area.
- Feasibility licence granted Feb 2025 to Alinta Energy; licence covers about one third of the 1,030 km² declared area.
- 1.2 GW from 50–75 turbines; reported cost A$4bn.
- JERA Nex (Parkwind) joined as partner in April 2024.
- Positioned to supply Portland aluminium smelter via existing transmission.
description_zh:
南大洋宣布海域唯一获许可项目。
- 2025年2月Alinta Energy获可行性许可证，许可海域约占1030平方公里宣布海域的三分之一。
- 装机1.2吉瓦，50–75台风机；媒体报道投资40亿澳元。
- 2024年4月JERA Nex（Parkwind）入股。
- 可借现有输电线路向Portland铝冶炼厂供电。
latest_update_en: 2026-08: Southern Ocean projects eligible for Victoria's first offshore wind auction (RFP opened 26 Aug 2026).
latest_update_zh: 2026年8月：南大洋海域项目可参与维州首轮海上风电招标（2026年8月26日开启RFP）。

name: Southern Winds Offshore Wind
name_zh: Southern Winds 海上风电项目
nature_en: Offshore wind proposal off Portland/Port MacDonnell (abandoned)
nature_zh: Portland/Port MacDonnell外海风电项目（已放弃）
basin_region: Southern Ocean (SA–VIC border, outside final declared area)
capacity_note: 1.2 GW per GEM
description_en:
BlueFloat/Energy Estate proposal in the western Southern Ocean.
- 1.2 GW proposal, 50:50 BlueFloat and Energy Estate.
- Site off Port MacDonnell (SA) lay in the original proposed Southern Ocean area, cut from the final 1,030 km² declaration.
- No feasibility licence granted.
- Abandoned when BlueFloat exited Australia in July 2025.
description_zh:
BlueFloat与Energy Estate在南大洋西段的项目。
- 拟建1.2吉瓦，双方各占50%。
- 位于南澳Port MacDonnell外海，原属南大洋拟议海域，最终1030平方公里宣布范围未纳入。
- 未获可行性许可证。
- 2025年7月BlueFloat退出澳洲后放弃。
latest_update_en: 2025-07: Cancelled with BlueFloat's exit from Australian offshore wind.
latest_update_zh: 2025年7月：随BlueFloat退出澳洲海上风电而取消。

name: Novocastrian Offshore Wind
nature_en: Floating offshore wind farm, Hunter declared area (licence declined)
nature_zh: 漂浮式海上风电场，猎人谷宣布海域（许可证被拒收）
location_note: approximate; ≥22 km off the Hunter coast, 500 km² licence area
capacity_note: up to 2 GW floating; 500 km² licence area
description_en:
Only Hunter project offered a feasibility licence; never accepted.
- Feasibility licence offered Feb 2025 (8 applications assessed); 90-day extension granted June 2025.
- Up to 2 GW floating, ≥22 km offshore; reported value ~A$10bn.
- Aug 2025: Equinor exited and the partners declined the licence.
- Minister Bowen said the Hunter zone would not be reopened to other applicants in 2025.
description_zh:
猎人谷海域唯一获发可行性许可证要约的项目，最终未接受。
- 2025年2月获许可证要约（共评估8份申请）；2025年6月获90天延期。
- 拟建最高2吉瓦漂浮式风电，离岸22公里以上；媒体报道投资约100亿澳元。
- 2025年8月Equinor退出，合作方拒收许可证。
- 部长Bowen表示2025年不向其他申请人重新开放猎人谷海域。
latest_update_en: 2025-08-22: Equinor and Oceanex declined the feasibility licence; Oceanex says it still seeks Hunter options.
latest_update_zh: 2025年8月22日：Equinor与Oceanex拒收可行性许可证；Oceanex称仍在寻求猎人谷开发机会。

name: Eastern Rise (formerly Hunter Coast Offshore Wind)
name_zh: Eastern Rise（原Hunter Coast）海上风电项目
nature_en: Floating offshore wind proposal, Hunter–Central Coast (abandoned)
nature_zh: 漂浮式海上风电项目，猎人谷–中央海岸（已放弃）
capacity_note: 1.725 GW at exit (earlier 1.4→1.65 GW, ~110 × 15 MW floating turbines)
description_en:
BlueFloat/Energy Estate floating project in the Hunter.
- Launched 2020 as Hunter Coast; expanded from 1.4 GW to 1.65 GW, later 1.725 GW as Eastern Rise.
- 20–50 km offshore using floating foundations.
- Not offered a feasibility licence (only Novocastrian was).
- Development ceased July 2025 when BlueFloat left Australia.
description_zh:
BlueFloat与Energy Estate在猎人谷的漂浮式项目。
- 2020年以Hunter Coast名义启动；装机由1.4吉瓦增至1.65吉瓦，更名Eastern Rise后为1.725吉瓦。
- 离岸20–50公里，采用漂浮式基础。
- 未获可行性许可证要约（仅Novocastrian获要约）。
- 2025年7月BlueFloat退出澳洲后终止开发。
latest_update_en: 2025-07: Development ceased with BlueFloat's exit.
latest_update_zh: 2025年7月：随BlueFloat退出终止开发。

name: South Pacific Offshore Wind (Illawarra)
name_zh: South Pacific 海上风电项目（伊拉瓦拉）
nature_en: Floating offshore wind proposal, Illawarra declared area (withdrawn)
nature_zh: 漂浮式海上风电项目，伊拉瓦拉宣布海域（已撤回）
location_note: approximate; off coast between Shellharbour and Clifton
capacity_note: 1.6 GW floating proposal
description_en:
Last remaining Illawarra applicant; withdrawn.
- 1.6 GW floating proposal between Shellharbour and Clifton.
- BlueFloat ceased all Australian work July 2025.
- Application formally withdrawn; Jan 2026 government confirmed no Illawarra licences.
- Illawarra zone remains declared and open to R&D licences.
description_zh:
伊拉瓦拉海域最后一个申请项目，已撤回。
- 拟建1.6吉瓦漂浮式风电，位于Shellharbour至Clifton外海。
- 2025年7月BlueFloat停止全部澳洲业务。
- 正式撤回许可证申请；2026年1月政府确认伊拉瓦拉不发放可行性许可证。
- 伊拉瓦拉宣布海域继续有效，可申请研发许可证。
latest_update_en: 2026-01-23: Government confirmed no Illawarra feasibility licences; BlueFloat application withdrawn.
latest_update_zh: 2026年1月23日：政府确认伊拉瓦拉不发放可行性许可证；BlueFloat申请已撤回。

name: Bunbury Offshore Wind North
name_zh: Bunbury 北部海上风电项目
nature_en: Offshore wind farm, Bunbury declared area (northern part)
nature_zh: 海上风电场，班伯里宣布海域北部
basin_region: Indian Ocean off Bunbury declared area
location_note: approximate; >30 km offshore, northern part of zone
owners: Bunbury Offshore Wind Farm Pty Ltd (EDF power solutions Australia)
capacity_note: 1.5 GW per RenewEconomy (Aug 2025); EDF site cites 1,500 MW for the Bunbury project
description_en:
EDF-led project in WA's first offshore wind zone.
- Preliminary feasibility licence June 2025; final licence offered 23 Jan 2026.
- ~1.5 GW, more than 30 km offshore.
- Would supply the South West Interconnected System (SWIS).
- Developer is EDF power solutions Australia (Oceanex did not bid in Bunbury).
description_zh:
法国电力（EDF）主导的西澳首个海上风电海域项目。
- 2025年6月获初步可行性许可证；2026年1月23日获最终许可证要约。
- 装机约1.5吉瓦，离岸30公里以上。
- 向西南互联电网（SWIS）供电。
- 开发商为EDF power solutions Australia（Oceanex未参与班伯里竞标）。
latest_update_en: 2026-01-23: Final feasibility licence offered.
latest_update_zh: 2026年1月23日：获最终可行性许可证要约。

name: Bunbury Offshore Wind South
name_zh: Bunbury 南部海上风电项目
nature_en: Offshore wind farm, Bunbury declared area (southern part)
nature_zh: 海上风电场，班伯里宣布海域南部
basin_region: Indian Ocean off Bunbury declared area
owners: Bunbury Offshore Wind Farm Pty Ltd (EDF power solutions Australia)
capacity_note: not separately disclosed; three Bunbury projects ~4 GW combined
description_en:
EDF's second Bunbury licence.
- Area overlapped Westward Wind; overlap resolved 27 Aug 2025.
- Preliminary licence Aug 2025; final licence offered 23 Jan 2026.
- Capacity not disclosed separately; Bunbury trio totals ~4 GW.
- 7-year licence term for surveys, EPBC approvals and consultation.
description_zh:
EDF在班伯里的第二张许可证。
- 海域曾与Westward Wind重叠，2025年8月27日协商解决。
- 2025年8月获初步许可证；2026年1月23日获最终许可证要约。
- 单独装机未披露；班伯里三个项目合计约4吉瓦。
- 许可期7年，用于勘察、EPBC审批及磋商。
latest_update_en: 2026-01-23: Final feasibility licence offered.
latest_update_zh: 2026年1月23日：获最终可行性许可证要约。

name: Westward Wind
name_zh: Westward Wind 海上风电项目
nature_en: Offshore wind farm, Bunbury declared area
nature_zh: 海上风电场，班伯里宣布海域
basin_region: Indian Ocean off Bunbury declared area
location_note: approximate; adjacent to Bunbury South licence area
capacity_note: up to 1.2 GW
description_en:
Ocean Winds' WA project.
- Preliminary licence Aug 2025 after resolving overlap with Bunbury South.
- Final feasibility licence offered 23 Jan 2026; granted (Ocean Winds release 12 Feb 2026).
- Up to 1.2 GW into the SWIS.
- Ocean Winds' second Australian licence after High Sea Wind.
description_zh:
Ocean Winds西澳项目。
- 2025年8月与Bunbury南部项目解决海域重叠后获初步许可证。
- 2026年1月23日获最终许可证要约，2026年2月12日Ocean Winds公告获证。
- 装机最高1.2吉瓦，接入SWIS电网。
- 为Ocean Winds继High Sea Wind后的第二张澳洲许可证。
latest_update_en: 2026-02-12: Ocean Winds announced feasibility licence granted.
latest_update_zh: 2026年2月12日：Ocean Winds公告获可行性许可证。

name: Perth Wave Energy Project (CETO 5, Garden Island)
name_zh: 珀斯波浪能项目（CETO 5，花园岛）
nature_en: Grid-connected wave energy demonstration array (CETO 5) supplying HMAS Stirling
nature_zh: 并网波浪能示范阵列（CETO 5），向HMAS Stirling海军基地供电
capacity_note: CETO 5 units rated 240 kW each; unit count not confirmed in sources used
description_en:
Australia's first grid-connected wave array.
- CETO 5 buoys installed Nov 2014–Jan 2015; grid supply from Feb 2015, all output to HMAS Stirling.
- Completed 12 months' operation (Jan 2016); >14,000 cumulative operating hours, ~12,000 kWh exported.
- Total cost almost A$40m; ARENA A$13.1m, WA LEED A$10m.
- ARENA funding period ended Dec 2017; array no longer operating.
description_zh:
澳洲首个并网波浪能阵列。
- 2014年11月至2015年1月安装CETO 5浮体；2015年2月起并网，全部电量供HMAS Stirling。
- 2016年1月完成12个月运行；累计运行逾1.4万小时，外送电量约1.2万千瓦时。
- 总投资近4000万澳元；ARENA资助1310万澳元，西澳LEED计划1000万澳元。
- ARENA资助期2017年12月结束；阵列已停运。
latest_update_en: 2017-12: ARENA funding period closed; demonstration complete.
latest_update_zh: 2017年12月：ARENA资助期结束，示范完成。

name: Albany Wave Energy Project (Sandpatch)
nature_en: Proposed 1 MW CETO wave farm (contract terminated)
nature_zh: 拟建1兆瓦CETO波浪电场（合同已终止）
capacity_note: 1 MW planned
description_en:
Planned commercial-scale CETO wave farm at Albany.
- Oct 2017: A$15.75m WA grant for a 1 MW farm at Sandpatch; UWA got A$3.75m for a wave research centre.
- Mar 2019: WA Government terminated the contract.
- Mar 2019: Carnegie entered voluntary administration (later recapitalised).
- Carnegie's CETO work moved to Spain (EuropeWave/ACHIEVE, BiMEP berth).
description_zh:
奥尔巴尼拟建CETO波浪电场。
- 2017年10月西澳政府拨款1575万澳元建设Sandpatch 1兆瓦电场；西澳大学获375万澳元建波浪能研究中心。
- 2019年3月西澳政府终止合同。
- 2019年3月卡内基进入自愿托管（后重组）。
- 此后CETO测试转至西班牙（EuropeWave/ACHIEVE项目，BiMEP泊位）。
latest_update_en: 2019-03: Contract terminated by WA Government.
latest_update_zh: 2019年3月：西澳政府终止合同。

name: MoorPower Scaled Demonstrator
nature_en: Wave energy system to power aquaculture feed barges (scaled demonstrator)
nature_zh: 为水产养殖投喂驳船供电的波浪能系统（缩比示范）
location_note: Carnegie test facility, Rous Head, North Fremantle
owners: Carnegie Clean Energy; Blue Economy CRC collaboration
capacity_note: rating not disclosed; three power take-off units
description_en:
Carnegie's aquaculture-focused wave power product.
- Scaled demonstrator with three seabed-connected PTO units, completed early 2025 and operating.
- Developed with the Blue Economy CRC; Huon Aquaculture and Tassal are partners.
- July 2025: funding awarded for MoorPower commercial pilot design (with Huon, UTAS and others).
- Targets diesel replacement on salmon feed barges.
description_zh:
卡内基面向水产养殖的波浪能产品。
- 缩比示范装置含3台海床连接取能单元，2025年初建成并运行。
- 与蓝色经济合作研究中心（Blue Economy CRC）合作；Huon Aquaculture与Tassal为合作方。
- 2025年7月获MoorPower商业试点设计资金（合作方含Huon、塔斯马尼亚大学等）。
- 用于替代三文鱼投喂驳船柴油发电。
latest_update_en: 2025-07: Funding awarded for MoorPower commercial pilot design.
latest_update_zh: 2025年7月：获MoorPower商业试点设计资金。

name: UniWave200 King Island
nature_en: 200 kW grid-connected oscillating-water-column wave energy converter
nature_zh: 200千瓦并网振荡水柱式波浪能装置
capacity_note: 200 kW
description_en:
Grid-connected wave energy demonstration on King Island.
- 200 kW UniWave200 near Grassy Harbour; grid-connected June 2021 under a PPA with Hydro Tasmania.
- Operated ~18 months; on site >2 years including extreme sea states.
- ARENA A$4.03m of A$19.37m total cost; project ran Mar 2019–Oct 2024.
- Device since decommissioned; data shared with AMC (UTAS) and US DOE.
description_zh:
金岛并网波浪能示范项目。
- 200千瓦UniWave200装置，位于Grassy Harbour附近；2021年6月并网，与Hydro Tasmania签订购电协议。
- 运行约18个月，现场部署逾2年，经历极端海况。
- 总投资1937万澳元，其中ARENA资助403万澳元；项目期2019年3月至2024年10月。
- 装置已退役；数据向澳大利亚海事学院（UTAS）及美国能源部开放。
latest_update_en: 2024-10: ARENA project completed; device decommissioned.
latest_update_zh: 2024年10月：ARENA项目结项，装置退役。

name: Banks Strait tidal resource assessment (AUSTEn)
name_zh: 班克斯海峡潮流能资源评估（AUSTEn）
nature_en: National tidal resource mapping with Eastern Bass Strait islands case study
nature_zh: 全国潮流能资源测绘，含巴斯海峡东部岛屿案例研究
basin_region: Banks Strait / eastern Bass Strait islands
location_note: representative point, Banks Strait (study area, not a project site)
owners: University of Tasmania (lead), CSIRO, University of Queensland
capacity_note: resource study; no development capacity
description_en:
Australia's main tidal energy resource study.
- ARENA A$2.49m of A$5.85m; ran Jun 2017–Jan 2021.
- ~500 m resolution national tidal resource map fed into AREMI.
- Case study on energy extraction at Eastern Bass Strait islands.
- Industry partners included MAKO Tidal Turbines, OpenHydro, Atlantis and Spiral Energy.
description_zh:
澳洲主要潮流能资源研究。
- 总投入585万澳元，其中ARENA资助249万澳元；2017年6月至2021年1月。
- 完成约500米分辨率全国潮流能资源图，纳入AREMI平台。
- 以巴斯海峡东部岛屿为能量提取案例研究。
- 行业合作方包括MAKO Tidal Turbines、OpenHydro、Atlantis、Spiral Energy。
latest_update_en: 2021-01: Study completed; no commercial tidal project has followed in Australia as at Oct 2026 (not verified beyond ARENA page).
latest_update_zh: 2021年1月：研究完成；截至2026年10月未见后续商业潮流能项目（仅据ARENA页面）。

name: Dampier Salt – Dampier
nature_en: Solar evaporation of seawater for export industrial salt
nature_zh: 海水太阳能蒸发制盐，出口工业盐
description_en:
One of the world's largest seaborne salt exporters, operating solar saltfields at Dampier and Port Hedland.
- Owners: Rio Tinto 68%, Marubeni 22%, Sojitz 10%.
- Two operations total 53 ponds over 20,000 ha.
- H1 2026 output 3.111 Mt (H1 2025: 3.235 Mt); Q2 2026 1.72 Mt.
- Lake MacLeod operation sold to Leichhardt (completed Dec 2024).
description_zh:
全球最大海运盐出口商之一，在丹皮尔和黑德兰港经营太阳能盐田。
- 股权：力拓68%、丸红22%、双日10%。
- 两处盐场共53个蒸发池，面积20,000公顷。
- 2026年上半年产量311.1万吨（2025年上半年323.5万吨），2026年二季度172万吨。
- Lake MacLeod盐场已出售予Leichhardt（2024年12月完成）。
latest_update_en: 2026-07: H1 2026 Dampier Salt output 3.111 Mt, 3.8% below H1 2025.
latest_update_zh: 2026年7月：Dampier Salt 2026年上半年产量311.1万吨，同比下降3.8%。

name: Dampier Salt – Port Hedland
nature_en: Solar evaporation of seawater for export industrial salt
nature_zh: 海水太阳能蒸发制盐，出口工业盐
capacity_note: Site-level capacity not disclosed; output reported combined with Dampier
description_en:
Second Dampier Salt solar saltfield, exporting through Port Hedland.
- Same JV: Rio Tinto 68%, Marubeni 22%, Sojitz 10%.
- Output reported with Dampier: combined H1 2026 3.111 Mt.
- Product meets Halal, Kosher and ISO9001 standards (company).
description_zh:
Dampier Salt第二处太阳能盐田，经黑德兰港出口。
- 同一合资：力拓68%、丸红22%、双日10%。
- 产量与丹皮尔合并披露：2026年上半年合计311.1万吨。
- 产品符合清真、犹太洁食及ISO9001标准（公司披露）。
latest_update_en: 2026-07: Combined Dampier Salt output 3.111 Mt in H1 2026.
latest_update_zh: 2026年7月：Dampier Salt 2026年上半年合计产量311.1万吨。

name: Lake MacLeod salt & gypsum
nature_en: Salt and gypsum from a seawater-fed coastal salt lake north of Carnarvon
nature_zh: 卡纳文以北海水补给型沿海盐湖产盐及石膏
capacity_note: Plus ~1 Mtpa gypsum
description_en:
Former Dampier Salt operation sold to Leichhardt Industrials for A$375m (US$251m).
- Capacity ~1.5 Mtpa salt and ~1 Mtpa gypsum.
- Sale agreed 16 Jan 2024, completed 2 Dec 2024; 127-person workforce retained.
- Leichhardt is also developing the Eramurra solar salt project in the Pilbara.
description_zh:
原Dampier Salt资产，以3.75亿澳元（2.51亿美元）出售予Leichhardt Industrials。
- 产能约150万吨/年盐及约100万吨/年石膏。
- 2024年1月16日签约，2024年12月2日交割；保留127名员工。
- Leichhardt同时开发皮尔巴拉Eramurra太阳能盐项目。
latest_update_en: 2024-12: Sale to Leichhardt completed.
latest_update_zh: 2024年12月：出售予Leichhardt完成交割。

name: Shark Bay Salt (Useless Loop)
nature_en: Solar seawater salt for high-end food and industrial markets in Asia
nature_zh: 海水太阳能制盐，供亚洲高端食品及工业市场
description_en:
Mitsui-owned solar salt operation in the Shark Bay World Heritage area, about 830 km north of Perth.
- Capacity ~1.3 Mtpa.
- Operating since 1967; Mitsui joined in 1973 and took 100% in 2005.
- Sells mainly to high-end food markets in Japan and Asia.
description_zh:
三井全资太阳能盐场，位于鲨鱼湾世界遗产区，距珀斯以北约830公里。
- 产能约130万吨/年。
- 1967年投产；三井1973年入股，2005年全资持有。
- 主要销往日本及亚洲高端食品市场。
latest_update_en: Operating; no dated 2025–26 development verified.
latest_update_zh: 在产；未核实到2025–26年具体进展。

name: Onslow Salt
nature_en: Solar seawater salt for chlor-alkali producers in Asia
nature_zh: 海水太阳能制盐，供亚洲氯碱企业
description_en:
Mitsui's larger WA solar salt operation, about 530 km north of Shark Bay.
- Capacity ~2.7 Mtpa.
- First salt shipped 2001; acquired by Mitsui in 2006.
- Main customers are chlor-alkali manufacturers in Japan and Asia.
description_zh:
三井在西澳规模更大的太阳能盐场，位于鲨鱼湾以北约530公里。
- 产能约270万吨/年。
- 2001年首次装船；2006年由三井收购。
- 主要客户为日本及亚洲氯碱企业。
latest_update_en: Operating; no dated 2025–26 development verified.
latest_update_zh: 在产；未核实到2025–26年具体进展。

name: Mardie Salt & Potash
nature_en: Greenfield seawater solar salt and sulphate of potash (SOP) project with export jetty
nature_zh: 新建海水太阳能盐及硫酸钾（SOP）项目，配套出口码头
capacity_note: Plus 140 ktpa SOP (SOP pilot plant FID planned Aug 2026)
description_en:
Australia's largest new salt project, 85% complete at 30 June 2026.
- Design capacity ~5.3 Mtpa salt (>99.5% NaCl) and 140 ktpa SOP.
- Salt-first budget A$1,443m (A$1,185m spent + A$258m to complete); debt drawn A$587m.
- Binding offtakes for 62% of first-three-year salt with buyers in China, Japan, Korea, Indonesia, Taiwan.
- Debt package includes A$981m syndicated facility with NAIF and Export Finance Australia support.
description_zh:
澳大利亚最大在建盐项目，截至2026年6月30日完工85%。
- 设计产能约530万吨/年盐（NaCl>99.5%）及14万吨/年硫酸钾。
- 盐优先预算14.43亿澳元（已支出11.85亿＋待完成2.58亿）；已提款债务5.87亿澳元。
- 前三年62%盐产量已签约，买家来自中国、日本、韩国、印尼、台湾。
- 债务含9.81亿澳元银团贷款，NAIF及澳大利亚出口金融公司参与。
latest_update_en: 2026-08: FY26 results: 85% complete; first salt harvest and first shipments targeted in FY27.
latest_update_zh: 2026年8月：FY26业绩显示完工85%，首次收盐及首船出口目标在FY27。

name: Eramurra Solar Salt Project
