nature_en: Proposed seawater solar salt project exporting via Cape Preston East
nature_zh: 拟建海水太阳能盐项目，经Cape Preston East港出口
capacity_note: Figure at scoping stage (Mining Monthly)
description_en:
Leichhardt's greenfield chemical-salt project under WA EPA assessment.
- Proposed ~3.4 Mtpa high-grade chemical salt for Asia-Pacific chemical makers.
- Located ~55 km WSW of Karratha; exports via trestle jetty at Cape Preston East Port.
- EPA requires a Public Environmental Review; PER comment period has closed.
description_zh:
Leichhardt新建化工盐项目，处于西澳EPA评估阶段。
- 拟产约340万吨/年高品位化工盐，供亚太化工企业。
- 位于Karratha西南偏西约55公里，经Cape Preston East港栈桥出口。
- EPA要求公共环境审查（PER），公众意见期已结束。
latest_update_en: 2025-08: EPA page updated: Public Environmental Review period closed; EPA report pending.
latest_update_zh: 2025年8月：EPA页面更新，公共环境审查期结束，EPA报告待出。

name: Ashburton Salt Project
nature_en: Proposed seawater solar salt project near Onslow (withdrawn)
nature_zh: 翁斯洛附近拟建海水太阳能盐项目（已撤回）
description_en:
Solar salt project proposed by Germany's K+S near Onslow, cancelled after about nine years of development.
- Underwent WA EPA Public Environmental Review.
- Cancellation reported by Project Blue; capacity and date not verified in this review.
- Removes one competing Pilbara supply source alongside Mardie and Eramurra.
description_zh:
德国K+S在翁斯洛附近拟建的太阳能盐项目，开发约9年后取消。
- 曾进行西澳EPA公共环境审查。
- Project Blue报道取消；本次未核实产能及具体日期。
- 皮尔巴拉潜在新增供应减少一处，余Mardie及Eramurra。
latest_update_en: Cancelled by K+S (date not verified).
latest_update_zh: 已由K+S取消（日期未核实）。

name: Cheetham Salt – Price saltfield
nature_en: Solar seawater saltfield and processing on Gulf St Vincent, Yorke Peninsula
nature_zh: 约克半岛圣文森特湾海水太阳能盐场及加工厂
owners: CK Life Sciences International (HKEX-listed) 100% (acquired 2013 from Ridley)
capacity_note: Company-wide capacity up to 800,000 t/yr across 6 fields and 4 refineries; site split not disclosed
description_en:
Cheetham's SA sea-salt field and processing site, drawing seawater into shallow evaporation ponds.
- Cheetham operates 6 solar fields (incl. 2 salt lakes) and 4 refineries; up to 800,000 t/yr in total.
- Owned by Hong Kong's CK Life Sciences since 2013 (bought from Ridley; ~A$150m deal announced 2012).
- Produces food and industrial salt and magnesium brine.
description_zh:
Cheetham在南澳的海盐田及加工厂，引海水入浅池蒸发。
- Cheetham共有6处太阳能盐田（含2个盐湖）及4座精制厂，合计产能最高80万吨/年。
- 2013年起由香港长江生命科技持有（自Ridley收购，2012年公布交易约1.5亿澳元）。
- 产品为食用盐、工业盐及镁卤水。
latest_update_en: 2026: Company brochure lists Price as an active sea-salt processing site.
latest_update_zh: 2026年：公司资料将普赖斯列为在产海盐加工基地。

name: Cheetham Salt – Bajool / Port Alma
nature_en: Solar seawater saltfield near Rockhampton with processing at Bajool
nature_zh: 罗克汉普顿附近海水太阳能盐场，Bajool设加工厂
capacity_note: Company-wide capacity up to 800,000 t/yr; site split not disclosed
description_en:
Cheetham's Queensland sea-salt operation, using Pacific seawater.
- Bajool is one of Cheetham's three processing facilities (with Price and Sea Lake).
- Group capacity up to 800,000 t/yr across 6 fields and 4 refineries.
- Owned by CK Life Sciences since 2013.
description_zh:
Cheetham昆士兰海盐业务，取用太平洋海水。
- Bajool为Cheetham三处加工厂之一（另为普赖斯、Sea Lake）。
- 集团6处盐田及4座精制厂合计产能最高80万吨/年。
- 2013年起由长江生命科技持有。
latest_update_en: 2026: Company brochure lists Bajool and Port Alma as active sites.
latest_update_zh: 2026年：公司资料将Bajool及Port Alma列为在产基地。

name: Dry Creek salt field (Adelaide)
nature_en: Former seawater solar salt field on Gulf St Vincent; restart conditional on brine bypass pipeline
nature_zh: 圣文森特湾原海水太阳能盐田；复产以建成卤水旁通管道为前提
location_note: Dry Creek / St Kilda salt ponds
owners: Buckland Dry Creek Pty Ltd (subsidiary of Adelaide Resource Recovery)
description_en:
Former Ridley/Cheetham salt field now held by Buckland Dry Creek; commercial production paused.
- Late-2020 hypersaline brine leak killed >190 ha of St Kilda mangroves and saltmarsh.
- Dec 2024: civil settlement with SA EPA incl. A$100,000 three-year monitoring study.
- 30 Jun 2025: DEM approved revised PEPR permitting restart only after a 6 km brine bypass pipeline is built.
- Part of the site is being prepared for housing development.
description_zh:
原Ridley/Cheetham盐田，现由Buckland Dry Creek持有，商业生产暂停。
- 2020年末高盐卤水泄漏致St Kilda红树林及盐沼死亡逾190公顷。
- 2024年12月与南澳EPA民事和解，含10万澳元三年环境监测。
- 2025年6月30日DEM批准修订版PEPR，须建成6公里卤水旁通管道后方可复产。
- 部分地块正为住宅开发做准备。
latest_update_en: 2025-06: Revised PEPR approved; restart conditional on 6 km bypass pipeline and SA Water access agreement.
latest_update_zh: 2025年6月：修订版PEPR获批；复产须先建成6公里旁通管道并与SA Water签订通道协议。

name: Groote Eylandt offshore manganese (NT seabed mining ban)
name_zh: 格鲁特岛海上锰矿（北领地海底采矿禁令）
nature_en: Proposed seabed manganese exploration/mining in NT coastal waters; blocked by moratorium and 2021 ban
nature_zh: 北领地沿海水域拟议海底锰矿勘探/开采；因暂停令及2021年禁令终止
owners: Northern Manganese Ltd (tenements); other applicants across NT bays
description_en:
Seabed mining proposals off Groote Eylandt and other NT bays ended when the NT made its moratorium a permanent ban.
- Moratorium first imposed Mar 2012, extended twice.
- Ban announced 5 Feb 2021 after NT EPA advice; formalised Aug 2021.
- 2006–2011 applications covered Fog Bay, Anson Bay, Blue Mud Bay, Wessel Islands, Groote Eylandt, Limmen Bight.
- Northern Manganese held tenements in the Groote area put at risk by the ban.
description_zh:
北领地将暂停令转为永久禁令后，格鲁特岛及其他海湾海底采矿提案终止。
- 2012年3月首次实施暂停令，两次延期。
- 依NT EPA意见于2021年2月5日宣布禁令，2021年8月正式生效。
- 2006–2011年申请区域含Fog Bay、Anson Bay、Blue Mud Bay、Wessel群岛、格鲁特岛、Limmen Bight。
- Northern Manganese在格鲁特海域的矿权受禁令影响。
latest_update_en: 2021-08: NT formalised permanent ban on seabed mining in Territory coastal waters.
latest_update_zh: 2021年8月：北领地正式实施沿海水域海底采矿永久禁令。

name: Sydney offshore sand (Cape Banks–Cape Solander)
name_zh: 悉尼海上砂矿（Cape Banks–Cape Solander）
nature_en: Legacy offshore sand exploration licence off Botany Bay; proposed source for Bate Bay beach nourishment
nature_zh: 植物学湾外海遗留海砂勘探许可证；拟作Bate Bay海滩补砂砂源
location_note: Offshore between Cape Banks and Cape Solander
owners: Licence holder not identified in sources reviewed
description_en:
An offshore sand exploration licence remains off Botany Bay despite NSW's seabed-mining ban.
- NSW stopped accepting offshore mining applications (Feb 2022) and legislated a ban on seabed mineral exploration and mining in coastal waters (Mar 2024); beach nourishment is exempt.
- Licence due to expire 2 July 2026; no renewal application lodged as of Feb 2026.
- Sutherland Shire Council voted 18 May 2026 to investigate one-off beach nourishment using sand from this area.
description_zh:
尽管新州已禁止海底采矿，植物学湾外海仍存一张海砂勘探许可证。
- 新州2022年2月停止受理海上采矿申请，2024年3月立法禁止州沿海水域海底矿产勘探及开采，海滩补砂豁免。
- 许可证2026年7月2日到期；截至2026年2月未提交续期申请。
- Sutherland Shire议会2026年5月18日表决研究以该海域砂源进行一次性海滩补砂。
latest_update_en: 2026-05: Sutherland Shire Council to investigate offshore sand for Bate Bay nourishment; licence status after 2 Jul 2026 not verified.
latest_update_zh: 2026年5月：Sutherland Shire议会研究以海上砂源补充Bate Bay海滩；2026年7月2日后许可证状态未核实。

name: Tweed River Entrance Sand Bypassing
name_zh: 特威德河口输砂旁通工程
nature_en: Permanent jetty-pump sand bypassing plus dredging to restore littoral drift to southern Gold Coast beaches
nature_zh: 固定栈桥泵送输砂及疏浚，恢复向黄金海岸南部海滩的沿岸输砂
basin_region: Tweed River entrance / southern Gold Coast
description_en:
Joint NSW–QLD scheme moving sand from Letitia Spit across the Tweed entrance.
- Long-term target ~500,000 m3/yr (~800,000 t) via pumping and dredging.
- Operating concession began May 2001; McConnell Dowell ran it for 25 years until handback in Sep 2024.
- Mar 2026 dredging campaign of up to 150,000 m3 placed offshore Snapper Rocks, Duranbah, Bilinga, Fingal.
description_zh:
新州与昆州联合工程，将Letitia Spit砂体输送跨越特威德河口。
- 长期目标约50万立方米/年（约80万吨），泵送与疏浚结合。
- 2001年5月开始特许运营；McConnell Dowell运营至2024年9月移交政府。
- 2026年3月疏浚作业最多15万立方米，抛放于Snapper Rocks、Duranbah、Bilinga、Fingal外海。
latest_update_en: 2026-03: Dredging campaign (up to 150,000 m3) began 27 Mar 2026.
latest_update_zh: 2026年3月：3月27日启动疏浚作业（最多15万立方米）。

name: Gold Coast offshore sand nourishment (post-Cyclone Alfred)
name_zh: 黄金海岸海上取砂补滩（阿尔弗雷德气旋后）
nature_en: Offshore dredged sand placed on Gold Coast beaches after Tropical Cyclone Alfred
nature_zh: 阿尔弗雷德热带气旋后，海上疏浚取砂回填黄金海岸海滩
location_note: Representative point: Surfers Paradise / Miami placement area
owners: City of Gold Coast; funded by Australian and Queensland Governments (DRFA)
description_en:
Largest recent beach restoration campaign on the Gold Coast using the dredger Trud R.
- ~1.2 million m3 placed Apr–Oct 2026 over 1,156 deliveries (Miami/Mermaid 797,740 m3).
- ~3 million m3 returned since Cyclone Alfred (Mar 2025), against ~4 million m3 lost.
- Fully funded through Commonwealth–Queensland disaster recovery arrangements.
description_zh:
黄金海岸近年最大规模补滩作业，使用Trud R挖泥船。
- 2026年4–10月共回填约120万立方米，1,156船次（Miami/Mermaid 797,740立方米）。
- 阿尔弗雷德气旋（2025年3月）后累计回填约300万立方米，损失约400万立方米。
- 费用由联邦与昆州灾后恢复资金全额承担。
latest_update_en: 2026-10: Campaign completed (City of Gold Coast, 8 Oct 2026).
latest_update_zh: 2026年10月：作业完成（黄金海岸市政府10月8日公布）。

name: Tassal Tasmanian salmon operations
name_zh: Tassal塔斯马尼亚三文鱼养殖业务
nature_en: Atlantic salmon & ocean trout sea-pen farming, south-east and west Tasmania
nature_zh: 大西洋鲑及海鳟网箱养殖：塔斯马尼亚东南部及西部海域
basin_region: Storm Bay / D'Entrecasteaux Channel / Macquarie Harbour
location_note: Representative point: Nubeena, Storm Bay zone
owners: Cooke Inc. 100% (acquired 2022, delisted from ASX Nov 2022)
description_en:
Tasmania's second-largest salmon farmer by FY2026 volume, owned by Canada's Cooke Inc.
- FY2026 output 33,388 t, down 0.4% on FY2025 (33,523 t); overtaken by Huon.
- Cooke agreed to acquire Tassal in Aug 2022 at A$5.23/share (~A$1.7bn); delisted Nov 2022.
- Five marine farming zones: Eastern (Okehampton Bay, Port Arthur), Channel, Southern (Dover, Huon River), Western (Macquarie Harbour), Storm Bay (Nubeena, West of Wedge).
- Also owns prawn farms in QLD/NSW and the Cone Bay barramundi farm (WA).
description_zh:
塔斯马尼亚第二大三文鱼养殖商（按FY2026产量），加拿大Cooke Inc.全资持有。
- FY2026产量33,388吨，较FY2025（33,523吨）下降0.4%，被Huon反超。
- 2022年8月Cooke以每股5.23澳元（约17亿澳元）收购，2022年11月从澳交所退市。
- 五个海水养殖区：东部（Okehampton Bay、Port Arthur）、Channel、南部（Dover、Huon河）、西部（Macquarie Harbour）、Storm Bay（Nubeena、West of Wedge）。
- 另持有昆士兰/新南威尔士对虾养殖场及西澳Cone Bay尖吻鲈养殖场。
latest_update_en: 2026-09: FY2026 state data show Tassal output 33,388 t, second to Huon (34,588 t).
latest_update_zh: 2026年9月：FY2026州统计显示Tassal产量33,388吨，次于Huon（34,588吨）。

name: Huon Aquaculture Tasmanian salmon operations
name_zh: Huon Aquaculture塔斯马尼亚三文鱼养殖业务
nature_en: Atlantic salmon sea-pen farming (Storm Bay, Hideaway Bay, Macquarie Harbour)
nature_zh: 大西洋鲑网箱养殖（Storm Bay、Hideaway Bay、Macquarie Harbour）
location_note: Representative point: Storm Bay lease off Bruny Island
description_en:
Tasmania's largest salmon producer by FY2026 volume, owned by Brazil's JBS since Nov 2021.
- FY2026 output 34,588 t (head-on-gutted), up 26.6% from 27,321 t in FY2025.
- Pens in Storm Bay (off Bruny Island), Hideaway Bay (Dover) and Macquarie Harbour (Strahan); processing at Parramatta Creek.
- Holds a 2,200 ha lease in WA's Mid West aquaculture zone (as of 2021).
- In Macquarie Harbour, files a joint oxygenation plan with Petuna under 2026 EPA requirements.
description_zh:
FY2026按产量计为塔斯马尼亚最大三文鱼生产商，2021年11月起为巴西JBS全资子公司。
- FY2026产量34,588吨（去头去脏），较FY2025的27,321吨增长26.6%。
- 网箱位于Storm Bay（Bruny岛外）、Hideaway Bay（Dover）及Macquarie Harbour（Strahan），加工厂在Parramatta Creek。
- 持有西澳Mid West水产养殖区2,200公顷海域租约（2021年数据）。
- 在Macquarie Harbour与Petuna联合提交2026年EPA要求的增氧方案。
latest_update_en: 2026-09: Overtook Tassal as Tasmania's largest salmon producer (FY2026 34,588 t).
latest_update_zh: 2026年9月：FY2026产量34,588吨，超越Tassal成为塔斯马尼亚最大三文鱼生产商。

name: Petuna salmon & ocean trout
nature_en: Atlantic salmon and ocean trout sea-pen farming, mainly Macquarie Harbour
nature_zh: 大西洋鲑及海鳟网箱养殖，主要在Macquarie Harbour
owners: Sealord Group 100% of farming business (second 50% bought Jan 2020); Sealord is 50% Moana New Zealand / 50% Nissui
description_en:
Third of Tasmania's three main salmonid farmers; fully owned by New Zealand's Sealord since 2020.
- FY2026 output 6,272 t, down 12.1% from 7,139 t in FY2025.
- Sealord bought the first 50% around 2011 and the remaining 50% in Jan 2020; the Rockliff family kept the wild-fisheries business.
- Sealord is owned 50% by Moana New Zealand (Maori) and 50% by Japan's Nissui.
- Submitted a joint Macquarie Harbour oxygen plan with Huon (EPA approval 1 Sep 2026).
description_zh:
塔斯马尼亚三大鲑鳟养殖商之一，2020年起由新西兰Sealord全资持有。
- FY2026产量6,272吨，较FY2025的7,139吨下降12.1%。
- Sealord约2011年收购首批50%，2020年1月收购剩余50%；Rockliff家族保留野生捕捞业务。
- Sealord股权：Moana New Zealand（毛利）50%、日本水产Nissui 50%。
- 与Huon联合提交Macquarie Harbour增氧方案，2026年9月1日获EPA批准。
latest_update_en: 2026-09: EPA approved joint Huon–Petuna dissolved-oxygen plan for Macquarie Harbour.
latest_update_zh: 2026年9月：EPA批准Huon与Petuna在Macquarie Harbour的联合溶解氧方案。

name: Macquarie Harbour salmon farming zone
nature_en: Shared salmonid farming zone in a World Heritage-adjacent harbour; habitat of the endangered Maugean skate
nature_zh: 三家运营商共用的鲑鳟养殖海域，毗邻世界遗产区，濒危Maugean鳐唯一栖息地
owners: Farm leases: Tassal (Cooke), Huon Aquaculture (JBS), Petuna (Sealord)
description_en:
Salmon farming continues after the Commonwealth closed its reconsideration of the 2012 expansion approval in 2025.
- Maugean skate estimated at 40–120 adults; harbour is its only habitat; low dissolved oxygen linked to farming.
- 28 Mar 2025 EPBC amendments removed reconsideration power for long-running requests; Minister Watt then confirmed the 2012 decision (Aug 2025).
- A$18.3m artificial oxygen-pumping program funded to offset farm oxygen demand.
- From 1 Nov 2026 operators must offset 10.3 t/day of oxygen consumed (EPA plans approved 1 Sep 2026).
description_zh:
2025年联邦政府结束对2012年扩建批准的复议，三文鱼养殖继续。
- Maugean鳐成体估计40–120尾，本港为唯一栖息地；低溶解氧与养殖相关。
- 2025年3月28日EPBC法修订取消长期复议请求的复议权；Watt部长随后于2025年8月确认2012年决定。
- 联邦出资1,830万澳元实施人工泵氧计划，抵消养殖耗氧。
- 2026年11月1日起运营商须每日补偿10.3吨耗氧量（EPA于2026年9月1日批准方案）。
latest_update_en: 2026-09: EPA approved oxygenation plans requiring full 10.3 t/day oxygen offset by 1 Nov 2026 after DO declines in H2 2025–H1 2026.
latest_update_zh: 2026年9月：2025年下半年至2026年上半年溶解氧下降后，EPA批准增氧方案，要求2026年11月1日前全额补偿每日10.3吨耗氧。

name: Storm Bay salmon farming zone
nature_en: Higher-energy offshore salmon farming zone in southern Tasmania
nature_zh: 塔斯马尼亚南部高能海况离岸三文鱼养殖区
owners: Leases: Tassal (Cooke) at West of Wedge; Huon Aquaculture (JBS) east of Yellow Bluff (Bruny Island)
capacity_note: Tassal's stated production in the zone at 2018 approval; zone-wide biomass cap not verified
description_en:
Expansion zone approved by the Tasmanian Government in Oct 2018 on the Marine Farming Planning Review Panel's recommendation.
- Tassal stated it would produce up to 16,000 t/yr in the zone (West of Wedge leases).
- Huon's preferred 230 ha lease lies east of Yellow Bluff, ~1.5 km off Bruny Island.
- Part of the state's shift of farming to more exposed sites; Tasmania's 2017 plan barred new east-coast farms.
description_zh:
2018年10月塔斯马尼亚州政府依海水养殖规划审查小组建议批准的扩张区。
- Tassal称该区年产量最高16,000吨（West of Wedge租约）。
- Huon首选230公顷租约位于Yellow Bluff以东，距Bruny岛约1.5公里。
- 属州政府将养殖迁往开阔海域的布局；2017年规划禁止东海岸新建养殖场。
latest_update_en: 2018-10: Zone approved; no later zone-level biomass change verified in this review.
latest_update_zh: 2018年10月：养殖区获批；本次核查未发现此后整区生物量上限调整的公开记录。

name: Okehampton Bay salmon farm
nature_en: Tassal east-coast salmon lease near Triabunna
nature_zh: Tassal东海岸三文鱼租约，近Triabunna
capacity_note: 28-pen proposal approved; current stocking level not verified
description_en:
Tassal's only east-coast salmon site, exempted from the 2017 east-coast farming ban.
- Operates under an existing marine farming licence; a 28-pen layout was approved.
- Part of Tassal's Eastern zone together with Port Arthur.
- Tasmania's 2017 draft salmon plan otherwise banned fish farms along the entire east coast.
description_zh:
Tassal唯一东海岸三文鱼养殖点，豁免于2017年东海岸养殖禁令。
- 依既有海水养殖许可证运营，28个网箱布局已获批准。
- 与Port Arthur同属Tassal东部养殖区。
- 2017年州三文鱼产业规划草案禁止其他东海岸养殖场。
latest_update_en: 2017-08: Exempted from east-coast ban; 2025–26 stocking status not confirmed in sources reviewed.
latest_update_zh: 2017年8月：豁免于东海岸禁令；2025–26年放养状态未能从公开资料核实。

name: Port Lincoln Southern Bluefin Tuna ranching
name_zh: 林肯港南方蓝鳍金枪鱼育肥养殖
nature_en: Wild-caught SBT towed to sea pens off Port Lincoln and fattened for the Japanese sashimi market
nature_zh: 野生南方蓝鳍金枪鱼围捕后拖至林肯港外海网箱育肥，主供日本刺身市场
location_note: Representative point: ranching leases off Port Lincoln
capacity_note: Commonwealth SBT TAC 2025–26; most of the commercial catch is ranched
description_en:
Australia's SBT quota is caught in the Great Australian Bight and grown out in pens off Port Lincoln.
- Commonwealth TAC 6,930 t for 2025–26; Australia's CCSBT allocation 7,341 t for 2024–26.
- ABARES tuna GVP A$165m nominal in 2023–24 (+3%), forecast real peak A$185m in 2025–26.
- CCSBT scientific committee recommended a global TAC of 23,647 t for 2027–29, implying ~8,408 t for Australia if adopted.
description_zh:
澳大利亚南方蓝鳍金枪鱼配额在大澳大利亚湾捕获后转入林肯港外海网箱育肥。
- 2025–26年联邦TAC为6,930吨；2024–26年澳方CCSBT国别配额7,341吨。
- ABARES统计2023–24年金枪鱼名义产值1.65亿澳元（+3%），预计2025–26年实际产值峰值1.85亿澳元。
- CCSBT扩大科学委员会建议2027–29年全球TAC为23,647吨，如获通过澳方配额约8,408吨。
latest_update_en: 2025-09: CCSBT papers propose global TAC 23,647 t for 2027–29 (Australia ~8,408 t), pending Commission decision.
latest_update_zh: 2025年9月：CCSBT文件建议2027–29年全球TAC为23,647吨（澳方约8,408吨），待委员会决定。

name: Clean Seas Yellowtail Kingfish (Spencer Gulf)
name_zh: Clean Seas黄尾鰤养殖（斯潘塞湾）
nature_en: Hatchery-to-harvest Yellowtail Kingfish sea-cage farming, Eyre Peninsula
nature_zh: 黄尾鰤全产业链网箱养殖（育苗至收获），艾尔半岛
location_note: Arno Bay hatchery; farms at Port Lincoln, Arno Bay, Fitzgerald Bay
description_en:
Australia's main Yellowtail Kingfish producer, listed in Sydney and Oslo.
- FY2022 sales 3,757 t; revenue A$66.2m (+37%).
- FY2025 sales guidance cut to 2,550–2,650 t (Nov 2024) after predation and mortality reduced live biomass by ~250 t.
- Hatchery at Arno Bay; processing at Royal Park (Adelaide); farms at Port Lincoln, Arno Bay, Fitzgerald Bay.
description_zh:
澳大利亚主要黄尾鰤生产商，悉尼及奥斯陆两地上市。
- FY2022销量3,757吨，收入6,620万澳元（+37%）。
- 2024年11月因捕食与死亡导致活体生物量减少约250吨，FY2025销量指引下调至2,550–2,650吨。
- 育苗场在Arno Bay，加工厂在阿德莱德Royal Park，养殖场在林肯港、Arno Bay、Fitzgerald Bay。
latest_update_en: 2024-11: FY2025 volume guidance revised to 2,550–2,650 t; FY2026 results not verified in this review.
latest_update_zh: 2024年11月：FY2025销量指引调整为2,550–2,650吨；FY2026业绩本次未能核实。

name: Cone Bay ocean barramundi farm
name_zh: Cone Bay海水尖吻鲈养殖场
nature_en: Australia's only ocean sea-cage barramundi farm, Buccaneer Archipelago
nature_zh: 澳大利亚唯一海上网箱尖吻鲈养殖场，Buccaneer群岛
owners: Tassal (Cooke) via MPA Fish Farms Pty Ltd, acquired Aug 2023 from Barramundi Group administrators
description_en:
Former Marine Produce Australia (MPA) farm bought by Cooke-owned Tassal in Aug 2023.
- Output ~1,600 t/yr at acquisition.
- Previous owner Barramundi Group (Singapore) put the Australian business into administration in May 2023.
- Prior plans to expand to 10,000 t then 30,000 t stalled without a funding partner; 13 additional sites applied for across the Buccaneer Archipelago.
description_zh:
原Marine Produce Australia（MPA）养殖场，2023年8月由Cooke旗下Tassal收购。
- 收购时年产约1,600吨。
- 原股东新加坡Barramundi Group于2023年5月令澳洲业务进入托管。
- 此前扩产至1万吨及3万吨计划因无资金伙伴搁置；已在Buccaneer群岛申请13处新增养殖点。
latest_update_en: 2023-08: Tassal acquired MPA Fish Farms and MPA Marketing; expansion applications status not verified.
latest_update_zh: 2023年8月：Tassal收购MPA Fish Farms及MPA Marketing；扩建申请进展未能核实。

name: Kimberley Aquaculture Development Zone
name_zh: 金伯利水产养殖发展区
nature_en: State-declared sea-cage finfish zone at Cone Bay with strategic environmental approval
nature_zh: 州政府划定的Cone Bay海上网箱鱼类养殖区，已取得战略性环评批准
owners: Zone administered by WA DPIRD; Cone Bay farm operated by Tassal (Cooke)
capacity_note: 2,000 ha zone, environmental approval Feb 2014
description_en:
2,000 ha aquaculture development zone at Cone Bay, approved in Feb 2014.
- Approved capacity 20,000 t/yr of finfish in floating sea cages.
- Current production comes from the Tassal (Cooke) Cone Bay barramundi farm (~1,600 t/yr in 2023).
- Pre-approval lowers environmental-assessment burden for new lessees.
description_zh:
Cone Bay 2,000公顷水产养殖发展区，2014年2月获批。
- 获批产能为浮式网箱鱼类年产20,000吨。
- 现有产量来自Tassal（Cooke）Cone Bay尖吻鲈养殖场（2023年约1,600吨）。
- 预先审批降低新租户的环评门槛。
latest_update_en: 2023-08: Zone's operating farm changed hands to Tassal (Cooke).
latest_update_zh: 2023年8月：区内在产养殖场转由Tassal（Cooke）持有。

name: Mid West Aquaculture Development Zone
name_zh: 中西部水产养殖发展区
nature_en: State-declared offshore finfish zone near the Abrolhos Islands, off Geraldton
nature_zh: 州政府划定的离岸鱼类养殖区，位于Geraldton外海Abrolhos群岛附近
owners: Lease holder includes Huon Aquaculture (JBS): 2,200 ha (as of 2021)
capacity_note: Zone capacity not verified; Huon lease 2,200 ha
description_en:
Offshore finfish zone in WA's Mid West where Huon (JBS) holds a lease.
- Huon's lease covers 2,200 ha (as of 2021).
- No commercial finfish production from the zone was confirmed in sources reviewed.
- Complements the Kimberley zone as WA's second pre-approved sea-cage area.
description_zh:
西澳中西部离岸鱼类养殖区，Huon（JBS）持有其中租约。
- Huon租约面积2,200公顷（2021年数据）。
- 本次核查未确认该区有商业化鱼类产出。
- 与金伯利区同为西澳预审批网箱养殖区。
latest_update_en: 2021: Huon (JBS) held a 2,200 ha lease; no later development milestone verified.
latest_update_zh: 2021年：Huon（JBS）持有2,200公顷租约；此后未核实到开发进展。

name: Humpty Doo Barramundi
nature_en: Land-based saltwater barramundi farm with recirculating wetland treatment
nature_zh: 陆基咸水尖吻鲈养殖，湿地净化循环水系统
description_en:
Family-owned saltwater barramundi farm south-east of Darwin.
- Over 30 years of barramundi farming at Humpty Doo.
- Saltwater wetland system: water cleaned by saltwater grasses and recirculated.
- ABARES ranks barramundi among Australia's top five aquaculture species groups by value.
description_zh:
达尔文东南的家族持有咸水尖吻鲈养殖场。
- 在Humpty Doo养殖尖吻鲈逾30年。
- 咸水湿地系统：盐生草净化后循环利用。
- 按产值计，尖吻鲈位列澳大利亚水产养殖前五大品类。
latest_update_en: Operating; no dated 2025–26 development verified.
latest_update_zh: 在产；未核实到2025–26年具体进展。

name: Project Sea Dragon (Legune)
nature_en: Proposed large-scale black tiger prawn farm at Legune Station near the NT/WA border
nature_zh: 拟建大型黑虎虾养殖项目，位于北领地/西澳边界Legune牧场
owners: Seafarms Group (ASX: SFG); project entity in liquidation, assets being reacquired
description_en:
Seafarms halted Project Sea Dragon in 2022; project entity was ordered into liquidation and Seafarms is reacquiring assets.
- Seafarms lost its appeal against liquidation in Nov 2024.
- Credit line from chair-controlled Avatar Finance raised from A$8.5m to A$16.5m (Oct 2025), repayment extended to 15 Oct 2026.
- Purchase of the project's non-cash assets finalised Feb 2026; Seafarms says reacquisition would allow a Stage 1A restart.
description_zh:
Seafarms于2022年暂停Sea Dragon项目，项目公司被裁定清算，Seafarms正回购资产。
- 2024年11月Seafarms清算上诉败诉。
- 2025年10月董事长控股的Avatar Finance授信由850万澳元增至1,650万澳元，还款期延至2026年10月15日。
- 2026年2月完成项目非现金资产收购；公司称回购完成后可重启1A期。
latest_update_en: 2026-08: Seafarms awaiting judgment on A$1.4m held by liquidator and considering asset sales.
latest_update_zh: 2026年8月：Seafarms等待清算人所持140万澳元的判决，并考虑出售资产。

name: Tassal prawn farms (QLD/NSW)
name_zh: Tassal对虾养殖场（昆士兰/新南威尔士）
nature_en: Pond prawn farming, hatcheries and processing in north Queensland and Yamba
nature_zh: 池塘对虾养殖、育苗及加工，北昆士兰及Yamba
description_en:
Tassal's prawn division, inherited by Cooke in the 2022 takeover.
- Sites: Mission Beach (farm, hatchery, processing), Gregory River, Exmoor Station Aquaculture Development Area (Proserpine district), Yamba NSW.
- ABARES prawn GVP (wild + farmed) A$484m in 2023–24.
- NSW black tiger prawn production remains halted after a white spot detection in Apr 2025.
description_zh:
Tassal对虾业务，2022年随收购并入Cooke。
- 场点：Mission Beach（养殖、育苗、加工）、Gregory River、Exmoor Station水产养殖开发区（Proserpine地区）、新州Yamba。
- ABARES统计2023–24年对虾（捕捞+养殖）产值4.84亿澳元。
- 2025年4月检出白斑病毒后，新州黑虎虾生产仍处停产。
latest_update_en: 2025-04: White Spot Syndrome Virus detection halted NSW black tiger prawn production (NSW DPIRD).
latest_update_zh: 2025年4月：检出白斑综合征病毒，新州黑虎虾生产停止（新州DPIRD）。

name: Paspaley South Sea pearling (Broome/Kimberley)
name_zh: Paspaley南洋珍珠养殖（布鲁姆/金伯利）
nature_en: Wild-collected Pinctada maxima pearl oysters and pearl farming in the Kimberley
nature_zh: 野生采集大珠母贝（Pinctada maxima）及金伯利海域珍珠养殖
description_en:
Australia's leading South Sea pearl producer, based on Kimberley Pinctada maxima.
- Founder Nicholas Paspaley Snr bought his first pearling lugger in the 1930s.
- Divers have collected Pinctada maxima off north-west Australia for over 90 years.
- Broome's pearling fleet once exceeded 400 vessels.
description_zh:
澳大利亚主要南洋珍珠生产商，以金伯利大珠母贝为基础。
- 创始人Nicholas Paspaley Snr于1930年代购入首艘采珠船。
- 在西北海域采集大珠母贝逾90年。
- 布鲁姆采珠船队历史峰值超400艘。
latest_update_en: Operating; no dated 2025–26 development verified.
latest_update_zh: 在产；未核实到2025–26年具体进展。

name: SA Pacific oyster industry (Eyre Peninsula)
name_zh: 南澳太平洋牡蛎产业（艾尔半岛）
nature_en: Intertidal and subtidal Pacific oyster farming at Coffin Bay, Smoky Bay, Streaky Bay, Franklin Harbor
nature_zh: Coffin Bay、Smoky Bay、Streaky Bay、Franklin Harbor潮间带及潮下带太平洋牡蛎养殖
owners: Multiple family-owned growers under PIRSA aquaculture leases
description_en:
Australia's largest Pacific oyster growing region, concentrated on the Eyre Peninsula.
- Main growing areas: Coffin Bay, Smoky Bay, Streaky Bay, Franklin Harbor.
- SA seafood industry farmgate revenue A$0.48bn in 2022–23 (all seafood, PIRSA).
- Oysters rank in the top three national aquaculture species groups by value (DAFF).
description_zh:
澳大利亚最大太平洋牡蛎产区，集中于艾尔半岛。
- 主要产区：Coffin Bay、Smoky Bay、Streaky Bay、Franklin Harbor。
- 2022–23年南澳海产品出塘收入4.8亿澳元（全品类，PIRSA）。
- 按产值计牡蛎位列全国水产养殖前三品类（DAFF）。
latest_update_en: No dated 2025–26 SA oyster-specific development verified in this review.
latest_update_zh: 本次核查未发现2025–26年南澳牡蛎专项进展。

name: NSW Sydney rock oyster industry
name_zh: 新南威尔士悉尼岩牡蛎产业
nature_en: Estuarine Sydney rock oyster and Pacific oyster farming across NSW estuaries
nature_zh: 新州各河口悉尼岩牡蛎及太平洋牡蛎养殖
owners: Multiple growers on NSW aquaculture leases
capacity_note: Value is total NSW aquaculture GVP (oysters the main component)
description_en:
Oysters are the core of NSW aquaculture, which was valued at A$112.6m in 2024–25 (est.).
- NSW aquaculture is 51% of state fisheries GVP of A$222.7m (2024–25).
- Pacific oyster volumes rose in 2024–25 with stable prices, offsetting declines elsewhere.
- NSW fisheries exports A$51.8m in 2024–25; Japan the top market (A$23.1m).
description_zh:
牡蛎为新州水产养殖核心，2024–25年新州水产养殖产值估计1.126亿澳元。
- 水产养殖占2024–25年新州渔业总产值2.227亿澳元的51%。
- 2024–25年太平洋牡蛎产量上升、价格平稳，抵消其他品类下滑。
- 2024–25年新州渔业出口5,180万澳元，日本为第一大市场（2,310万澳元）。
latest_update_en: 2025: NSW DPIRD Performance Data & Insights reports aquaculture GVP A$112.6m for 2024–25.
latest_update_zh: 2025年：新州DPIRD《绩效数据与洞察》公布2024–25年水产养殖产值1.126亿澳元。

name: Tasmanian oyster & mussel farming
name_zh: 塔斯马尼亚牡蛎及贻贝养殖
nature_en: Pacific oyster and blue mussel farming in south-east and east-coast Tasmanian bays
nature_zh: 塔斯马尼亚东南部及东海岸海湾太平洋牡蛎与蓝贻贝养殖
owners: Multiple growers on Tasmanian marine farming leases
description_en:
Tasmania's shellfish sector supplies Pacific oysters, oyster spat and blue mussels.
- Pacific Oyster Mortality Syndrome (POMS) hit Tasmania in 2016, cutting spat supply to SA growers.
- Oysters rank in the top three national aquaculture species groups by value (DAFF).
- Figures by species for Tasmania were not verified in this review.
description_zh:
塔斯马尼亚贝类产业供应太平洋牡蛎、牡蛎苗及蓝贻贝。
- 2016年太平洋牡蛎死亡综合征（POMS）侵袭塔州，南澳养殖户苗种供应受阻。
- 按产值计牡蛎位列全国水产养殖前三品类（DAFF）。
- 本次未核实塔州分品种数据。
latest_update_en: No dated 2025–26 development verified.
latest_update_zh: 未核实到2025–26年具体进展。

name: Port Phillip Bay mussel farming
nature_en: Longline blue mussel farming in Port Phillip Bay aquaculture fisheries reserves
nature_zh: 菲利普港湾水产养殖保留区延绳式蓝贻贝养殖
description_en:
Victoria's main marine aquaculture activity, centred on Portarlington and Clifton Springs.
- Longline culture of blue mussels in designated aquaculture fisheries reserves.
- Managed by the Victorian Fisheries Authority.
- Production and value figures not verified in this review.
description_zh:
维州主要海水养殖活动，集中在Portarlington及Clifton Springs。
- 于指定水产养殖保留区延绳养殖蓝贻贝。
- 由维州渔业局管理。
- 本次未核实产量及产值数据。
latest_update_en: No dated 2025–26 development verified.
latest_update_zh: 未核实到2025–26年具体进展。

name: Land-based abalone farms (Yumbah; Jade Tiger)
nature_en: Onshore pump-ashore abalone farming in VIC, SA and TAS
nature_zh: 维州、南澳、塔州陆基抽海水鲍鱼养殖
basin_region: Western Victoria / Eyre Peninsula / East Tasmania
owners: Yumbah: Australian-owned, small group of long-term shareholders; Jade Tiger Abalone separately owned
description_en:
Yumbah is Australia's largest land-based abalone farmer and also grows mussels, oysters, spat and kingfish.
- Abalone operation at Port Lincoln (SA) under ASC audit.
- First oyster farm in Australia to achieve BAP certification (company claim).
- ABARES abalone GVP (wild + farmed) A$152m in 2023–24, declining ~1%/yr.
description_zh:
Yumbah为澳大利亚最大陆基鲍鱼养殖商，并养殖贻贝、牡蛎、苗种及黄尾鰤。
- 南澳林肯港鲍鱼业务接受ASC认证审核。
- 公司称其为澳大利亚首家获BAP认证的牡蛎养殖场。
- ABARES统计2023–24年鲍鱼（捕捞+养殖）产值1.52亿澳元，预计年降约1%。
latest_update_en: No dated 2025–26 development verified.
latest_update_zh: 未核实到2025–26年具体进展。

name: Sea Forest Asparagopsis (SeaFeed)
nature_en: Asparagopsis seaweed cultivation for methane-reducing livestock feed supplement
nature_zh: 芦笋藻（Asparagopsis）养殖，制成牲畜甲烷减排饲料添加剂
owners: Listed (ASX: SEA), IPO Nov 2025 raising A$20.5m at A$2.00
description_en:
Tasmanian producer of SeaFeed, an Asparagopsis supplement claimed to cut ruminant methane by up to 80%.
- FY2026 preliminary SeaFeed revenue A$4.98m (+486%); net loss narrowed 40% to A$5.42m.
- 131,000 cattle under agreement, above its stated cash-flow break-even threshold.
- Laboratory at Triabunna; land-based cultivation at Swansea; first mixing and distribution centre in Newcastle (NSW) being commissioned.
description_zh:
塔斯马尼亚SeaFeed生产商，产品为芦笋藻添加剂，公司称可降低反刍动物甲烷排放最高80%。
- FY2026初步SeaFeed收入498万澳元（+486%），净亏损收窄40%至542万澳元。
- 签约牛只13.1万头，高于公司披露的现金流盈亏平衡线。
- Triabunna设实验室，Swansea为陆基养殖点，新州纽卡斯尔首个混配及分销中心调试中。
latest_update_en: 2026-08: Preliminary FY2026 revenue A$4.98m; Newcastle distribution centre commissioning.
latest_update_zh: 2026年8月：FY2026初步收入498万澳元；纽卡斯尔分销中心调试。

name: West Coast Rock Lobster Managed Fishery
name_zh: 西海岸岩龙虾管理渔业
nature_en: Quota-managed western rock lobster pot fishery, WA
nature_zh: 西澳西部岩龙虾配额管理笼捕渔业
basin_region: WA west coast (Shark Bay to Cape Leeuwin)
owners: Quota-holding licensees (e.g. Geraldton Fishermen's Co-op among processors)
capacity_note: Current-season TACC not verified in this review
description_en:
WA's most valuable fishery and historically Australia's most valuable single-species wild-capture fishery.
- First fishery in the world certified by the MSC (2000); recertified for the fifth time in 2022.
- Managed under an annual Total Allowable Commercial Catch on a 12-month season.
- National rock lobster GVP A$403m in 2023–24 (ABARES); ABARES forecasts higher rock lobster value lifting 2026–27 sector GVP.
description_zh:
西澳产值最高渔业，历史上为澳大利亚产值最高的单一品种野生捕捞渔业。
- 2000年成为全球首个获MSC认证的渔业，2022年第五次续证。
- 采用年度商业总可捕量（TACC）管理，渔季12个月。
- ABARES统计2023–24年全国岩龙虾产值4.03亿澳元；预计岩龙虾价值上升带动2026–27年行业产值增长。
latest_update_en: 2026-03: ABARES cites higher wild rock lobster value as a driver of the 2026–27 sector GVP forecast (A$4.0bn).
latest_update_zh: 2026年3月：ABARES称野生岩龙虾价值上升为2026–27年行业产值预测（40亿澳元）的驱动因素之一。

name: Northern Prawn Fishery
nature_en: Commonwealth otter-trawl fishery for banana, tiger and endeavour prawns across northern Australia
nature_zh: 联邦拖网渔业，捕捞北澳香蕉虾、虎虾及Endeavour虾
basin_region: Gulf of Carpentaria / Joseph Bonaparte Gulf
location_note: Fishery centroid, Gulf of Carpentaria (spans QLD, NT, WA)
owners: Statutory fishing right holders; co-managed with NPF Industry Pty Ltd
capacity_note: GVP is 2023–24; 52 boat SFRs cap active vessels
description_en:
Australia's largest Commonwealth prawn fishery, from Cape York to Cape Londonderry.
- 2025 catch 2,935 t (banana 1,770 t, tiger 819 t), down from 5,510 t in 2024; 46 vessels fished.
- Fishery value A$77.6m in 2023–24.
- 52 boat SFRs and 35,479 gear SFRs; seasons 1 Apr–15 Jun and 1 Aug–late Nov.
- MSC certified since 2012 (re-awarded 2018).
description_zh:
澳大利亚最大联邦对虾渔业，范围自约克角至伦敦德里角。
- 2025年捕捞量2,935吨（香蕉虾1,770吨、虎虾819吨），2024年为5,510吨；46艘渔船作业。
- 2023–24年渔业产值7,760万澳元。
- 渔船捕捞权52份、网具捕捞权35,479份；渔季4月1日–6月15日及8月1日–11月下旬。
- 2012年起获MSC认证（2018年续证）。
latest_update_en: 2026-04: AFMA 2025 data summary shows catch fell to 2,935 t from 5,510 t in 2024.
latest_update_zh: 2026年4月：AFMA 2025年数据摘要显示捕捞量由2024年5,510吨降至2,935吨。

name: Southern Rock Lobster fisheries (SA/VIC/TAS)
name_zh: 南部岩龙虾渔业（南澳/维州/塔州）
nature_en: State-managed quota pot fisheries for southern rock lobster (Jasus edwardsii)
nature_zh: 各州配额管理的南部岩龙虾（Jasus edwardsii）笼捕渔业
owners: Quota-holding licensees across SA, VIC and TAS
capacity_note: 2025–26; VIC Western Zone 245 t and Eastern Zone 21 t; TAS and SA Northern Zone TACCs not verified
description_en:
Southern rock lobster is fished under separate state quota systems; SA Southern Zone is the largest verified TACC.
- SA Southern Zone TACC 1,320 t for 2025–26 (quota unit 111.09 kg).
- Victoria: Western Zone 245 t, Eastern Zone 21 t (held since 2023/24); 2026/27 recommendation unchanged.
- Exports mainly live product; national rock lobster GVP A$403m in 2023–24 (all species).
description_zh:
南部岩龙虾由各州独立配额体系管理，已核实最大TACC为南澳南区。
- 南澳南区2025–26年TACC 1,320吨（每配额单位111.09公斤）。
- 维州：西区245吨、东区21吨（2023/24年起维持），2026/27年建议不变。
- 以活体出口为主；2023–24年全国岩龙虾产值4.03亿澳元（全品种）。
latest_update_en: 2025: SA set 2025–26 Southern Zone TACC at 1,320 t; VIC advisory group recommends unchanged 2026/27 TACCs.
latest_update_zh: 2025年：南澳设定2025–26年南区TACC为1,320吨；维州咨询组建议2026/27年TACC维持不变。

name: Spencer Gulf & West Coast Prawn Fisheries
name_zh: 斯潘塞湾及西海岸对虾渔业
nature_en: Western king prawn trawl fisheries in SA gulfs
nature_zh: 南澳海湾西部王对虾拖网渔业
owners: 39 Spencer Gulf licences; 3 West Coast licences
description_en:
Spencer Gulf Prawn Fishery is SA's main prawn trawl fishery, with 39 licences unchanged for 20 years.
- 2023/24 catch 1,465 t (-7%); GVP A$23.65m, the lowest real value in the 20-year series.
- Peak recent GVP A$43.7m nominal in 2017/18 (2,361 t).
- West Coast Prawn Fishery has 3 licences; western king prawn stock rated 'depleting' for 2023.
description_zh:
斯潘塞湾对虾渔业为南澳主要对虾拖网渔业，39张牌照20年未变。
- 2023/24年捕捞量1,465吨（-7%），产值2,365万澳元，为20年序列实际值最低。
- 近年峰值为2017/18年名义产值4,370万澳元（2,361吨）。
- 西海岸对虾渔业3张牌照，2023年西部王对虾资源评级为“衰减中”。
latest_update_en: 2025-06: BDO economic report for PIRSA shows 2023/24 GVP A$23.65m.
latest_update_zh: 2025年6月：BDO为PIRSA编制的经济报告显示2023/24年产值2,365万澳元。

name: Abalone fisheries (TAS/VIC/SA/WA)
name_zh: 鲍鱼渔业（塔州/维州/南澳/西澳）
nature_en: Dive fisheries for blacklip and greenlip abalone under state quota systems
nature_zh: 各州配额管理的黑唇鲍、绿唇鲍潜水捕捞渔业
location_note: Representative point: south-west Tasmania (largest state fishery)
owners: Quota-holding licensees across TAS, VIC, SA, WA
capacity_note: GVP is national abalone total (wild + farmed), ABARES
description_en:
Wild abalone is a high-value export dive fishery spread across four southern states, led by Tasmania.
- National abalone GVP A$152m in 2023–24 (+2%), wild and farmed combined.
- ABARES projects abalone value to decline ~1% a year to 2028–29.
- State TACCs not verified in this review.
description_zh:
野生鲍鱼为高价值出口型潜水渔业，分布于南部四州，塔州规模最大。
- 2023–24年全国鲍鱼产值1.52亿澳元（+2%），含捕捞与养殖。
- ABARES预计至2028–29年鲍鱼产值年降约1%。
- 本次未核实各州TACC。
latest_update_en: 2025-04: ABARES Outlook projects abalone value declining ~1%/yr.
latest_update_zh: 2025年4月：ABARES展望预计鲍鱼产值年降约1%。

name: Southern Bluefin Tuna Fishery (Commonwealth)
name_zh: 南方蓝鳍金枪鱼渔业（联邦）
nature_en: Commonwealth purse-seine and longline fishery under CCSBT allocation
nature_zh: CCSBT配额下的联邦围网及延绳钓渔业
owners: Quota SFR holders, mainly Port Lincoln ranching companies
capacity_note: 2025–26 TAC; Australia CCSBT allocation 7,341 t (2024–26); 5% set aside for recreational fishing
description_en:
Commonwealth fishery supplying the Port Lincoln ranching sector; landing ports Port Lincoln, Ulladulla, Bermagui.
- TAC 6,930 t for 2025–26.
- Global CCSBT TAC 20,647 t for 2024–26; Australia allocation 7,341 t (effective limit 7,295 t).
- Fishery value A$46.87m in 2023–24 (AFMA; landed value before ranching).
description_zh:
联邦渔业，为林肯港育肥养殖供应原料；主要卸货港为林肯港、Ulladulla、Bermagui。
- 2025–26年TAC为6,930吨。
- 2024–26年CCSBT全球TAC 20,647吨，澳方配额7,341吨（有效上限7,295吨）。
- 2023–24年渔业产值4,687万澳元（AFMA，育肥前卸货价值）。
latest_update_en: 2025-09: CCSBT extended scientific committee recommended global TAC 23,647 t/yr for 2027–29.
latest_update_zh: 2025年9月：CCSBT扩大科学委员会建议2027–29年全球TAC为每年23,647吨。

name: Heard Island and McDonald Islands Fishery (toothfish)
name_zh: 赫德岛和麦克唐纳群岛渔业（齿鱼）
nature_en: Sub-Antarctic longline/trawl fishery for Patagonian toothfish and mackerel icefish
nature_zh: 亚南极延绳钓/拖网渔业，捕捞巴塔哥尼亚齿鱼及鲭冰鱼
owners: Small number of quota holders (value confidential per AFMA)
capacity_note: Season 1 Dec 2025–30 Nov 2026; mackerel icefish TAC 1,427 t
description_en:
Remote Commonwealth fishery in Australia's sub-Antarctic EEZ, aligned with CCAMLR.
- 2025–26 TACs: Patagonian toothfish 2,119 t; mackerel icefish 1,427 t; unicorn icefish 1,663 t.
- Demersal longline for toothfish; trawl for icefish (max three trawl boats at once).
- Fishery value confidential due to the small number of operators; MSC certified.
description_zh:
澳大利亚亚南极专属经济区内的偏远联邦渔业，与CCAMLR规则衔接。
- 2025–26年TAC：巴塔哥尼亚齿鱼2,119吨，鲭冰鱼1,427吨，独角冰鱼1,663吨。
- 齿鱼采用底层延绳钓，冰鱼采用拖网（同时作业拖网船不超过3艘）。
- 运营商数量少，产值保密；获MSC认证。
latest_update_en: 2025-11: AFMA TAC Determination 2025 set toothfish TAC at 2,119 t for 2025–26.
latest_update_zh: 2025年11月：AFMA《2025年TAC决定》将2025–26年齿鱼TAC定为2,119吨。

name: Southern and Eastern Scalefish and Shark Fishery (SESSF)
name_zh: 南部及东部鳍鱼和鲨鱼渔业（SESSF）
nature_en: Multi-sector Commonwealth trawl, hook, gillnet and trap fishery across south-eastern Australia
nature_zh: 覆盖东南澳的多作业方式联邦渔业（拖网、钓、刺网、笼捕）
basin_region: South-east Australia (Fraser Island to Cape Leeuwin)
owners: 146 SFRs across trawl, hook and gillnet sectors
capacity_note: 2026–27 TAC for the largest quota species; 34 quota species
description_en:
Australia's largest Commonwealth finfish fishery by area, covering almost half the Australian Fishing Zone.
- GVP A$98.58m in 2022–23.
- Six sectors incl. South East Trawl, Shark Gillnet, GAB Trawl; 34 quota species.
- Key species: blue grenadier (2026–27 TAC 14,650 t), tiger flathead, gummy shark, pink ling.
description_zh:
按面积计为澳大利亚最大联邦鳍鱼渔业，覆盖近半个澳大利亚渔业区。
- 2022–23年产值9,858万澳元。
- 六个作业部门，含东南拖网、鲨鱼刺网、大澳湾拖网；34个配额品种。
- 主要品种：蓝鳕（2026–27年TAC 14,650吨）、虎头鲬、星鲨、粉红鳕。
latest_update_en: 2026: AFMA set 2026–27 blue grenadier TAC at 14,650 t.
latest_update_zh: 2026年：AFMA设定2026–27年蓝鳕TAC为14,650吨。

name: Eastern Tuna and Billfish Fishery
name_zh: 东部金枪鱼及旗鱼渔业
nature_en: Commonwealth pelagic longline fishery off eastern Australia
nature_zh: 东澳外海联邦中上层延绳钓渔业
owners: 79 longline boat SFRs; 83 minor line boat SFRs
capacity_note: 2026 TACCs: yellowfin 2,880 t, albacore 2,500 t, bigeye 1,056 t, swordfish 1,047 t, striped marlin 351 t
description_en:
Longline fishery from Cape York to the SA/VIC border, extending to adjacent high seas.
- Fishery value A$38.6m in 2023–24.
- 2026 TACCs: yellowfin 2,880 t, albacore 2,500 t, bigeye 1,056 t, swordfish 1,047 t, striped marlin 351 t.
- 79 longline and 83 minor-line boat SFRs.
description_zh:
延绳钓渔业，范围自约克角至南澳/维州边界并延伸至公海。
- 2023–24年渔业产值3,860万澳元。
- 2026年TACC：黄鳍金枪鱼2,880吨、长鳍金枪鱼2,500吨、大眼金枪鱼1,056吨、剑鱼1,047吨、条纹四鳍旗鱼351吨。
- 延绳钓渔船捕捞权79份，小型钓具渔船捕捞权83份。
latest_update_en: 2026: AFMA set 2026-season TACCs (yellowfin 2,880 t).
latest_update_zh: 2026年：AFMA发布2026渔季TACC（黄鳍金枪鱼2,880吨）。

name: Queensland East Coast Otter Trawl Fishery
name_zh: 昆士兰东海岸拖网渔业
nature_en: State otter-trawl fishery for prawns, scallops and bugs along the QLD east coast incl. GBR waters
nature_zh: 昆士兰东海岸（含大堡礁海域）州管拖网渔业，捕捞对虾、扇贝、琵琶虾
basin_region: Queensland east coast / Great Barrier Reef
location_note: Representative point: central GBR trawl grounds off Townsville
description_en:
Queensland's main prawn trawl fishery, operating partly inside the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park.
- Targets tiger, endeavour, king and banana prawns, saucer scallops and Moreton Bay bugs.
- Managed by effort units and spatial closures under a harvest strategy.
- Catch and value figures not verified in this review.
description_zh:
昆士兰主要对虾拖网渔业，部分作业区位于大堡礁海洋公园内。
- 目标品种：虎虾、Endeavour虾、王对虾、香蕉虾、碟形扇贝及摩顿湾琵琶虾。
- 依捕捞策略以努力量单位及空间禁渔区管理。
- 本次未核实捕捞量及产值。
latest_update_en: No dated 2025–26 development verified.
latest_update_zh: 未核实到2025–26年具体进展。

name: Torres Strait fisheries (Tropical Rock Lobster)
name_zh: 托雷斯海峡渔业（热带岩龙虾）
nature_en: PZJA-managed Torres Strait fisheries; Tropical Rock Lobster is the main commercial fishery, shared with PNG
nature_zh: PZJA管理的托雷斯海峡渔业，主要商业渔业为热带岩龙虾，与巴布亚新几内亚共享
owners: Traditional Inhabitant Boat sector (quota held in trust by TSRA) and Transferable Vessel Holders
capacity_note: 2025–26 revised TAC; global TAC 398.3 t with PNG entitlement 70 t
description_en:
Torres Strait fisheries operate under the 1985 Australia–PNG Torres Strait Treaty and are managed by the PZJA.
- TRL TAC raised from 200 t to 268.85 t on 5 Feb 2026 (TIB 178.0 t; TVH 90.9 t).
- Global TAC 398.3 t under proposed catch-sharing; PNG entitlement 70 t.
- Other fisheries: prawn, beche-de-mer, finfish, pearl shell, Spanish mackerel, crab, trochus.
description_zh:
托雷斯海峡渔业依1985年澳巴《托雷斯海峡条约》运营，由PZJA管理。
- 2026年2月5日热带岩龙虾TAC由200吨上调至268.85吨（传统居民船队178.0吨，可转让船队90.9吨）。
- 拟议捕捞分配下全球TAC 398.3吨，巴新配额70吨。
- 其他渔业：对虾、海参、鳍鱼、珍珠贝、康氏马鲛、蟹、马蹄螺。
latest_update_en: 2026-02: TRL TAC for 2025–26 increased to 268.852 t; harvest strategy revised Dec 2025.
latest_update_zh: 2026年2月：2025–26年热带岩龙虾TAC上调至268.852吨；捕捞策略于2025年12月修订。

name: Gorgon Carbon Dioxide Injection Project
nature_en: CCS: reservoir CO2 stripped at Gorgon LNG, injected into saline aquifer beneath Barrow Island
nature_zh: CCS：Gorgon LNG脱除的储层CO2回注至Barrow岛下方咸水层
owners: Gorgon JV: Chevron 47.333% (operator), ExxonMobil 25%, Shell 25%, Osaka Gas 1.25%, Tokyo Gas 1%, JERA 0.417%
capacity_note: design injection rate ~4 Mtpa (80% of reservoir CO2); actual ~one-third of design
description_en:
Australia's only operating large-scale CCS project, injecting reservoir CO2 separated at the Gorgon LNG plant.
- Injection began August 2019; cumulative injection >11 Mt CO2 by May 2025 (Chevron).
- FY2024-25 stored volume 1.33 Mt, about one-third of the ~4 Mtpa design rate; FY2023-24 was 1.6 Mt.
- Shortfall caused by reservoir pressure management limits; Chevron added water-production wells and treatment to relieve pressure.
- Shortfall is covered by carbon offsets under WA conditions; A$60m federal LETDF grant.
description_zh:
澳大利亚唯一在运的大型CCS项目，回注Gorgon LNG厂分离出的储层CO2。
- 2019年8月开始回注；截至2025年5月累计回注逾1,100万吨CO2（雪佛龙数据）。
- 2024-25财年封存133万吨，约为设计回注率（约400万吨/年）的三分之一；2023-24财年为160万吨。
- 回注不足源于储层压力管控约束；雪佛龙已增建产水井及水处理设施以泄压。
- 缺口按西澳审批条件以碳信用抵消；联邦LETDF拨款6,000万澳元。
latest_update_en: 2025-12: Chevron indicated injection will stay materially below nameplate through at least 2027 (Energy Intelligence); FY2024-25 stored 1.33 Mt.
latest_update_zh: 2025年12月：雪佛龙表示至少至2027年回注量将低于铭牌能力（Energy Intelligence报道）；2024-25财年封存133万吨。

name: Bayu-Undan CCS
nature_en: CCS: CO2 captured at Darwin LNG (Barossa gas) piped back to depleted Bayu-Undan field
nature_zh: CCS：Darwin LNG厂（Barossa气源）捕集的CO2经管道回注枯竭的Bayu-Undan气田
location_note: field location approx.; field lies in Timor-Leste jurisdiction since 2019 maritime boundary treaty; capture plant onshore at Darwin
owners: Santos (operator); Bayu-Undan JV partners incl. SK E&S, INPEX, Eni, JERA, Tokyo Gas (CCS-phase equity not confirmed)
capacity_note: proposed capacity per Santos (Argus, Feb 2026)
description_en:
Proposed conversion of the depleted Bayu-Undan gas field into a CO2 storage hub, starting with Darwin LNG emissions.
- Target capacity up to 10 Mtpa CO2; FEED complete, project in pre-FID phase.
- Santos guides FID in 2H 2027, subject to Timor-Leste approvals for CO2 transport and storage.
- Australian Industry Participation summary (2026) puts Darwin capture-side capex at A$0.5-1bn, estimated completion October 2030.
- Darwin LNG resumed exports in January 2026 on high-CO2 Barossa gas, the first anchor source.
description_zh:
拟将枯竭的Bayu-Undan气田改造为CO2封存枢纽，首期气源为Darwin LNG排放。
- 规划能力最高1,000万吨/年；FEED已完成，处于FID前阶段。
- 桑托斯预计2027年下半年FID，前提是东帝汶批准CO2运输及封存。
- 2026年澳大利亚产业参与计划摘要显示，达尔文捕集端资本开支5亿至10亿澳元，预计2030年10月完工。
- Darwin LNG于2026年1月以高含CO2的Barossa气恢复出口，为首个锚定气源。
latest_update_en: 2026-02: Santos CEO guided FID in 2H 2027 (Argus); 2026-07 AIPP summary lists completion Oct 2030.
latest_update_zh: 2026年2月：桑托斯CEO表示FID预计在2027年下半年（Argus）；2026年7月AIPP摘要列明2030年10月完工。

name: Bonaparte CCS (G-7-AP)
nature_en: CCS: offshore saline-aquifer storage hub for Ichthys LNG and third-party CO2
nature_zh: CCS：海上咸水层封存枢纽，接收Ichthys LNG及第三方CO2
location_note: permit area approx. 260 km offshore Darwin (representative point)
owners: INPEX Browse E&P 53% (operator), TotalEnergies CCS Australia 26%, Woodside 21%
capacity_note: up to 10 Mtpa storage capacity
description_en:
INPEX-led CCS hub in greenhouse gas assessment permit G-7-AP, awarded in the 2021 acreage round.
- Up to 10 Mtpa CO2 storage, sourced from Ichthys LNG and other Darwin emitters.
- Pre-FEED started April 2025; federal Major Project Status granted July 2025.
- Government declared an identified greenhouse gas storage formation in October 2026.
- First injection targeted early 2030s, subject to approvals and commercial agreements.
description_zh:
INPEX牵头的CCS枢纽，位于2021年招标获授的温室气体评估许可证G-7-AP。
- 封存能力最高1,000万吨/年CO2，气源为Ichthys LNG及达尔文其他排放源。
- 2025年4月启动预FEED；2025年7月获联邦重大项目地位。
- 2026年10月获政府宣告为已识别温室气体封存地层。
- 目标2030年代初首次回注，取决于审批及商业协议。
latest_update_en: 2026-10: Declaration of identified greenhouse gas storage formation received for G-7-AP.
latest_update_zh: 2026年10月：G-7-AP获已识别温室气体封存地层宣告。

name: CarbonNet Pelican
nature_en: CCS: Gippsland industrial CO2 piped from Latrobe Valley to offshore Pelican saline storage site
nature_zh: CCS：Latrobe Valley工业CO2经管道输送至海上Pelican咸水层封存
location_note: storage site ~10 km offshore Golden Beach (approx.); pipeline crosses state waters
owners: State of Victoria (development partner being sought)
capacity_note: up to 6 Mtpa over 30 years; P90 storage >=168 Mt
description_en:
Victorian Government CCS project to store Latrobe Valley and Gippsland CO2 in Bass Strait.
- Capacity up to 6 Mtpa over 30 years; P90 storage at least 168 Mt, 1.5 km below seabed.
- ~100 km pipeline Loy Yang to Golden Beach (80 km onshore, 20 km offshore); up to six injection wells.
- FEED completed 2024; Pelican and Kookaburra Declarations of Storage Formation planned for 2026.
- Operation expected late 2030s once a development partner is in place.
description_zh:
维州政府CCS项目，将Latrobe Valley及Gippsland排放的CO2封存于巴斯海峡。
- 能力最高600万吨/年，运营30年；P90封存量不低于1.68亿吨，位于海床下1.5公里。
- Loy Yang至Golden Beach管道约100公里（陆上80公里、海上20公里）；最多6口注入井。
- 2024年完成FEED；计划2026年为Pelican及Kookaburra申报封存地层宣告。
- 引入开发合作方后，预计2030年代末投运。
latest_update_en: 2026-04: CarbonNet still seeking development partner; DoSF submission for Pelican and Kookaburra listed as 2026 objective.
latest_update_zh: 2026年4月：CarbonNet仍在寻找开发合作方；Pelican及Kookaburra封存地层宣告申报列为2026年目标。

name: Cliff Head CO2 Storage (Mid West Clean Energy Project)
name_zh: Cliff Head CO2封存项目（中西部清洁能源项目）
nature_en: CCS: repurpose depleted Cliff Head oil field and pipeline for CO2 storage
nature_zh: CCS：利用枯竭的Cliff Head油田及管道改作CO2封存
location_note: Cliff Head field approx.; onshore Arrowsmith plant near Dongara
owners: Pilot Energy (moving to 100%; offshore JV transfer pending NOPTA approval); plans sell-down up to 60% of CCS project
capacity_note: 2C contingent storage resource 72.2 Mt (WA-31-L, 100% basis, Dec 2025); declared formation capacity 13.4 Mt (2024)
description_en:
Pilot Energy plan to convert the Cliff Head oil field off Dongara into a CO2 storage site.
- Declaration of storage formation granted June 2024 (13.4 Mt for initial stage).
- 2C storage resource upgraded to 72.2 Mt in December 2025, from 45.6 Mt.
- Oil production ceased; facilities transitioned to non-production phase.
- A foreign state-owned enterprise withdrew a proposed 20% stake in September 2025.
description_zh:
Pilot Energy拟将Dongara外海Cliff Head油田改作CO2封存场地。
- 2024年6月获封存地层宣告（首期1,340万吨）。
- 2025年12月2C封存资源量由4,560万吨上调至7,220万吨。
- 油田已停产，设施转入非生产阶段。
- 一家外国国有企业于2025年9月撤回拟收购的20%权益。
latest_update_en: 2025-12: 2C storage resource raised to 72.2 Mt; DoSF amendment and EPBC referral planned for Q1 2026.
latest_update_zh: 2025年12月：2C封存资源量上调至7,220万吨；计划2026年一季度提交封存地层宣告修订及EPBC申报。

name: Angel CCS (G-10-AP)
nature_en: GHG assessment permit: depleted Angel gas field as storage for Karratha-area emissions
nature_zh: 温室气体评估许可证：以枯竭的Angel气田封存Karratha地区排放
location_note: permit area ~125 km NW of Dampier (approx.)
description_en:
North West Shelf partners' CO2 storage permit covering the depleted Angel gas field.
- Permit G-10-AP awarded 31 August 2022 under the 2021 acreage release.
- 1,775 km2 permit, about 125 km northwest of Dampier.
- Five equal 20% holders: Woodside (operator), bp, MIMI, Shell, Chevron.
description_zh:
西北大陆架合作方持有的CO2封存许可证，覆盖枯竭的Angel气田。
- G-10-AP于2022年8月31日在2021年招标轮次中获授。
- 许可面积1,775平方公里，位于Dampier西北约125公里。
- 五方各持20%：伍德赛德（运营商）、英国石油bp、MIMI（三井/三菱）、壳牌、雪佛龙。
latest_update_en: 2022-09: Permit awarded; no development concept announced as at Oct 2026 (not verified beyond award).
latest_update_zh: 2022年9月：许可证获授；截至2026年10月未见开发方案公告（仅核实至授予环节）。

name: Santos Bonaparte CCS (G-11-AP)
nature_en: GHG assessment permit: offshore CO2 storage appraisal in the Bonaparte Basin
nature_zh: 温室气体评估许可证：Bonaparte盆地海上CO2封存评价
location_note: representative point within large permit area (approx.)
description_en:
Santos-operated CO2 storage assessment permit offshore the Northern Territory.
- Permit G-11-AP covers about 26,239 km2.
- Holders: Santos (operator), Chevron and SK E&S.
- Up to three appraisal wells planned; no wells drilled per CarbonStorage.io listing.
description_zh:
桑托斯运营的北领地外海CO2封存评估许可证。
- G-11-AP面积约26,239平方公里。
- 持有方：桑托斯（运营商）、雪佛龙、SK E&S。
- 计划最多钻3口评价井；据CarbonStorage.io尚未钻井。
latest_update_en: 2024-08: Chevron confirmed non-operated interest in G-11-AP; appraisal programme of up to three wells planned.
latest_update_zh: 2024年8月：雪佛龙确认持有G-11-AP非作业权益；计划最多3口评价井。

name: CStore1 floating CCS hub (G-14-AP)
nature_en: GHG assessment permit: ship-fed floating CO2 injection hub
nature_zh: 温室气体评估许可证：船运供气的浮式CO2注入枢纽
owners: deepC Store (operator), Azuli (Australia); also hold G-13-AP
capacity_note: G-14-AP storage potential ~1 Gt (company estimate)
description_en:
Independent floating CCS hub concept taking shipped liquefied CO2 from Australian and Asian emitters.
- Permits G-13-AP and G-14-AP granted 1 August 2024 to deepC Store and Azuli.
- G-14-AP estimated storage potential about 1 Gt CO2 (company estimate).
- TGS contracted in February 2025 for well planning and storage verification.
description_zh:
独立浮式CCS枢纽方案，接收澳大利亚及亚洲排放源船运的液态CO2。
- G-13-AP及G-14-AP于2024年8月1日授予deepC Store与Azuli。
- G-14-AP封存潜力约10亿吨CO2（公司估算）。
- 2025年2月委托TGS开展井位规划及封存量核实。
latest_update_en: 2025-02: TGS engaged for storage resource verification on G-14-AP during 2025.
latest_update_zh: 2025年2月：委托TGS于2025年开展G-14-AP封存资源核实。

name: InCapture G-15-AP
nature_en: GHG assessment permit: CO2 storage appraisal offshore Burrup Peninsula
nature_zh: 温室气体评估许可证：Burrup半岛外海CO2封存评价
location_note: permit area 120-150 km offshore Burrup Peninsula (approx.)
description_en:
Third-party CO2 storage permit serving Pilbara and Asian emitters.
- About 6,500 km2, 120-150 km offshore the Burrup Peninsula.
- Wood awarded Development Concept Engineering in January 2026; Halliburton running parallel subsurface assessment.
- Studies to conclude within two years, supporting a future Declaration of Storage Formation.
description_zh:
面向皮尔巴拉及亚洲排放源的第三方CO2封存许可证。
- 面积约6,500平方公里，距Burrup半岛120至150公里。
- 2026年1月Wood获开发概念工程合同；哈里伯顿并行开展地下评价。
- 研究两年内完成，为后续封存地层宣告提供依据。
latest_update_en: 2026-01: Wood awarded concept engineering for G-15-AP.
latest_update_zh: 2026年1月：Wood获G-15-AP概念工程合同。

name: Chevron Onslow CCS permit (G-18-AP)
nature_en: GHG assessment permit: potential storage hub for Wheatstone and third-party CO2
nature_zh: 温室气体评估许可证：潜在封存枢纽，服务Wheatstone及第三方CO2
owners: Chevron 70% (operator), Woodside 30%; 5% farm-down to GS Caltex agreed (subject to approval)
description_en:
Chevron-operated CO2 storage permit offshore Onslow, assessed as a multi-user hub.
- G-18-AP awarded August 2024; about 8,467 km2.
- Chevron 70% / Woodside 30%; 5% farm-down to Korea's GS Caltex agreed.
- Chevron also holds non-operated interests in G-9-AP, G-10-AP and G-11-AP.
description_zh:
雪佛龙运营的Onslow外海CO2封存许可证，按多用户枢纽评估。
- G-18-AP于2024年8月获授，面积约8,467平方公里。
- 雪佛龙70%、伍德赛德30%；已同意向韩国GS Caltex转让5%。
- 雪佛龙另持有G-9-AP、G-10-AP、G-11-AP非作业权益。
latest_update_en: 2024-08: Permit awarded.
latest_update_zh: 2024年8月：许可证获授。

name: Chevron Barrow Island CCS permit (G-20-AP)
nature_en: GHG assessment permit adjacent to Barrow Island, complementing Gorgon CCS
nature_zh: Barrow岛毗邻海域温室气体评估许可证，补充Gorgon CCS
location_note: permit area adjacent to Barrow Island (approx.)
owners: Chevron (operator), Shell, Mobil Australia Resources (ExxonMobil); equity not disclosed
description_en:
Gorgon-partner permit to test offshore storage next to Barrow Island.
- G-20-AP accepted 18 December 2024; 2,222 km2 in 25-125 m water depth.
- Holders: Chevron (operator), Shell and ExxonMobil affiliate Mobil.
- Offers alternative capacity as Gorgon onshore injection runs at about one-third of design.
description_zh:
Gorgon合作方持有的Barrow岛毗邻海域封存评估许可证。
- G-20-AP于2024年12月18日接受授予；面积2,222平方公里，水深25至125米。
- 持有方：雪佛龙（运营商）、壳牌、埃克森美孚旗下Mobil。
- Gorgon陆上回注约为设计能力三分之一，本许可提供替代封存能力。
latest_update_en: 2024-12: Permit accepted by Chevron-led JV.
latest_update_zh: 2024年12月：雪佛龙牵头的合资方接受许可证。

name: Woodside Browse CCS permit (G-8-AP)
nature_en: GHG assessment permit in the Browse Basin
nature_zh: Browse盆地温室气体评估许可证
description_en:
Woodside CO2 storage assessment permit offshore the Kimberley.
- G-8-AP (release area GHG21-3) awarded 2022 in the 2021 acreage round.
- One of the first two offshore GHG permits awarded since 2014, with G-7-AP.
- No development concept announced (not verified after award).
description_zh:
伍德赛德持有的金伯利外海CO2封存评估许可证。
- G-8-AP（招标区块GHG21-3）于2022年在2021年招标轮次中获授。
- 与G-7-AP同为2014年以来首批获授的海上温室气体许可证。
- 未见开发方案公告（获授后未再核实）。
latest_update_en: 2022-08: Permit award announced by Resources Minister.
latest_update_zh: 2022年8月：资源部长宣布授予许可证。

name: Beach Energy Otway CCS permit (G-21-AP)
nature_en: GHG assessment permit near Beach's Otway gas operations
nature_zh: 毗邻Beach Otway天然气业务的温室气体评估许可证
location_note: representative point in offshore Otway Basin (approx.)
description_en:
Beach Energy CO2 storage permit in the offshore Otway Basin.
- G-21-AP granted 18 December 2024 for an initial six-year term.
- Beach was also granted G-16-AP and G-17-AP on 6 August 2024.
- Beach has completed a pre-feasibility study for Otway CCS; progress depends on JV approvals.
description_zh:
Beach Energy持有的Otway盆地海上CO2封存许可证。
- G-21-AP于2024年12月18日获授，首期6年。
- Beach另于2024年8月6日获授G-16-AP及G-17-AP。
- Beach已完成Otway CCS预可研；推进需合资方批准。
latest_update_en: 2024-12: G-21-AP granted (Commonwealth Gazette).
latest_update_zh: 2024年12月：G-21-AP获授（联邦公报）。

name: South East Australia Carbon Capture Hub (Bream)
nature_en: CCS: storage in depleted Bream field via Gippsland infrastructure (withdrawn)
nature_zh: CCS：利用Gippsland设施封存于枯竭的Bream油气田（已撤回）
capacity_note: forecast average 0.5 Mtpa, max 3 Mtpa
description_en:
ExxonMobil-led Gippsland CCS proposal, withdrawn in 2025.
- Planned to store CO2 in the depleted Bream field; average 0.5 Mtpa, up to 3 Mtpa.
- Entered the EPBC process in 2023; partners Esso and Woodside.
- Exxon said Bream A platform is not needed for any CCS project and will be decommissioned.
description_zh:
埃克森美孚牵头的Gippsland CCS方案，2025年撤回。
- 原计划封存于枯竭的Bream油气田；平均50万吨/年，最高300万吨/年。
- 2023年进入EPBC审批；合作方为Esso及伍德赛德。
- 埃克森美孚表示Bream A平台无需用于CCS，将退役。
latest_update_en: 2025-03: Project withdrawn; Bream A platform to be decommissioned.
latest_update_zh: 2025年3月：项目撤回；Bream A平台将退役。

name: Perth Seawater Desalination Plant
nature_en: Seawater reverse-osmosis plant supplying Perth IWSS
nature_zh: 海水反渗透淡化厂，供应珀斯综合供水系统
owners: Water Corporation (WA Government); built and operated by private consortium under 25-year contract
capacity_note: 45 GL/yr nameplate
description_en:
Australia's first large seawater desalination plant.
- 45 GL/yr capacity; operating since 2006.
- Development cost A$387m; private consortium design-build-operate contract of 25 years.
- Power offset by 80 MW Emu Downs Wind Farm (270 GWh/yr vs plant need of 180 GWh/yr).
description_zh:
澳大利亚首座大型海水淡化厂。
- 产能45 GL/年；2006年投运。
- 开发成本3.87亿澳元；私营联合体设计建造并运营25年。
- 用电由80兆瓦Emu Downs风电场对冲（年发电270 GWh，淡化厂需180 GWh）。
latest_update_en: 2026-09: Water Corporation's third Perth plant (Alkimos) completed marine works; Kwinana remains in base-load service (no 2026 plant-specific update found).
latest_update_zh: 2026年9月：西澳水务第三座珀斯淡化厂（Alkimos）完成海上工程；Kwinana厂维持基荷运行（未见2026年专项更新）。

name: Southern Seawater Desalination Plant
nature_en: Seawater reverse-osmosis plant supplying Perth IWSS
nature_zh: 海水反渗透淡化厂，供应珀斯综合供水系统
owners: Water Corporation; private consortium (Sacyr-led) design-build-operate contract
capacity_note: expanded from 50 to 100 GL/yr in 2013
description_en:
Perth's largest desalination plant, about one-third of Perth's supply.
- 100 GL/yr after 2013 doubling from 50 GL/yr; opened September 2011.
- Cost reported as A$955m (Wikipedia) or A$1.4bn development cost incl. expansion (HK LegCo research).
- Private consortium operates under a 25-year contract.
description_zh:
珀斯最大淡化厂，约占珀斯供水三分之一。
- 2013年由50 GL/年扩至100 GL/年；2011年9月投运。
- 成本口径不一：9.55亿澳元（维基百科）或含扩建14亿澳元（香港立法会研究）。
- 私营联合体按25年合同运营。
latest_update_en: 2013-01: Full 100 GL/yr capacity reached (no 2025-26 plant-specific update found).
latest_update_zh: 2013年1月：达到100 GL/年满负荷（未见2025-26年专项更新）。

name: Alkimos Seawater Desalination Plant
nature_en: Perth's third seawater desalination plant, renewably powered
nature_zh: 珀斯第三座海水淡化厂，可再生能源供电
owners: Water Corporation; Alkimos SeaWater Alliance with Acciona and Jacobs (design, build, operate)
capacity_note: Stage 1 50 GL/yr; Stage 2 to 100 GL/yr subject to further investment
description_en:
Perth's next desalination plant, replacing declining groundwater supply.
- Stage 1 50 GL/yr, expandable to 100 GL/yr; first water scheduled 2028.
- Cost A$2.8bn (WA Government, Sept 2026).
- Alliance contract awarded April 2024 to Acciona and Jacobs.
- Tunnelling (32,000+ segments) and intake/outfall structures completed by September 2026.
description_zh:
珀斯下一座淡化厂，替代下降的地下水供给。
- 一期50 GL/年，可扩至100 GL/年；计划2028年首次供水。
- 投资28亿澳元（西澳政府2026年9月口径）。
- 2024年4月与Acciona、Jacobs签订联盟合同。
- 截至2026年9月，隧道（逾32,000片管片）及取排水结构完工。
latest_update_en: 2026-09: Two undersea tunnels completed; jack-up barge left site 28 July 2026 after installing intake/outfall structures.
latest_update_zh: 2026年9月：两条海底隧道完工；自升式驳船于2026年7月28日完成取排水结构安装后离场。

name: Sydney Desalination Plant
nature_en: Seawater reverse-osmosis plant supplying Sydney
nature_zh: 海水反渗透淡化厂，供应悉尼
owners: NSW Government (asset, 50-year lease from 2012) leased to SDP Pty Ltd: Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan 50%, Utilities Trust of Australia & The Infrastructure Fund 50%; Veolia operates
capacity_note: up to 250 ML/d, ~15% of Sydney's supply
description_en:
Sydney's only desalination plant, supplying up to 15% of demand.
- 250 ML/d capacity; operating since January 2010.
- Construction cost A$1.803bn; leased in 2012 for 50 years at A$2.3bn.
- Owned by Ontario Teachers' (50%) and UTA/TIF funds (50%); Veolia operates.
- Tunnels and pipeline sized for 500 ML/d.
description_zh:
悉尼唯一淡化厂，最高供应15%需求。
- 产能250 ML/日；2010年1月投运。
- 建设成本18.03亿澳元；2012年以23亿澳元出租50年。
- 安大略教师退休金计划持股50%，UTA及TIF基金持股50%；威立雅运营。
- 隧道及管道按500 ML/日设计。
latest_update_en: 2025-12: Plant reported operating at ~250 ML/d average; expansion awaiting government decision.
latest_update_zh: 2025年12月：工厂平均产量约250 ML/日；扩建待政府决策。

name: Sydney Desalination Plant Expansion
nature_en: Proposed doubling of Kurnell desalination output to 500 ML/d
nature_zh: 拟将Kurnell淡化产能翻倍至500 ML/日
owners: Sydney Desalination Plant Pty Ltd; NSW Government decision
capacity_note: incremental 250 ML/d (to 500 ML/d total), ~90 GL/yr extra
description_en:
Expansion option revived by the NSW Government in October 2023.
- Would add 250 ML/d, taking capacity to 500 ML/d (~30% of Sydney supply), +90 GL/yr.
- Existing tunnels, pipeline, land and planning approvals already accommodate expansion.
- If approved, programme ~6 years including 3.5-4 years construction; to be renewably powered.
description_zh:
新州政府于2023年10月重启的扩建方案。
- 新增250 ML/日，总产能达500 ML/日（约占悉尼供水30%），年增90 GL。
- 现有隧道、管道、用地及规划审批已覆盖扩建。
- 获批后工期约6年，其中建设调试3.5至4年；全部使用可再生电力。
latest_update_en: 2025-12: No government approval yet; timing tied to water security planning.
latest_update_zh: 2025年12月：尚未获政府批准；时间表取决于供水安全规划。

name: Victorian Desalination Plant
nature_en: Seawater reverse-osmosis plant supplying Melbourne and regional Victoria
nature_zh: 海水反渗透淡化厂，供应墨尔本及维州地区
owners: AquaSure PPP consortium (2009: Degremont/Suez, Macquarie Capital, Ventia); contract to 2039; Melbourne Water purchases water
capacity_note: 150 GL/yr, expandable to 200 GL/yr
description_en:
Australia's largest desalination plant, delivered as a PPP.
- 150 GL/yr, expandable to 200 GL/yr; completed December 2012.
- Fixed payments ~A$608m/yr regardless of orders; contract to 2039.
- First maximum 150 GL order placed for 2026-27, deliveries from 1 June 2026.
- A 50 GL expansion is among options under study; taskforce report due March 2027.
description_zh:
澳大利亚最大淡化厂，以PPP模式建设。
- 产能150 GL/年，可扩至200 GL/年；2012年12月建成。
- 无论订水量多少，年固定付费约6.08亿澳元；合同至2039年。
- 2026-27年度首次下达150 GL满额订单，2026年6月1日起供水。
- 50 GL扩建列入研究选项；供水安全工作组报告2027年3月提交。
latest_update_en: 2026-08: Water Minister did not rule out 50 GL expansion; 150 GL order for 2026-27 under way.
latest_update_zh: 2026年8月：维州水务部长未排除扩建50 GL；2026-27年度150 GL订单执行中。

name: Adelaide Desalination Plant
nature_en: Seawater reverse-osmosis plant supplying Adelaide
nature_zh: 海水反渗透淡化厂，供应阿德莱德
owners: SA Water; O&M by AdelaideAqua (Acciona/Trility) under 20-year contract
capacity_note: 100 GL/yr (300 ML/d) at full output
description_en:
SA Water-owned plant able to supply about half of Adelaide's needs.
- 100 GL/yr (300 ML/d); stage 1 October 2011, stage 2 July 2012.
- Final capital cost A$1.83bn.
- Ramped to 300 ML/d in January 2025 after a dry 2024, from 17 ML/d a year earlier.
description_zh:
南澳水务所有的淡化厂。
- 产能100 GL/年（300 ML/日）；一期2011年10月、二期2012年7月投产。
- 最终资本开支18.3亿澳元。
- 2024年干旱后，2025年1月产量升至300 ML/日（上年同期17 ML/日）。
latest_update_en: 2025-01: Output increased to full 300 ML/d through mid-2025 due to low reservoir levels.
latest_update_zh: 2025年1月：因水库水位偏低，产量提升至300 ML/日满负荷，持续至2025年年中。

name: Northern Water Supply Project
nature_en: Proposed Spencer Gulf desalination plant and pipeline to Upper Spencer Gulf, Far North and Olympic Dam
nature_zh: 拟建Spencer湾淡化厂及输水管线，供应上Spencer湾、远北地区及Olympic Dam
location_note: Mullaquana Station site ~20 km south of Whyalla (approx.)
owners: SA Government (Northern Water Project Delivery Office) with BHP as foundation partner
description_en:
State-led industrial water project for mining and hydrogen in northern SA.
- Desalination site moved to Mullaquana Station near Whyalla, replacing Cape Hardy (reported December 2025).
- Estimated cost about A$5bn (press report); pipeline to Olympic Dam and Carrapateena.
- Pre-FID; FID reportedly expected toward end-2026.
description_zh:
州政府主导的工业供水项目，服务南澳北部采矿及氢能。
- 淡化厂选址由Cape Hardy改为Whyalla附近Mullaquana牧场（2025年12月报道）。
- 估算投资约50亿澳元（媒体报道）；管线延伸至Olympic Dam及Carrapateena。
- 处于FID前阶段；据报FID预计2026年底。
latest_update_en: 2025-12: Mullaquana selected as desalination site (Iron Road ASX citing The Advertiser); delivery office website updated Oct 2026 without new milestones.
latest_update_zh: 2025年12月：Mullaquana被选定为淡化厂址（Iron Road公告引述The Advertiser）；2026年10月项目网站更新，未披露新节点。

name: Eyre Peninsula Desalination Plant
nature_en: Seawater desalination plant at Billy Lights Point, Port Lincoln
nature_zh: Port Lincoln Billy Lights Point海水淡化厂
capacity_note: up to 16 ML/d; 5.3 GL/yr expandable to 8 GL/yr
description_en:
Regional plant to replace over-drawn Eyre Peninsula groundwater.
- Up to 16 ML/d (5.3 GL/yr, expandable to 8 GL/yr).
- A$330m budget in the 2023-24 State Budget; construction approved November 2024.
- Not a controlled action under EPBC; first water targeted mid-2026.
description_zh:
替代超采的Eyre半岛地下水的区域淡化厂。
- 产能最高16 ML/日（5.3 GL/年，可扩至8 GL/年）。
- 2023-24州预算拨款3.3亿澳元；2024年11月获建设批准。
- EPBC认定非受控行动；目标2026年年中首次供水。
latest_update_en: 2024-11: Construction approved; SA Water targeted first water mid-2026 (commissioning status not verified as at Oct 2026).
latest_update_zh: 2024年11月：获建设批准；南澳水务目标2026年年中首次供水（截至2026年10月调试状态未核实）。

name: Gold Coast Desalination Plant
nature_en: Seawater reverse-osmosis plant supplying the SEQ Water Grid
nature_zh: 海水反渗透淡化厂，供应东南昆士兰供水网
capacity_note: up to 43 GL/yr (133 ML/d)
description_en:
SEQ's only desalination plant, built during the Millennium Drought.
- Up to 43 GL/yr (133 ML/d); supplying the grid since February 2009.
- Cost A$1.2bn; owned by Seqwater since July 2011, operated by Veolia.
- Expansion in business-case stage; next major SEQ grid augmentation likely needed by ~2035.
description_zh:
东南昆州唯一淡化厂，建于千年干旱期间。
- 产能最高43 GL/年（133 ML/日）；2009年2月起向管网供水。
- 投资12亿澳元；2011年7月起归Seqwater所有，威立雅运营。
- 扩建处于商业论证阶段；东南昆州供水网下一轮主要扩容约需在2035年前到位。
latest_update_en: 2026: Seqwater refining expansion design, capacity and timing (business case stage).
latest_update_zh: 2026年：Seqwater细化扩建设计、规模及时间表（商业论证阶段）。

name: SEQ second desalination plant
name_zh: 东南昆州第二座海水淡化厂
nature_en: Proposed new SEQ desalination plant (candidate site Kawana, Sunshine Coast)
nature_zh: 拟建东南昆州新淡化厂（候选厂址阳光海岸Kawana）
description_en:
New desalination plant in Queensland's 30-year SEQ water strategy.
- Kawana (Sunshine Coast) named as possible site; location subject to business case.
- Early cost estimates A$4-8bn (press, 2023).
- Delivery targeted around 2035.
description_zh:
昆州东南部30年供水战略中的新建淡化厂。
- 阳光海岸Kawana为候选厂址，最终选址取决于商业论证。
- 早期估算40亿至80亿澳元（2023年媒体）。
- 目标约2035年交付。
latest_update_en: 2026: Seqwater indicates next major grid augmentation needed by ~2035; site and capacity not confirmed.
latest_update_zh: 2026年：Seqwater表示下一轮主要扩容约需在2035年前完成；厂址及规模未定。

name: Dampier Seawater Desalination Plant
nature_en: Seawater desalination for West Pilbara Water Supply Scheme and Rio Tinto operations
nature_zh: 海水淡化，供应西皮尔巴拉供水系统及力拓业务
owners: 50:50 JV Rio Tinto (operator) and WA Government
capacity_note: Stage 1 4 GL/yr (2026) + Stage 2 4 GL/yr (2027)
description_en:
Pilbara's first large seawater desalination plant, shared by industry and towns.
- Stage 1 adds 4 GL/yr in late 2026; Stage 2 adds 4 GL/yr with first water 2027.
- Combined A$1.1bn; 50:50 Rio Tinto / WA Government JV, Rio Tinto operates.
- Supplies Water Corporation's West Pilbara scheme (Karratha, Dampier).
description_zh:
皮尔巴拉首座大型海水淡化厂，工业与城镇共用。
- 一期2026年底新增4 GL/年；二期新增4 GL/年，2027年首次供水。
- 合计投资11亿澳元；力拓与西澳政府50:50合资，力拓运营。
- 供应西澳水务西皮尔巴拉供水系统（Karratha、Dampier）。
latest_update_en: 2026-03: Rio Tinto and WA Government formed JV; Stage 2 construction commenced.
latest_update_zh: 2026年3月：力拓与西澳政府成立合资公司；二期开工。

name: Cape Preston Desalination Plant (Sino Iron)
name_zh: Cape Preston海水淡化厂（中澳铁矿）
nature_en: Mining seawater desalination plant for Sino Iron magnetite operations
nature_zh: 矿业海水淡化厂，供应中澳铁矿（Sino Iron）磁铁矿项目
owners: CITIC Pacific Mining (CITIC Limited); built by IDE Technologies
capacity_note: 140,000 m3/d per IDE (~51 GL/yr if run continuously)
description_en:
Largest mining desalination plant in Australia, supporting Chinese-owned Sino Iron.
- 140,000 m3/d capacity (IDE Technologies).
- Commissioned 2013; modules fabricated in China.
- Supplies process water for magnetite concentrating at Cape Preston.
description_zh:
澳大利亚最大矿业淡化厂，配套中资中澳铁矿项目。
- 产能14万立方米/日（IDE Technologies数据）。
- 2013年投运；模块在中国制造。
- 为Cape Preston磁铁矿选矿提供工艺用水。
latest_update_en: 2013: Commissioned (no 2025-26 plant-specific update found).
latest_update_zh: 2013年：投运（未见2025-26年专项更新）。

name: Basslink
nature_en: HVDC electricity interconnector Victoria-Tasmania with fibre
nature_zh: 维州至塔州高压直流电力互联线，附光缆
location_note: mid-route point of subsea cable (McGaurans Beach VIC to Five Mile Bluff TAS)
capacity_note: 500 MW continuous; 630 MW TAS->VIC for up to 4 hours
description_en:
Only electricity link between Tasmania and the mainland NEM.
- 400 kV HVDC monopole; 290 km subsea, 370 km total route Loy Yang-George Town.
- 500 MW continuous; commercial trading since April 2006.
- 2015 six-month outage led to administration; APA bought it in 2022 for A$773m.
- Carries a 12-core fibre cable (commercial since 2009).
description_zh:
塔州与国家电力市场之间唯一电力通道。
- 400千伏高压直流单极；海底段290公里，Loy Yang至George Town全长370公里。
- 持续输送500兆瓦；2006年4月起商业运营。
- 2015年断线6个月致前业主破产管理；APA于2022年以7.73亿澳元收购。
- 附12芯光缆（2009年起商用）。
latest_update_en: 2025-06: AER approved conversion to a regulated transmission asset; APA targeted regulated operation from July 2026.
latest_update_zh: 2025年6月：AER批准转为受监管输电资产；APA目标2026年7月起按监管模式运营。

name: Marinus Link (Stage 1)
nature_en: HVDC electricity interconnector Tasmania-Victoria, second Bass Strait link
nature_zh: 塔州至维州高压直流互联线，巴斯海峡第二条电力通道
location_note: mid-route point (Heybridge TAS to Waratah Bay VIC)
capacity_note: Stage 1 750 MW; Stage 2 (+750 MW) deferred to ~2033 subject to demand; capex ~A$3bn (Sept 2023 estimate)
description_en:
New 750 MW HVDC link to unlock Tasmanian hydro and wind for the mainland.
- FID taken August 2025; completion targeted 2030.
- 345 km route: ~255 km subsea, ~90 km underground in Gippsland; converters at Heybridge and Hazelwood.
- Prysmian supplies cable; TasVic Greenlink (DT Infrastructure/Samsung C&T) won A$994m works contract.
- Stage 1 cost estimated ~A$3bn (Sept 2023); Stage 2 deferred to ~2033.
description_zh:
新建750兆瓦高压直流线路，将塔州水电及风电送往大陆。
- 2025年8月FID；目标2030年完工。
- 全长345公里：海底约255公里、Gippsland地下约90公里；换流站位于Heybridge及Hazelwood。
- 普睿司曼供应电缆；TasVic Greenlink（DT Infrastructure/三星物产）获9.94亿澳元工程合同。
- 一期成本约30亿澳元（2023年9月估算）；二期推迟至约2033年。
latest_update_en: 2025-12: Final major Stage 1 contract (A$994m) awarded; shore-crossing preparatory works at Waratah Bay and Heybridge scheduled from early 2026.
latest_update_zh: 2025年12月：一期最后一份主要合同（9.94亿澳元）授出；Waratah Bay及Heybridge登陆段预备工程排期2026年初开工。

name: Australia-Asia PowerLink (AAPowerLink)
nature_en: Solar + storage in NT with HVDC subsea export cable Darwin-Singapore
nature_zh: 北领地光伏加储能，经达尔文至新加坡高压直流海缆出口
location_note: representative point: cable departure offshore Darwin
owners: Grok Ventures (Mike Cannon-Brookes) controlling owner since 2023
capacity_note: 1.75 GW export to Singapore (EMA conditional licence); ~6 GW solar at Powell Creek
description_en:
Intercontinental renewable export project led by SunCable.
- ~4,300 km HVDC subsea cable to Singapore; 1.75 GW import conditionally approved by Singapore EMA (October 2024).
- Scope cut from 20 GW to ~6 GW solar at Powell Creek, NT (4 GW Darwin, up to 2 GW export).
- Federal environmental approval granted 2024; Major Project Status renewed July 2025.
- FID guided for 2027; total value A$40bn+.
description_zh:
SunCable牵头的跨洲可再生能源出口项目。
- 约4,300公里高压直流海缆至新加坡；2024年10月获新加坡能源市场管理局1.75吉瓦进口有条件批准。
- 规模由20吉瓦压缩至北领地Powell Creek约6吉瓦光伏（4吉瓦供达尔文，最多2吉瓦出口）。
- 2024年获联邦环境批准；2025年7月重大项目地位续期。
- FID指引2027年；总投资逾400亿澳元。
latest_update_en: 2025-07: Federal Major Project Status renewed; FID still targeted 2027 (no later milestone verified).
latest_update_zh: 2025年7月：联邦重大项目地位续期；FID仍定于2027年（未核实更新节点）。

name: Southern Cross Cable Network & Southern Cross NEXT
nature_en: International telecom cable Sydney-NZ-Fiji-US
nature_zh: 国际通信海缆：悉尼-新西兰-斐济-美国
owners: Southern Cross Cables Ltd: Spark NZ, Singtel/Optus, Telstra (25%), Verizon
capacity_note: Southern Cross NEXT design capacity 72 Tbps; original SCCN ~30,500 km ring
description_en:
Main trans-Pacific data route from Australia to the United States.
- Original SCCN in service November 2000; ~30,500 km ring via NZ, Fiji and Hawaii.
- Southern Cross NEXT (Sydney-Auckland-Fiji-Kiribati-Tokelau-Los Angeles) in service July 2022, adding 72 Tbps.
- Owners Spark NZ, Singtel/Optus, Telstra and Verizon.
description_zh:
澳大利亚至美国的主要跨太平洋数据通道。
- 原SCCN于2000年11月投运；环网约30,500公里，经新西兰、斐济、夏威夷。
- Southern Cross NEXT（悉尼-奥克兰-斐济-基里巴斯-托克劳-洛杉矶）2022年7月投运，新增72 Tbps。
- 股东为Spark NZ、新电信/Optus、澳洲电信Telstra、Verizon。
latest_update_en: 2022-07: Southern Cross NEXT entered service; SX Tasman Express (Clovelly-Whenuapai) planned for 2028.
latest_update_zh: 2022年7月：Southern Cross NEXT投运；SX Tasman Express（Clovelly-Whenuapai）计划2028年投运。

name: SX Tasman Express (SX-TX)
nature_en: Telecom cable Sydney-Auckland
nature_zh: 通信海缆：悉尼-奥克兰
description_en:
New Tasman Sea cable by the Southern Cross consortium.
- 2,276 km, Clovelly (NSW) to Whenuapai (NZ).
- Ready-for-service targeted 2028 (TeleGeography).
- Adds route diversity to TGA and Southern Cross.
description_zh:
Southern Cross联合体新建塔斯曼海海缆。
- 全长2,276公里，Clovelly（新州）至Whenuapai（新西兰）。
- 目标2028年投运（TeleGeography）。
- 为TGA及Southern Cross提供路由冗余。
latest_update_en: 2028 RFS listed by TeleGeography (as at Oct 2026).
latest_update_zh: TeleGeography列示2028年投运（截至2026年10月）。

name: Hawaiki Cable
nature_en: Trans-Pacific telecom cable Sydney-NZ-Hawaii-Oregon
nature_zh: 跨太平洋通信海缆：悉尼-新西兰-夏威夷-俄勒冈
capacity_note: design capacity raised from 43.8 to 67 Tbps (2020)
description_en:
Independent trans-Pacific cable linking Australia and New Zealand to the US west coast.
- ~15,000 km; commercial operations from July 2018.
- Capacity upgraded to 67 Tbps by June 2020.
- Owned by Singapore's BW Digital since May 2022; branches to New Caledonia and Tonga.
description_zh:
连接澳新与美国西海岸的独立跨太平洋海缆。
- 全长约15,000公里；2018年7月商用。
- 2020年6月容量升至67 Tbps。
- 2022年5月起由新加坡BW Digital持有；设新喀里多尼亚及汤加支线。
latest_update_en: 2026-05: Tonga branch commissioned; BW Digital planning Hawaiki Nui 1 (RFS 2029).
latest_update_zh: 2026年5月：汤加支线投运；BW Digital规划Hawaiki Nui 1（2029年投运）。

name: Hawaiki Nui 1
nature_en: Telecom cable linking Sydney, Brisbane, Darwin to Indonesia and Singapore
nature_zh: 通信海缆：悉尼、布里斯班、达尔文至印尼及新加坡
description_en:
BW Digital system linking eastern and northern Australia to Southeast Asia.
- ~10,000 km; landings Sydney, Brisbane, Darwin, Jakarta, Batam, Singapore; PNG, Solomons and Timor-Leste TBD.
- Ready-for-service targeted 2029.
- First new Darwin-Singapore route from the east coast.
description_zh:
BW Digital连接澳大利亚东部、北部与东南亚的系统。
- 约10,000公里；登陆悉尼、布里斯班、达尔文、雅加达、巴淡、新加坡；巴新、所罗门及东帝汶待定。
- 目标2029年投运。
- 东海岸经达尔文至新加坡的新路由。
latest_update_en: 2029 RFS listed by TeleGeography (as at Oct 2026).
latest_update_zh: TeleGeography列示2029年投运（截至2026年10月）。

name: INDIGO cable system (West & Central)
nature_en: Telecom cables Sydney-Perth and Perth-Jakarta-Singapore
nature_zh: 通信海缆：悉尼-珀斯、珀斯-雅加达-新加坡
owners: Consortium: AARNet, Google, Indosat Ooredoo, Singtel/Optus, Superloop, Telstra (West)
description_en:
Consortium cables giving Australia a southern route to Singapore.
- INDIGO-West: 4,600 km Perth-Jakarta-Singapore, RFS May 2019.
- INDIGO-Central: 4,850 km Sydney-Perth, RFS May 2019.
- Partners include AARNet, Google, Indosat Ooredoo, Singtel, Superloop and Telstra.
description_zh:
联合体海缆，为澳大利亚提供至新加坡的南线路由。
- INDIGO-West：珀斯-雅加达-新加坡4,600公里，2019年5月投运。
- INDIGO-Central：悉尼-珀斯4,850公里，2019年5月投运。
- 合作方包括AARNet、谷歌、Indosat Ooredoo、新电信、Superloop、澳洲电信Telstra。
latest_update_en: 2019-05: Both segments entered service.
latest_update_zh: 2019年5月：两段同时投运。

name: Australia-Singapore Cable (ASC)
nature_en: Telecom cable Perth-Christmas Island-Jakarta-Singapore
nature_zh: 通信海缆：珀斯-圣诞岛-雅加达-新加坡
description_en:
Vocus-owned cable from Perth to Singapore.
- 4,600 km; ready for service September 2018.
- Landings Perth, Christmas Island, Anyer (Indonesia), Tanah Merah (Singapore).
- Wholly owned by Vocus.
description_zh:
Vocus持有的珀斯至新加坡海缆。
- 全长4,600公里；2018年9月投运。
- 登陆珀斯、圣诞岛、安耶尔（印尼）、丹那美拉（新加坡）。
- Vocus全资持有。
latest_update_en: 2018-09: Entered service.

name: Oman Australia Cable (OAC)
nature_en: Telecom cable Perth-Cocos-Diego Garcia-Oman
nature_zh: 通信海缆：珀斯-科科斯-迪戈加西亚-阿曼
capacity_note: lit capacity upgraded from 39 to 48 Tbps (Oct 2023)
description_en:
Direct Australia-Middle East route bypassing Singapore.
- Live September 2022; landings Perth, Cocos (Keeling) Islands, Diego Garcia, Barka (Oman).
- Lit capacity upgraded to 48 Tbps in October 2023 (Ciena).
- Owned and operated by SUBCO.
description_zh:
绕开新加坡的澳大利亚-中东直连通道。
- 2022年9月开通；登陆珀斯、科科斯（基林）群岛、迪戈加西亚、巴尔卡（阿曼）。
- 2023年10月点亮容量升至48 Tbps（Ciena）。
- SUBCO持有并运营。
latest_update_en: 2023-10: Capacity upgrade to 48 Tbps.
latest_update_zh: 2023年10月：容量升级至48 Tbps。

name: Sydney-Melbourne-Adelaide-Perth (SMAP)
name_zh: SMAP海缆（悉尼-墨尔本-阿德莱德-珀斯）
nature_en: Domestic festoon telecom cable around southern Australia
nature_zh: 沿南部海岸的国内通信海缆
description_en:
SUBCO domestic subsea cable linking the four southern capitals.
- ~5,000 km; landings Sydney (Maroubra), Torquay (VIC), Adelaide and Perth.
- Ready for service listed as June 2026 (TeleGeography).
- Adds subsea diversity to terrestrial east-west fibre.
description_zh:
SUBCO连接南部四个首府的国内海缆。
- 约5,000公里；登陆悉尼（Maroubra）、Torquay（维州）、阿德莱德、珀斯。
- TeleGeography列示2026年6月投运。
- 为陆上东西向光缆提供海底冗余。
latest_update_en: 2026-06: Listed ready for service (TeleGeography; commercial launch not independently verified).
latest_update_zh: 2026年6月：列示投运（TeleGeography；商业开通未独立核实）。

name: Japan-Guam-Australia South (JGA-S)
name_zh: 日本-关岛-澳大利亚南段海缆JGA-S
nature_en: Telecom cable Sydney/Sunshine Coast-Guam
nature_zh: 通信海缆：悉尼/阳光海岸-关岛
description_en:
Australia-Guam leg of the JGA system.
- 7,081 km; ready for service March 2020.
- Landings Brookvale (NSW), Maroochydore (QLD), Piti (Guam).
- Owners AARNet, Google and Lightstorm.
description_zh:
JGA系统的澳大利亚-关岛段。
- 全长7,081公里；2020年3月投运。
- 登陆Brookvale（新州）、Maroochydore（昆州）、皮蒂（关岛）。
- 股东AARNet、谷歌、Lightstorm。
latest_update_en: 2020-03: Entered service.

name: Coral Sea Cable System (CS2)
nature_en: Telecom cable Sydney-Port Moresby-Honiara
nature_zh: 通信海缆：悉尼-莫尔兹比港-霍尼亚拉
owners: PNG DataCo, Solomon Islands Submarine Cable Company (Australian Government-funded build)
description_en:
Australian Government-funded cable to Papua New Guinea and Solomon Islands.
- 4,700 km; ready for service February 2020.
- Landings Sydney, Port Moresby, Honiara and Solomon Islands domestic branches.
- Owned by PNG DataCo and Solomon Islands Submarine Cable Company.
description_zh:
澳大利亚政府出资建设的巴新及所罗门群岛海缆。
- 全长4,700公里；2020年2月投运。
- 登陆悉尼、莫尔兹比港、霍尼亚拉及所罗门群岛国内支线。
- 由PNG DataCo及所罗门群岛海缆公司持有。
latest_update_en: 2020-02: Entered service.

name: Tasman Global Access (TGA)
nature_en: Telecom cable Sydney-New Zealand
nature_zh: 通信海缆：悉尼-新西兰
capacity_note: design capacity 20 Tbps
description_en:
Trans-Tasman cable providing diversity to Southern Cross.
- 2,288 km, Narrabeen (NSW) to Raglan (NZ); in service 2017.
- Design capacity 20 Tbps.
- Owned by Spark, Telstra and Vodafone NZ.
description_zh:
为Southern Cross提供冗余的跨塔斯曼海海缆。
- 全长2,288公里，Narrabeen（新州）至Raglan（新西兰）；2017年投运。
- 设计容量20 Tbps。
- 股东Spark、澳洲电信Telstra、沃达丰新西兰。
latest_update_en: 2017: Entered service.

name: Australia-Japan Cable (AJC)
nature_en: Telecom cable Sydney-Guam-Japan
nature_zh: 通信海缆：悉尼-关岛-日本
description_en:
Legacy Australia-Japan route.
- 12,700 km; ready for service December 2001.
- Landings Sydney, Guam (Tanguisson Point, Tumon Bay), Japan (Maruyama, Shima).
- Owners AT&T, NTT, SoftBank, Telstra and Verizon.
description_zh:
澳日传统通信路由。
- 全长12,700公里；2001年12月投运。
- 登陆悉尼、关岛、日本（丸山、志摩）。
- 股东AT&T、NTT、软银、澳洲电信Telstra、Verizon。
latest_update_en: 2001-12: Entered service.

name: Tabua
nature_en: Google telecom cable Australia-Fiji-US
nature_zh: 谷歌通信海缆：澳大利亚-斐济-美国
description_en:
Google cable linking Australia to the US via Fiji.
- 14,751 km; landings Maroochydore, Sydney, Natadola and Suva (Fiji), Kapolei (Hawaii), Los Angeles.
- Ready-for-service targeted 2027.
- Part of Google's South Pacific Connect programme.
description_zh:
谷歌经斐济连接澳美的海缆。
- 全长14,751公里；登陆Maroochydore、悉尼、斐济Natadola及苏瓦、夏威夷Kapolei、洛杉矶。
- 目标2027年投运。
- 属谷歌南太平洋互联计划。
latest_update_en: 2027 RFS listed by TeleGeography (construction progress not verified).
latest_update_zh: TeleGeography列示2027年投运（施工进度未核实）。

name: Honomoana
